sp-04867.description_en: I — Creates a wall a black, insubstantial wall up to 20' x 20' x 1" that light cannot pass into or through (i.e., it does not hinder movement, but it blocks vision).

sp-04868.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-04869.description_en: As Light Wall I, except for duration.

sp-04870.description_en: Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.

sp-04871.description_en: Creates a wall of wood up to 10' x 20' x 2". This wall can be burned though, chopped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

sp-04872.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of earth and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (3' at base, 1' at top) of packed earth.

sp-04873.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of ice and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (2' at base, 1' at top). It can be melted through, chipped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

sp-04874.description_en: Opens a pit (500 cubic feet in stone; 1000 cubic feet in earth or ice). The entire pit must be within 50' of caster. A pit may not be opened except on a horizontal surface with an incline of less than 45˚.

sp-04876.description_en: As Woodwall, except wall is made of stone and has a size up to 10' x 10' x 1'. It can be chipped through.

sp-04879.description_en: As Earth Wall, except for duration.

sp-04880.description_en: As Icewall I, except wall is up to 20' x 20' x (4' at base, 2' at top).

sp-04882.description_en: Fuses 2 touching walls (seam can be up to 20' long) or fuses a section of stone blocks (up to 100 cubic feet').

sp-04883.description_en: As any one of the lower level “wall” spells on this list, except the wall can be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-04884.description_en: By directly Channeling the power of his deity, the caster creates a transparent wall of “force” that is absolutely impassable by anyone or anything. It can be up to 10' x 20' x 1".

sp-04885.description_en: Target is healed of d10 concussion hits.

sp-04886.description_en: Target is healed of one area of up to mild frostbite or 1st degree burn.

sp-04887.description_en: Target is healed of one minor irritation (e.g., headache, toothache, bee-sting, hangover, etc.).

sp-04888.description_en: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 3d10 concussion hits.

sp-04889.description_en: Target is relieved of 1 round's worth of accumulated stun effects. See Section 7.1.1 for more information.

sp-04890.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 2 areas of mild damage or 1 area of moderate damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn).

sp-04891.description_en: Will reduce damage target has by 1 hit every minute as long as caster concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him without concentration. See Appendix 7.1.1 for more on subconscious spells.

sp-04892.description_en: As Healing I except that target is healed of 5d10 concussion hits.

sp-04893.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or a combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area of damage.

sp-04895.description_en: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 7d10 concussion hits.

sp-04896.description_en: As Regeneration I, except target's damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute of concentration.

sp-04897.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 4 mild or 2 moderate or 1 mild and 1 severe or 2 mild and 1 moderate area(s) of damage.

sp-04898.description_en: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 10d10 concussion hits.

sp-04899.description_en: As Stun Relief, except that the caster's range is 100'.

sp-04900.description_en: As Regeneration I, except target's damage is reduced by 3 hits per minute.

sp-04901.description_en: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 15d10 concussion hits.

sp-04902.description_en: As Regeneration I, except target's damage is reduced by 5 hits per minute.

sp-04903.description_en: As Healing I, except that target is healed of all concussion hits.

sp-04904.description_en: Allows caster to heal all concussion hits in a number of targets equal to level of caster.

sp-04905.description_en: Detects any active spell or item from the Channeling realm; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-04906.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except realm is Essence.

sp-04907.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except realm is Mentalism.

sp-04908.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except detects living beings.

sp-04909.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except detects curses on people or things.

sp-04910.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except detects the presence of Undead.

sp-04911.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance). See Section 7.1.28 for information on trap complexity.

sp-04912.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except it analyzes one living being; giving race, age, and current state of health.

sp-04913.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except detects invisible things. All attacks against an invisible target suffer a -50 penalty (instead of the standard -100). See Section 7.1.10 for more in Invisibility.

sp-04914.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e., level) of the person, item, or spell examined.

sp-04915.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except it gives an analysis of any poisons on a single object or in a single being.

sp-04916.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or cast) and what spell list it was cast from. In the case of a person, it gives his exact profession.

sp-04917.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except detects any spell that has ever been cast in the area examined.

sp-04918.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except range is 500' and area is 50'R.

sp-04919.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.

sp-04920.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except a curse may be analyzed for level, effect and required cure.

sp-04921.description_en: As Life Typing, except also gives exact profession, alignment, and other pertinent details.

sp-04922.description_en: As Detect Channeling, except any of the lower level spells on this list can be used once per round.

sp-04923.description_en: As Location, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-04924.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm; 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the spell duration has not expired).

sp-04925.description_en: I — Lights a 10'R area about the point touched; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-04926.description_en: Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks against the target.

sp-04927.description_en: As Light I, except 1 or 2 areas can be created with a total radius of 20' (e.g., one area of 20' or two areas of 10').

sp-04928.description_en: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light, all within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-04929.description_en: As Aura, except it makes him appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from all attacks against the target.

sp-04930.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-04931.description_en: As Light II, up to 3 areas can be created with a total radius of 30'.

sp-04932.description_en: As Light I, except it is the equivalent of full daylight; it also nullifies all magically created darkness for the duration.

sp-04933.description_en: As Light I, except caster can delay the spell up to 24 hours; it can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): elapsed time, specific movements, specific sounds, or touch.

sp-04934.description_en: A 6" radius ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area equal to the range is lit if the flare can raise to its full range. If used against a target, use the Shock Bolt Attack Table but deliver Heat criticals.

sp-04935.description_en: As Light III, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of 50'.

sp-04936.description_en: As Light III, except up to 10 areas can be created with a total radius of 100'.

sp-04937.description_en: As Utterlight I, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of 50'.

sp-04938.description_en: As Light III, except total radius is 10' per level.

sp-04939.description_en: As Aura, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-04940.description_en: Caster can cause a lightning bolt to strike a target within his range. Results are determined on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table. There must be a storm within 1 mile that is severe enough to cause precipitation or lightning or very heavy winds. The caster must be outdoors to cast this spell.

sp-04941.description_en: As Aura, except target seems like a minor god and the subtraction is 25.

sp-04942.description_en: As Utterlight I, except as many areas as the caster levels can be created with a total radius of 10' per level.

sp-04943.description_en: Target can walk along narrow edges (down to 2" wide) that can support his weight. Maneuver rolls are not normally required.

sp-04944.description_en: Target can walk along tree limbs as if he were on level ground.

sp-04945.description_en: Target can walk on stone surfaces of up to 60˚ as if he were on level ground.

sp-04946.description_en: Target can walk on water as if he were on level ground; may not be used on rough water.

sp-04947.description_en: Target can merge into organic material (live or dead). While merged, the target cannot move or perceive. When the target emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The target cannot move “through” material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet.

sp-04948.description_en: Caster “stores” a location for use with spells later on this list. While casting this spell, the caster must meditate for one hour in the location that will be stored. The caster can only have one sanctuary stored at a time. As long as this location remains “stored,” it will detect as a magical (i.e., “holy”) place.

sp-04949.description_en: As Limbwalking, except target can run.

sp-04950.description_en: As Stonewalking, except target can run.

sp-04951.description_en: As Waterwalking, except target can run.

sp-04952.description_en: Target can walk on calm air. This spell only allows for horizontal movement. Vertical movement must be achieved by other means.

sp-04953.description_en: Caster may return to his stored sanctuary so long as the sanctuary is no more than 1 mile away.

sp-04955.description_en: As Returning I, except the sanctuary can be up to 5 miles away.

sp-04956.description_en: As Windwalking, except target can run.

sp-04957.description_en: As Returning I, except the sanctuary can be up to 10 miles away.

sp-04958.description_en: As Great Merging Organic, except target may use spells on himself while merged.

sp-04959.description_en: As Windrunning, except target can run up to twice the normal speed on calm air without expending energy.

sp-04960.description_en: As Returning I, except the sanctuary can be any distance away up to 10 miles per level of the caster.

sp-04961.description_en: Caster may go to his sanctuary (as per Word of Return), stay up to 1 round per level, and then return to the point where he cast his spell (thus making it a round trip).

sp-04975.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 5 animals.

sp-04976.description_en: As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 3 plants.

sp-04977.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except that the radius is 500'.

sp-04978.description_en: Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any 1 animal, plant, stone, or dead organic object. The caster can change targets once per round.

sp-04979.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control all of the animals of a given species within a range equal to 10' x his level (e.g., at 30th level you could control all of the ferrets or minks within 300').

sp-04980.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except duration is permanent and concentration is not required. At a given time, there may only be 1 animal controlled by caster through use of this spell.

sp-04962.description_en: Caster learns nature, history, and value of any 1 plant.

sp-04963.description_en: Caster can understand the nature, origin, and value of any 1 herb; if the plant is not an herb, no information will be related.

sp-04964.description_en: Caster learns the nature, history, and origin of any 1 stone.

sp-04965.description_en: Caster can increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the radius by 10 times.

sp-04966.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.

sp-04967.description_en: Caster can control the actions of any 1 animal.

sp-04968.description_en: Caster can monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., he will be aware of subtle movements). For the duration of the spell, the caster cannot move.

sp-04969.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.

sp-04970.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 3 animals.

sp-04971.description_en: Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any 1 animal.

sp-04972.description_en: Caster can control the automatic and/or mental processes of any 1 plant. Caster can also control the plant's movements. Note that this spell does not allow movement beyond normal allowances.

sp-04973.description_en: Caster can communicate with any 1 stone if it possesses any animate qualities (e.g., caster could speak to a holy stone that possesses an intelligence).

sp-04974.description_en: Caster can grow an herb by planting the proper seed. The herb is sterile and the growth takes 1-10 rounds.

sp-04981.description_en: Stops infection and/or spread of a disease in 1 target after he has acquired the disease. No further damage will occur in uninfected areas of the body.

sp-04982.description_en: This spell perfectly preserves one day's worth of food for 1 week, after which it will spoil normally.

sp-04983.description_en: Neutralizes any 1 poison in the system of 1 target. Note: Damage already sustained is not cured.

sp-04984.description_en: For the duration of the spell, target gets an additional RR versus any disease(s).

sp-04985.description_en: For the duration of the spell, target gets an additional RR versus any poison(s).

sp-04986.description_en: This spell neutralizes abnormal diseases, poison, and other similar substances in one day's worth of food and/or water. It will not neutralize a poison or similar substance that is a natural part of the food (e.g., it will not neutralize the natural poison in poisoned mushrooms).

sp-04987.description_en: As Disease Resistance I, except target gets 2 additional RRs.

sp-04988.description_en: As Poison Resistance I, except target gets 2 additional RRs.

sp-04989.description_en: Target is cured of any 1 mind disease, recovery 1-50 days.

sp-04990.description_en: As Disease Resistance I, except target gets 3 additional RRs.

sp-04991.description_en: As Poison Resistance I, except target gets 3 additional RRs.

sp-04992.description_en: Caster can remove any 1 disease from a target.

sp-04993.description_en: Caster can remove any 1 poison from a target.

sp-04994.description_en: Caster can remove any 1 disease from a number of targets equal to his level (e.g., an 18th level caster could remove leprosy from 18 targets).

sp-04995.description_en: Caster can remove any 1 poison from the systems of a number of targets equal to his level.

sp-04996.description_en: As Mind Disease Cures, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-04999.description_en: Eliminates all poisons and/or diseases in the area.

sp-05000.description_en: Target is able to communicate basic ideas in the language of a specific being (e.g., hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language.

sp-05001.description_en: Creates a 1'R area around the target, into and out of which sound cannot travel; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being; +25 to Stalking attempts. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-05002.description_en: Creates a plane (up to 20' x 20'), through which sound will not pass.

sp-05003.description_en: As Speech I, except target can communicate in more complex concepts, although there is a good chance of misinterpretations. For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.

sp-05004.description_en: As Quiet I, except radius is 10'.

sp-05005.description_en: As Quiet I, except 3 targets can be affected.

sp-05006.description_en: As Soundwall I, except 5 such walls are created. Each Soundwall must be connected to at least one other Soundwall.

sp-05007.description_en: As Quiet I, except 5 targets may be affected.

sp-05008.description_en: As Silence I, except radius is 50'.

sp-05009.description_en: As Speech II, except target is reasonably fluent in the language. Target's accent is imperfect, but there is only a slight chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the language.

sp-05010.description_en: Target can speak at 5 times his normal loudness.

sp-05011.description_en: As Silence I, except radius is 100'.

sp-05012.description_en: As Soundwall V, except as many Soundwalls as the target's level can be created.

sp-05013.description_en: As Quiet I, except as many targets as the target's level can be affected.

sp-05014.description_en: As Speech III, except for the duration and the target speaks the specified language as if he were a native. For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 8 in the language.

sp-05037.description_en: Caster can ascertain information from the surrounding atmosphere. Information that may be gained includes: temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and wind speed. The caster can gain a different piece of information each round.

sp-05038.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time and type of precipitation (±15 minutes) over the next 24 hour period.

sp-05039.description_en: As Rain Prediction, except it allows a 95% chance of predicting the time and type of a storm, ±15 minutes over the next 24 hour period.

sp-05040.description_en: As Rain Prediction except it allows 95% chance of predicting time, type, and severity of weather (±15 minutes) over the next 24 hour period.

sp-05041.description_en: Caster causes a breeze to come forth that will drive out any gaseous matter (cloud, etc.) and subtracts from all missile attacks (-10). Once set, the direction of the breeze will not change.

sp-05042.description_en: Caster causes fog to arise that obscures all vision in and through the radius. All missile attacks into or out of the fog are modified by -10 to -50 (GM's discretion).

sp-05043.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except that caster has a 95% chance of predicting weather over a 3 day period.

sp-05044.description_en: Caster causes rain or snow (depending on temperature) to fall. The precipitation obscures vision into the radius by 25% and modifies all missile attacks passing through any part of the area by -25.

sp-05045.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except that caster has a 95% chance of predicting weather over a 5 day period.

sp-05046.description_en: Caster can control the speed and direction of the wind. Caster can increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mph x his level (e.g., if the wind speed is normally 20 mph, a 15th level caster could reset the wind speed to any speed between 5 and 35 mph). By directing the wind against missile attacks he can cause a -1 modification for each mph of wind speed. Note that caster can also control the direction of the flow of gases and/or clouds.

sp-05047.description_en: Caster can make the skies clear of haze, precipitation, clouds, etc. This spell will not affect the wind.

sp-05048.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except that caster has a 95% chance of predicting weather over a 30 day period.

sp-05049.description_en: Caster can summon rain of moderate intensity. The rain will obscure short range vision by up to 25% and long range vision by up to 75%. In addition, missile attacks will suffer penalties. Short-ranged attacks suffer a -25. Mediumranged attacks suffer a 75. Long-ranged attacks are not possible.

sp-05050.description_en: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list, but with an increased area of effect (1 mile radius).

sp-05051.description_en: Caster may call forth a storm of any type with maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to circumstance (and the GM's discretion). For example, a 30th level caster could summon a lightning storm with intense rain and constant wind speeds of up to 60 m.p.h.: the GM may wish to have random rolls to determine possible lightning strikes versus exposed targets.

sp-05052.description_en: Caster may indicate the weather conditions in the area, modifying wind speeds by ±1 m.p.h. per level, and setting the level of intensity, fog, cloud cover etc. Caster may call for shifts in the patterns as he concentrates, but the change will take at least 1 minute.

sp-05053.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round; target may not be moved, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-05054.description_en: As Flowstop I, except that caster can stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total).

sp-05055.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round; for 1 hour, target can move at no more than a walking pace, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-05056.description_en: As Flowstop I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is bleeding up to 5 hits per round.

sp-05057.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of same spells from Muscle Law, Bone Law, and Nerve Law.

sp-05058.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding from 1 wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round.

sp-05059.description_en: As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total).

sp-05060.description_en: Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that bleeds at up to 3 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).

sp-05061.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) up to 3 hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hit per round wound or one 2 hit per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be healed.

sp-05062.description_en: Allows caster to repair 1 damaged blood vessel of any size, including severed veins and arteries; recovery time: 1-10 days, depending on size of vessel and severity of damage. A major vessel is one that bleeds at 5 hit per round or more when severed.

sp-05063.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb; also requires use of Bone Law, Muscle Law, and Nerve Law Joining spells in order to restore functional status; limb is fully functional in 10-100 days.

sp-05064.description_en: As Flow Stoppage I, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-05065.description_en: As Clotting I, except that blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-05066.description_en: Allows caster to remove any one blood clot; will counter Clotting Curse (on the Evil Cleric list, Curses). This spell has no affect on bleeding wounds that have clotted (i.e., “clots” in this sense apply only to internal blood clotting).

sp-05067.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.

sp-05068.description_en: As Flow Stoppage True, except that caster may stop bleeding from a number of wounds equal to his level (e.g., a 20th level caster can stop bleeding from 20 wounds).

sp-05069.description_en: As Joining, except that limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).

sp-05070.description_en: As Mass Flow Stoppage, except that bleeding is stopped as in Clotting True.

sp-05071.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding in, and fully repair, 1 wound per level (e.g., a 50th level caster can fully repair a total of 50 wounds/spell cast).

sp-05072.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any bone damage, including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-05073.description_en: Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is one day.

sp-05074.description_en: Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time is one day.

sp-05075.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of one limb (even if severed). Also requires the use of the same spell from Nerve Law, Muscle Law, and Blood Law.

sp-05076.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can also repair compound fractures. Recovery time is one day.

sp-05077.description_en: Allows caster to mend one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered area). Recovery time is 1-10 days (depending on the damage).

sp-05078.description_en: Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered). Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-05080.description_en: Allows caster to reattach a limb. Requires the use of Muscle Law, Blood Law, and Nerve Law Joining spells to restore functional status. Limb is fully functional in 10-100 days.

sp-05081.description_en: As Cartilage Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05082.description_en: As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05083.description_en: As Skull Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05084.description_en: As Joint Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-05085.description_en: Allows caster to repair any broken or shattered bone. Requires a 10 minute operation and 1-10 days recovery time.

sp-05087.description_en: As Mass Minor Fracture Repair, except it repairs cartilage (as in Cartilage Repair).

sp-05088.description_en: As Joining, except that the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided that the caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).

sp-05090.description_en: As Mass Minor Fracture Repair, except for the range and it repairs any broken or shattered bone (as in Shatter Repair).

sp-05091.description_en: Target will take no aggressive/offensive action, and will fight only if attacked.

sp-05092.description_en: As Calm I, except 2 targets may be affected.

sp-05093.description_en: Humanoid target is held to 25% of normal action.

sp-05094.description_en: As Calm I, except 3 targets may be affected.

sp-05095.description_en: As Calm I, except 4 targets may affected.

sp-05096.description_en: As Calm I, except 5 targets may be affected.

sp-05097.description_en: ng I — Caster can calm a number of animals equal to his level.

sp-05098.description_en: As Hold Kind, except it will affect any target.

sp-05099.description_en: As Calm I, except that 10 targets may be affected.

sp-05100.description_en: All targets in radius must resist or they are calmed.

sp-05102.description_en: Allows Caster to calm up to 20 targets.

sp-05104.description_en: Caster can calm a number of targets equal to his level.

sp-05114.description_en: As Water Production I, except caster can produce 5 days of water.

sp-05115.description_en: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 5 beings for 1 day.

sp-05116.description_en: As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce 3 loaves of waybread.

sp-05117.description_en: Caster can double the potency of any 1 herb (growing or dead); spell may be employed only once/herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.

sp-05118.description_en: Caster can produce a plant up to 10' in height and/or width; plant must be commonly found in the region.

sp-05119.description_en: As Water Production I, except caster can create 1 day of water per level (e.g., a 17th level Cleric could create 17 days of water).

sp-05120.description_en: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed a number of beings equal to his level.

sp-05121.description_en: uction — Caster can create an animal representative of the surrounding region and weighing no more than 10 pounds; animal will be friendly to caster.

sp-05122.description_en: As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce loaves of waybread equal to his level.

sp-05123.description_en: As Lesser Plant Production, except that caster can create 1 plant with a height and/or width of 1' per level (e.g., a 30th level could produce a 20' high tree with a 30' maximum width); plant must be commonly found in the local area.

sp-05124.description_en: As Lesser Animal Production, except that caster can produce an animal with a maximum weight of 1 pound per level; the animal must be a native of the area.

sp-05106.description_en: Allows caster to go without food or water and not suffer damage (i.e., provides nutrition and water for 1 day).

sp-05107.description_en: Caster can produce sufficient in any available receptacle to supply a being for one day.

sp-05108.description_en: Caster can produce sufficient food from the surrounding area to feed 1 hearty appetite for 1 day.

sp-05109.description_en: Allows caster to set a fire of 1'R; fire will then last as long as there is fuel. A target in the 1'R will take an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-05110.description_en: Caster can produce 1 loaf of waybread that weighs .5lb and will support 1 being for 1 day; the loaf will lose potency in 1 month.

sp-05111.description_en: As Water Production I, except caster can produce 3 days of water.

sp-05112.description_en: As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 3 beings for 1 day.

sp-05113.description_en: Allows caster to enhance the potency of any 1 growing herb by 100% (i.e., x2); spell may be employed only once per herb.

sp-05125.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g, roll 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).

sp-05126.description_en: Caster learns the location(s) of any “path(s)” within 100'; gives the nearest point on path, but not the path's course.

sp-05127.description_en: The caster is subtly directed (hints and clues) towards a specific destination (within 100'/lvl) by guidance from his deity. The exact form of the guidance may vary from deity to deity (e.g., a deity of water might leave hints in the rocks of a stream, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the caster must concentrate on following the guidance.

sp-05128.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.

sp-05129.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 300'.

sp-05130.description_en: As Location I, except range is 300'.

sp-05131.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 500'.

sp-05132.description_en: As Location I, except range is 500'.

sp-05133.description_en: Caster can remember an exact route he traveled; whether or not he was without one or more of his senses when he made his original journey (e.g., a 12th level caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip even if he had been blindfolded). To be effective, this spell must be cast within 1 month of the journey.

sp-05134.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 1 mile.

sp-05135.description_en: As Guidance, except the form of the guidance is that of an animal companion sent by the deity. The caster can follow the animal to a specific destination. If more than 24 hours pass without the caster making progress towards the destination, the animal will leave.

sp-05136.description_en: Caster can locate any 1 object he describes, if indeed it exists and is in range (e.g., caster could describe a type of mace he had never seen or heard of).

sp-05137.description_en: As Location I, except range is 1 mile.

sp-05138.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 10 miles.

sp-05139.description_en: As Finding I, except range is 300'.

sp-05140.description_en: As Location I, except range is 20 miles.

sp-05141.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 1 mile per level and exact route(s) within the range are ascertained.

sp-05142.description_en: As Location I, except range is 1 mi per level.

sp-05143.description_en: As Finding, except range is 100' per level.

sp-05144.description_en: Allows caster virtual total recall of any conversation or writing he encountered within a period of days equal to his level.

sp-05145.description_en: Detects “true evil” in an animate or inanimate target; caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-05146.description_en: As Detect Evil, except caster can detect curses.

sp-05147.description_en: As Detect Evil, except caster can detect extremes of emotion (e.g., hatred, love, sadness, etc.). In addition, the caster learns which emotions the target is feeling in extreme. If there are no extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal feelings), this spell detects nothing.

sp-05148.description_en: Caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 1 “holy item” that is not “of darkness” or “of evil;” will not give specific capabilities.

sp-05149.description_en: Caster can ascertain exact nature and type of poison; he can determine what cure may be used, but does not receive the required tools or skills.

sp-05150.description_en: Caster can determine the nature and type of any 1 living target. He will not be able to ascertain the target's personal traits or capabilities, but will know the normal abilities associated with the target's species.

sp-05151.description_en: Caster can determine nature and origin of any 1 curse, including the name of the one who bequeathed it.

sp-05152.description_en: As Light Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 1 item “of darkness” or “of evil.”

sp-05153.description_en: As Light Lore I, except that caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 2 “holy items” or caster can determine the nature, origin point, and the exact significance of any 1 “holy item.”

sp-05154.description_en: Caster can determine the nature and origin of extreme emotion(s) found within any 1 target (inanimate or animate); the degree and other details of the emotion(s) can also be acquired.

sp-05155.description_en: As Light Lore I, except that caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 3 “holy items” or caster can determine the age, origin point, name of the creator, and nature of any 1 “holy item.” Caster also learns item's specific capabilities.

sp-05156.description_en: As Light Lore II, except that it can only be used on items “of darkness” or “of evil.”

sp-05157.description_en: Caster can ascertain exact nature, origin, purpose, and history of any 1 “holy item;” it allows caster to visualize all who have possessed the item.

sp-05158.description_en: As Light Lore III, except that it can be used only on items of evil or “darkness.”

sp-05159.description_en: As Life Lore, except caster can determine specific traits and capabilities of any 1 target.

sp-05160.description_en: As White Lore, except it can only be used on an item “of darkness” or “of evil.”

sp-05161.description_en: As White Lore, except caster can acquire the information on all “holy items” within 100'.

sp-05162.description_en: Caster acquires a complete understanding of any muscle damage, including the tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-05163.description_en: As Muscle Lore, except the knowledge obtained concerns the healing of tendon damage.

sp-05165.description_en: Allows caster to repair (not replace) 1 damaged muscle; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-05166.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of same spells from Nerve Law, Bone Law, and Blood Law.

sp-05167.description_en: Allows caster to repair one damaged tendon; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-05168.description_en: As Muscle Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.

sp-05169.description_en: As Tendon Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.

sp-05170.description_en: Allows caster to reattach limb, but requires use of Bone Law, Blood Law, and Nerve Law Joining spells in order to restore functional status; limb is fully functional in 1-10 days.

sp-05171.description_en: As Muscle Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous and requires 1 minute “operation” (concentration by caster).

sp-05172.description_en: As Tendon Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous and requires 1 minute “operation” (concentration by caster).

sp-05173.description_en: Allows repair of 1 muscle per level of the caster (e.g., a 17th level caster can repair 17 muscles); spell can be used as long as caster concentrates (i.e., caster can move from target to target until he has healed a number of muscles equal to his level); recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-05174.description_en: As Mass Muscle Repair, except caster heals tendons.

sp-05175.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 muscle; regrowth takes 1-10 hrs, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05176.description_en: As Joining, except limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).

sp-05177.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate 1 tendon; regrowth takes 1-10 hrs, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05178.description_en: As Mass Muscle Repair, except any combination of muscles and tendons may be healed, the range is 100', and recovery is instantaneous.

sp-05179.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any nerve damage, including the tools and methods required for healing: caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-05180.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor damage to 1 nerve; requires 1 day recovery period. Minor damage is defined as any nerve damage that results in penalties up to -20.

sp-05181.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of same spells from Muscle Law, Bone Law, and Blood Law.

sp-05182.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except will heal any nerve damage.

sp-05183.description_en: Caster can cure any 1 paralysis problem.

sp-05184.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except there is no recovery time.

sp-05185.description_en: Allows caster to reattach limb, but requires use of Bone Law, Muscle Law, and Blood Law Joining spells in order to restore functional status; limb is fully functional in 10-100 days.

sp-05186.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor brain damage (including recovery from coma); note that experience lost is not restored (% lost permanently dependent on severity of damage); requires a 1 hour operation; recovery time: 1-10 days.

sp-05187.description_en: As Major Nerve Repair, except that there is no recovery period required.

sp-05188.description_en: Allows caster to cure paralysis in 1 target (recovery time of 1-10 days); paralysis must have resulted from a spell or disease (not a poison).

sp-05189.description_en: Allows caster to repair a minor psychosis in 1 target (recovery time of 1-10 days). Minor psychoses include mild to moderate phobias (see GM Law for more on mind diseases).

sp-05190.description_en: As Nerve Repair True, except that each spell cast affects 1 nerve per level of caster.

sp-05191.description_en: As Joining, except that limb is fully functional in only 10 minutes (provided caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).

sp-05192.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate lost nerve; regrowth takes 110 days, depending on extent of loss.

sp-05193.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate lost brain material; regrowth takes 10-100 days, depending on extent of damage; target is in coma during recovery; note that experience lost is not restored (amount lost permanently is dependent on severity of damage).

sp-05194.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any organ damage, including the tools and the methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-05195.description_en: Allows caster to repair any nose damage short of complete nose loss; requires 6-60 minutes depending on damage.

sp-05196.description_en: Caster can repair any external damage, including ear loss (regeneration takes 1-10 hours).

sp-05197.description_en: Allows caster to repair any minor eye damage (e.g., corneal scratch, removal of foreign object, etc.).

sp-05198.description_en: As Minor Ear Repair except that caster can repair any interior or exterior damage; hearing is restored in 1-10 days (note that complete replacement of the inner ear is an exception).

sp-05199.description_en: As Minor Eye Repair, except that caster can repair any eye damage short of total eye loss (e.g., eye's destruction precludes repair); recovery time: 1-10 days.

sp-05200.description_en: Allows caster to repair any heart damage short of total loss or destruction (i.e., replacement); requires 1-10 hour operation and 1-100 day recovery time.

sp-05201.description_en: Allows caster to repair any lung damage short of total loss or destruction (i.e., replacement); requires a 1-10 hour operation and 1-100 day recovery time.

sp-05202.description_en: Allows caster to repair any internal or external organ damage (not including the brain or nervous system); requires a 1-10 hour operation and 1-10 day recovery time.

sp-05203.description_en: Allows target to regenerate 1 lost nose; regrowth takes 1-10 days.

sp-05204.description_en: Allows caster to transplant 1 healthy organ; operation takes 1 hour; recovery time: 1-10 days; chance of rejection is 10% if same race, 50% if other humanoid.

sp-05205.description_en: eration — Allows target to regenerate 1 lost eye or ear (including inner ear); regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on loss.

sp-05206.description_en: As Organ Repair, except recovery time is 10 minutes and no operation is required.

sp-05207.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate heart; regrowth takes 1-10 days.

sp-05208.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate any internal or external organ (not including the brain or nervous system); regrowth takes 1-10 days.

sp-05210.description_en: This spell “primes” the next spell cast by the caster—that spell is treated as if it were instantaneous. The PP cost of this spell is equal to the highest level that the caster desires to be primed. For example, if the caster wants any fourth level spell (or less) to be treated as instantaneous, this spell will cost 4 PPs. In addition, when casting this spell, the caster must pray for one minute per PP spent in the spell. For example, if the caster spends 4 PPs on this spell, he must pray for 4 minutes before this spell is completed. Any interruption of this process results in the failure of this spell. The effects of this spell end when the caster casts his next spell (even if the next spell is higher level than the number of PPs expended on this spell). (Got all that?)

sp-05211.description_en: Caster can remove one Symbol I (an emplaced 1st level spell). The Symbol's RR is based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (the target level) and the level of the Unsymbol spell (the attack level).

sp-05212.description_en: (F) D: P R: 10' Caster can emplace one 1st level spell on any 1 given non-mobile stone (see below). Within one minute, the spell to be emplaced must also be cast (within 10'). The symbol is usually visible, but is only required to be visible if reading is the trigger (see below). • The Symbol must be placed on a slab of stone (block, piece, etc.) weighing at least 2,000 pounds. Only one Symbol may be placed on each continuous slab. The stone may not be moved without dispelling the Symbol. • A Symbol can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is normally 10' or the range of the emplaced spell, whichever is larger. • If the spell emplaced is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell's level (i.e., for Symbol I the attack level is always 1st level, not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normally +0. However, the attack can be focused on a location (as opposed to simply the person who triggers the symbol). In this case, the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Symbol affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered only once per day.

sp-05213.description_en: (F) As above, except a 2nd level spell is emplaced.

sp-05214.description_en: (F) As above, except 2nd level spell is removed.

sp-05215.description_en: (F) As above, except a 3rd level spell is emplaced.

sp-05217.description_en: (F) As above, except a 5th level spell may be emplaced.

sp-05218.description_en: (F) As above, except 3rd level spell is removed.

sp-05219.description_en: (F) As above, except a 6th level spell is removed.

sp-05220.description_en: (F) As above, except 7th level spell is emplaced.

sp-05221.description_en: (F) As above, except 5th level spell is removed.

sp-05222.description_en: (F) As above, except a 8th level spell is emplaced.

sp-05223.description_en: (F) As above, except 10th level spell is removed.

sp-05224.description_en: (F) As above, except a 9th level spell is emplaced.

sp-05225.description_en: (F) As above, except a 10th level spell is emplaced.

sp-05227.description_en: (F) As above, except a 20th level spell is emplaced.

sp-05228.description_en: (F) As above, except caster can remove any spell of a level less than his own (e.g., a 50th level Cleric could remove a 49th level spell, but not a 50th level spell).

sp-02864.description_en: Puts any animal (i.e., non-humanoid) to sleep. Will not affect enchanted creatures or creatures with greater than animal intelligence.

sp-02865.description_en: Caster may heal any non-fatal damage in any animal up to 10 pounds in weight. Healing takes 6-600 minutes.

sp-02866.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.

sp-02867.description_en: As Animal Sleep I, except can put up to 3 animals to sleep.

sp-02868.description_en: Allows caster to control the actions of any 1 animal.

sp-02869.description_en: Caster can locate members of any 1 species of animal or he can find out what species are in the area.

sp-02870.description_en: All animals within 10' will act friendly toward caster. This spell does not control the animals.

sp-02871.description_en: As Animal Restoration I, except will affect an animal up to 150 pounds in weight, or an animal up to 10 pounds in weight can be healed of fatal damage (though not brought back from the dead).

sp-02872.description_en: Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any 1 animal.

sp-02873.description_en: Caster magically summons a 1stlevel, non-intelligent creature from the surrounding area. The caster can specify the type of creature, but the GM should determine the type of creature that answers the summons. If the animal can understand the caster (e.g., Animal Tongues), the creature can be controlled through normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained only through concentration of the caster. If the animal summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in its own perception), the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the animal is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level.

sp-02874.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 3 animals.

sp-02875.description_en: As Animal Summons I, except caster can also choose two of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-02876.description_en: Caster can “call” any 1 known, specific animal. If it is physically possible, the animal will come to him.

sp-02877.description_en: Will return any animal up to 10 pounds in weight from the dead. The dead animal must make a roll (d100, open-ended) and add 2 times its previous level. There is an additional modifier of -2 per day that the animal was dead. If the result is over 100, the animal is returned from the dead. If the result is less than 100, the animal may not be returned from the dead by this caster (until the caster gains another level). The animal will be at -100 to all actions for a number of days equal to 20 days per day dead.

sp-02878.description_en: When cast upon any domesticated animal, that animal will return to its “wild” state. The animal will have no difficulty adapting to the harsh requirements of the wilderness (and have no desire to return to domestication).

sp-02879.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control 5 animals.

sp-02880.description_en: As Animal Restoration I, except will affect an animal up to 3,000 pounds in weight, or an animal up to 150 pounds in weight may be healed of fatal damage (though not brought back from the dead).

sp-02881.description_en: As Animal Summons II, except four options can be chosen.

sp-02882.description_en: As Animal Reviving I, except modifier is -1 for every two deads deady and there is no recovery time.

sp-02883.description_en: As Animal Summons II, except nine options may be chosen.

sp-02884.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control all animals of a given species within 10'R per level.

sp-02885.description_en: As Animal Reviving III, except target is automatically brought back from the dead and there is no recovery period; and the range is 100'.

sp-02886.description_en: As Animal Summons I, except caster can select one option for every two levels of experience.

sp-02887.description_en: Caster can understand the nature, origin, and value of any 1 herb. If the plant is not an herb, no information will be gained.

sp-02888.description_en: Allows caster to enhance the potency of any 1 growing herb by 100% (i.e., x2). This spell may be used only once per herb.

sp-02889.description_en: Allows caster to locate any 1 specific variety of herb that is sought, regardless of physical obstacles (gives exact direction, distance, and quantity).

sp-02890.description_en: Allows caster to make any 1 herb capable of being instantly effective. When the herb is subsequently used, its benefits/dangers will be immediately felt. The herb will keep for 1 day per level of the caster.

sp-02891.description_en: Caster can double the potency of any 1 herb (growing or dead). This spell may be employed only once per herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.

sp-02892.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except that the range is 300'.

sp-02893.description_en: Caster can grow an herb by planting the proper seed. The herb is sterile and the growth takes 1-10 rounds.

sp-02894.description_en: As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 3 times.

sp-02895.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except range is 500'.

sp-02896.description_en: Allows caster to remove any harmful poisons, by-products, or side effects from all herbs within range.

sp-02897.description_en: As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 5x.

sp-02898.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except range is 1 mile. Location is known within 10'R. 15 Herb Mastery X — As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 10x.

sp-02901.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except range is 5 miles. Location is known within 25'R.

sp-02902.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except range is 20 miles; location is known within 100'R.

sp-02903.description_en: As Enhancement, except that potency of 1 growing herb is increased 100% x level of caster (e.g., a 30th level caster could increase the potency of a growing herb by 3000% or 30 times its normal potency).

sp-02904.description_en: As Herb Mastery II, except that the potency fo 1 herb can be increased by 100% x level of caster (e.g., a 50th level caster could increase the potency of any herb by 5000% or 50 times its normal potency).

sp-02905.description_en: As Herb Finding I, except that caster can locate any 1 herb variety within a range of 1 mile per level of caster (e.g., 50 miles for a 50th level caster). Location is known within 100'R.

sp-02906.description_en: Caster has a 75% chance of detecting a trap in the area of effect. The caster can concentrate on a different area each round. There must be living plants or animals in the area of effect or no information will be gained.

sp-02907.description_en: Caster can monitor animate activity in the area of effect (e.g., he will be aware of subtle movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot move.

sp-02908.description_en: Caster learns the location(s) of any “path(s)” within 100'. The spell gives the nearest point on the path, but not the path's course.

sp-02909.description_en: Caster has a 75% chance of detecting active magic in the area of effect. The caster can concentrate on a different area each round. There must be living plants or animals in the area of effect or no information will be gained.

sp-02910.description_en: Give a 95% chance of predicting time, type, and severity of weather over the next 24 hour period.

sp-02911.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-02912.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 3 days.

sp-02913.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will know the direction and distance to any unique natural feature that the caster is familiar with. The feature must be within range or no information is gained.

sp-02914.description_en: Allows caster to set up a natural “alarm system” in the area of effect. Any disturbing activity will cause caster to be alerted.

sp-02915.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-02916.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 5 days.

sp-02917.description_en: Caster can remember an exact route he travelled; whether or not he was without one or more of his senses when he made his original journey (e.g., a 12th level caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip, even is he had been blindfolded). To be effective, this spell must be cast within one month per level of the journey.

sp-02918.description_en: As Waiting Awareness I, except for area of effect.

sp-02919.description_en: As Locate Landmark I, except for the range.

sp-02920.description_en: Allows caster to visualize and sense activity in a known area (100'R).

sp-02921.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-02922.description_en: The caster can communicate with any elemental force within range. The elemental force must be able to communicate with the caster (i.e., this spell does not confer communication abilities upon the force). Elemental forces include all magically created elementals, water spirits, forest spirits, etc.

sp-02923.description_en: The target of this spell is a small pool of water. The water must be calm (and remain calm for the duration of the spell). The caster may designate a topic and a vision will appear in the pool that relates to the topic. The vision takes 1-50 rounds.

sp-02924.description_en: As Locate Landmark I, except for the range.

sp-02925.description_en: As Nature's Eye I, except for the range and area of effect.

sp-02926.description_en: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 1 day/lvl.

sp-02927.description_en: As Nature's Eye I, except for the range and area of effect.

sp-02928.description_en: Allows caster to monitor an area of 100'R that he has both been to and become acquainted with (i.e., spent at least 1 day meditating in or 30 days living in).

sp-02930.description_en: Caster's skin takes on the coloration of the surrounding terrain. Adds +10 to +50 to all Stalking/Hiding manuevers. As caster moves, coloration changes to match the surrounding terrain. This spell does not affect gear or clothing.

sp-02931.description_en: Caster gains an increased sense of smell and hearing (subtle smells and higher sonic ranges included). Adds +50 to Perceptions with only these senses; +20 to Perceptions using these sense combined with others.

sp-02932.description_en: Caster can run at two times normal pace (i.e., Run pace) and expend exhaustion points as if only walking.

sp-02933.description_en: Increases caster's ability to manuever without his sight. When blinded or otherwise without sight, this spell adds +10 to +50 to manuever rolls in the dark. Note that this spell does not negate penalties for blindness; it simply decreases them.

sp-02934.description_en: Caster can safely hold his breath for the duration of this spell.

sp-02935.description_en: Caster can glide like a bird. The product of the caster's altitude and horizontal speed cannot exceed 100' per round. For example, a caster can glide along at a rate of 5' per round if he were 20' off the ground; or he could glide at the rate of 50' per round if he were 2' off the ground. Note that the total must equal 100' (i.e., the caster cannot choose to have a total less than or more than 100').

sp-02937.description_en: Caster's skin has the resilience of a large cat (effective AT of 3).

sp-02938.description_en: Caster gains the ferosity of a wild boar. He gains +20 to his melee OB, but cannot parry or use missiles for the duration of the spell.

sp-02939.description_en: Caster gains the ability to make claw attacks as a lion. He may attack using the Claw Attack Table (from Arms Law), with a maximum of Medium results. The caster must develop skill (i.e., an OB) with these claws (cost to develop is the same as Martial Arts Striking; stat modifiers are St/St/Ag).

sp-02940.description_en: Caster gains the vibratory sensitivity of an insect. He can sense vibrations in the ground (or other solid material) up to the area of effect. He will gain information indicating general movements and number of targets (±10%). Treat as a +25 to +100 bonus to Perception (depending on the type of activity).

sp-02941.description_en: II — As Deer Speed I, except the speed increase is three times (i.e., Sprint pace).

sp-02942.description_en: Caster's skin has the resilience of a bear (effective AT of 8).

sp-02943.description_en: Caster gains the ability to make grapple attacks as a bear. He may attack using the Grapple Attack Table (from Arms Law), with a maximum of Medium results.The caster must develop skill (i.e., an OB) with this attack (cost to develop is the same as Martial Arts Sweeps/Throws; stat modifiers are St/St/Ag).

sp-02944.description_en: As Glide I, except product must equal 300'.

sp-02945.description_en: Caster gains the ability to make bite attacks as a serpent. He may attack using the Bite Attack Table (from Arms Law), with a maximum of Medium results. The caster must develop skill (i.e., an OB) with this attack (cost to develop is the same as Martial Arts Strikingp; stat modifier are St/Ag/Ag).

sp-02946.description_en: Caster's skin has the resilience of a minor drake (effective AT of 12).

sp-02947.description_en: As Deer Speed I, except the speed increase is four times (i.e., Fast Sprint pace).

sp-02948.description_en: Caster gains the strength of an ox. He gains a +40 melee OB, but cannot parry or use missiles for the duration of the spell.

sp-02949.description_en: As Glide I, except product must be 500'.

sp-02950.description_en: As Deer Speed I, except speed increase is five time (i.e., Dash pace).

sp-02951.description_en: Caster's skin takes on the resilience of a lesser drake (effective AT of 20).

sp-02952.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal or plant for use with spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels.

sp-02953.description_en: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170˚F and natural cold down to 20˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100˚F to determine the effective temperature for the caster. For temperatures below 20˚F, add 50˚F to determine the effect temperature for the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks); as well as +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and ice attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and ice attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if the caster does not move. If the caster moves, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-02954.description_en: Allows caster to take on the physical coloration of any 1 organic object. The caster must be in contact with object when the spell is cast. In many situations this will give a +10 to +50 bonus (GM's discretion) to Hiding attempts (and perhaps to some Stalking attempts).

sp-02955.description_en: Allows caster to appear as any one type of plant that he has studied. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the plant (i.e., it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules—see Section 7.1.27 for more on illusions).

sp-02956.description_en: Caster can move silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more than 1' from his body.

sp-02957.description_en: Caster can breathe normally under water. This spell will not function with any liquid but water.

sp-02958.description_en: Allows caster to appear as any one type of animal that he has studied. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the animal (i.e., it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules—see Section 7.1.27 for more on illusions).

sp-02959.description_en: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between +25 and +75).

sp-02960.description_en: Any single attack made against the caster this round suffers a -50 modifier. The weapon or object striking the caster must be from an organic source (i.e., an animal) or at least a partially organic weapon (i.e., an arrow).

sp-02961.description_en: Allows caster to take the form of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to 200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the plant. See Section 7.1.11 for more on changing forms.

sp-02963.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's mental patterns will appear to be those of any animal he has studied. The caster cannot move while this spell is active.

sp-02964.description_en: As Shielding Organic I, except the penalty is -100.

sp-02965.description_en: Allows caster to take the form of any one animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to 200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the animal. See Section 7.1.11 for more on changing forms.

sp-02966.description_en: As Animal Thoughts, except caster can move (though he must maintain concentration).

sp-02969.description_en: As Shielding Organic I, except attack automatically misses.

sp-02970.description_en: As Animal Form II, except caster gains the phsyical attacks of the animal. Caster can vary his size from 5% of normal to 4000% normal.

sp-02971.description_en: As Plant Form II, except the caster can change his form to any other plant he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.

sp-02972.description_en: As Animal Form III, except the caster can change his form to any other animal he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.

sp-02973.description_en: As Plant Form III and Animal Form III in operation at the same time.

sp-02974.description_en: Each round during the duration of the spell, the caster can negate (i.e., cause to miss) one attack directed at him. The attacking weapon must be at least part organic and he must be able to see the attack.

sp-02975.description_en: Caster learns nature and history of any 1 plant.

sp-02976.description_en: Allows caster to increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the area of effect by 10 times.

sp-02977.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.

sp-02978.description_en: Heals damage to one plant that is less complex than a tree (especially severe damage may get a RR to avoid the effects of this spell, GM discretion).

sp-02979.description_en: As Speed Growth I, except growth rate is 100 times normal.

sp-02980.description_en: Caster can locate members of any 1 species of plant or he can find out what species are in the area of effect.

sp-02981.description_en: Allows caster to double the size of any 1 plant. The growth takes place over the course of 1 day.

sp-02982.description_en: Caster can control the automatic and/or mental processes of any 1 plant. The caster can also control the plant's movements, though this spell doesn't allow movement beyond normal allowances.

sp-02983.description_en: As Speed Growth I, except the area of effect is 100'R, and the range is 100'.

sp-02984.description_en: As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 3 times.

sp-02985.description_en: As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 3 plants.

sp-02986.description_en: As Plant Restore, except it can affect any plant (including trees).

sp-02987.description_en: As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 5 times.

sp-02988.description_en: As Speed Growth II, except the area of effect is 100'R and the range is 100'.

sp-02989.description_en: As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 5 plants.

sp-02990.description_en: Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to 10' x 10' x 5'. Anyone moving through the wall receives d10 dagger attacks (use a +50 dagger attack on the Dagger Attack Table from Arms Law, if available) per foot of wall moved through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.

sp-02991.description_en: This spell will put out any fires upon living materials that are in the area of effect.

sp-02992.description_en: As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 10 times.

sp-02993.description_en: As Plant Growth I, except affects all plants in the area of effect.

sp-02994.description_en: As Speed Growth I, except for the range and area of effect.

sp-02995.description_en: As Plant Control I, except caster can control all plants within the area of effect.

sp-02996.description_en: Caster can animate any 1 plant. The plant can then move slowly, carrying any root system it may possess along.

sp-02997.description_en: When this spell is cast, up to four ounces of clean, clear water is transformed into holy water. This spell takes one hour to cast. If the water is not placed into a clean receptical, its holy nature is ruined.

sp-02998.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell may take no aggressive/offensive action, and will only fight if attacked.

sp-02999.description_en: When this spell is cast, the first level spell that the caster begins to cast the next round will be “channeled” to another spell user of the Channeling realm. The “channeled” spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately (i.e., the receiving spell user is now treated as the caster of the spell). All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver of the spell or know exactly where he is (direction and distance, or specific location). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (though he need not know exactly what spell is coming). For example, if a Cleric was at a certain altar at midnight of a full moon ready to receive a spell; then another spell user who knew this could use Channels to send him a spell.

sp-03000.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell is stunned.

sp-03001.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a third level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03002.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell falls into a deep sleep. The first minute of this sleep is magical (and the target cannot be awakened in any normal fashion). After the first minute, the target may be awakened normally (though his deep sleep will prevent him from waking on his own until he has slept a full eight hours).

sp-03003.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a fifth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03004.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell is blinded for the duration of the spell.

sp-03005.description_en: As Channels I, except up to an eighth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03006.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's “soul” is torn from his body; it remains in whatever place “souls” go for the duration of the spell. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. Target is unconscious until soul is restored. Even subconscious activities (i.e., healing, etc.) suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-03007.description_en: All beings not of the caster's own “alignment” (religious persuasion) are affected. All targets failing their RRs by 40 or less are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure. All those failing by more than 40 are unconscious.

sp-03008.description_en: Target item (weighing no more than 10 pounds) will return to a designated location. This spell has two possible durations (determined at the time of casting). The caster may send (i.e., teleport) the target item to a designated location at the time of casting (with an instant duration), or the caster can designate that the target item return to the caster when the possessor of the item has completed a specific task (specified at the time of casting).

sp-03009.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a tenth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03010.description_en: Caster is returned to a predefined place this is (a type of teleportation). Caster must have lived in the place for at least 30 days (mediating for 16 houthis is rs each day) to define it as his “sanctuary.” A spell user may only have one such place defined at any one time.

sp-03011.description_en: As Item Returning, except object will stay at the designated location (set at time of casting) for up to 1 round per level. At the end of this time, the object will go back to where it “returned” from.

sp-03012.description_en: As Absolution, except “soul” can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-03013.description_en: For up to 1 round per level after he has used Sanctuary, the caster may cast this spell and be returned to within 20' of the point at which he used Sanctuary.

sp-03014.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a twentieth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03015.description_en: Opens a direct channel to the caster's deity; results depend on the deity's personality, motives, and powers. Any spell the deity can cast may be transmitted through the gate.

sp-03016.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest), the caster may cast this spell and the GM will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g., roll d100: correct on a 26-100, incorrect on 1-25).

sp-03017.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-03018.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell to work.

sp-03019.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 3 minutes into the future.

sp-03020.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead target through the eyes of the deceased. He also gets a view of the killer (if any). The caster must be within 10' of the corpse. Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to caster's level.

sp-03021.description_en: Caster can make contact with any 1 known target he his acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being. This spell is often used with a Channels spell (see Cleric Base List 2.4.1).

sp-03022.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 5 minutes into the future.

sp-03023.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-03024.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 10 minutes into the future.

sp-03025.description_en: Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a “yes” or a “no” answer to a question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day.

sp-03026.description_en: The target of this spell is a small pool of clear, clean water. The water must be calm (and remain calm for the duration of the spell). The caster may designate a topic and a vision will appear in the pool that relates to the topic. This vision normally takes 5-50 rounds.

sp-03027.description_en: As Channel Opening I, except for range.

sp-03028.description_en: As Magic Basin I, except up to two topics may be designated (5-50 rounds is required for each one).

sp-03029.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events sur rounding the death of any 1 dead target within 10 feet. Caster gets an understanding of the reason(s) the deceased died, exactly who the killer was (if any), and who was ultimately responsible (if anyone). Corpse may be of any age.

sp-03030.description_en: As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept.

sp-03031.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze into the future for a number of minutes equal to his level.

sp-03032.description_en: As Channel Opening I, except caster can open a channel to anyone he chooses, regardless of whether or not he is acquainted with the being The caster must specify the type of being he is seeking (e.g., a priest of a specific deity, a warrior with blue eyes, etc.).

sp-03033.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question.

sp-03034.description_en: Caster can preserve a “dead” body, preventing any further deterioration (i.e., stat deterioration) or damage from already existing wounds; the target will be in a coma; this spell will not prevent the target's soul from leaving the body.

sp-03035.description_en: Caster can prevent the soul of a “dead” body from leaving its body (thus preventing actual death and enabling the fallen being to be restored via simple bodily repairs). This spell must be cast before the soul leaves the body or Lifegiving will be necessary for recovery.

sp-03036.description_en: As Preservation I, except for the duration.

sp-03037.description_en: The target of this spell is any being who has suffered some amount of soul damage. The target will be healed of d10 ponts of lost temporary Constitution. See Section 7.2 for more information on soul damage.

sp-03038.description_en: As Lifekeeping I, except for the duration.

sp-03039.description_en: As Heal Life Essence I, except will heal 2d10 lost points.

sp-03040.description_en: As Preservation I, except for the duration.

sp-03041.description_en: As Heal Life Essence I, except will heal 3d10 lost points of temporary Constitution.

sp-03042.description_en: As Preservation I, except for duration.

sp-03043.description_en: As Lifekeeping I, except for the duration.

sp-03044.description_en: Caster can “raise” 1 dead being by restoring the being's lost soul. Target's soul must still exist and he must have died within the last year. To be successfully “raised”, the target must roll d100 (open-ended) and add his Constitution stat (not the stat bonus). A modification of -10 is applied to the result for every day the target has been dead (e.g., if the target has been dead for 3 days, 30 is subtracted from the roll). If the result is over 100, the target is “raised” successfully. If the result is less than 100, the target is not “raised” (and may not ever be raised by this caster). The target will be incapacitated (-100 to all activity) for a period of 100 days for each day dead (e.g., if the target was dead 2 days, the recovery period would be 200 days).

sp-03045.description_en: As Heal Life Essence I, except will heal one lost point of temporary Constitution per level of the caster.

sp-03046.description_en: As Preservation I, except for the duration.

sp-03047.description_en: As Lifegiving I, except a modification of -5 per day dead is applied to the target's roll and the recovery period is only 50 days per day dead.

sp-03048.description_en: As Lifekeeping I, except for duration.

sp-03049.description_en: As Lifekeeping I, except a modification of -2 per day dead is applied to the target's roll and the recovery period is only 20 days per day dead.

sp-03050.description_en: As Preservation I, except for the duration.

sp-03051.description_en: The target of this spell is any being that has had his mental capabilities hindered (e.g., from the Mind Erosion spell list). The target of this spell will recover lost experience. However, recovery is not always complete.
