The amount of experience that is not recovered is 1% for each day that the target suffered from the condition. For example, if a target lost 10,000 experience points and it took him 20 days to find a Cleric with this spell, he would only recover 8,000 of the lost experience points.

sp-03052.description_en: As Lifegiving I, except a modification of -1 per day dead is applied to the target's roll and the recovery period is equal to the number of days dead.

sp-03053.description_en: As Lifegiving I, except a modification of -1 for every two days dead is applied to the target's roll and there is no recovery period.

sp-03054.description_en: As Restoration, except that target's mind is fully restored (including experience).

sp-03055.description_en: As Lifegiving, except the target is automatically raised from the dead and there is no recovery period.

sp-03056.description_en: Target gets a 5 bonus to his RRs and maneuver rolls. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If caster is the target, the duration is 1 minute per level.

sp-03057.description_en: Target gets a 5 bonus to his DB and maneuver rolls. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a nonmobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If caster is the target, the duration is 1 minute per level.

sp-03058.description_en: Target gets a 5 bonus to his RRs and DB. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a nonmobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If caster is the target, the duration is 1 minute per level.

sp-03059.description_en: Target is protected from natural heat up to 170˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a nonmobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-03060.description_en: Target is protected from natural cold down to 20˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures below 20˚F, add 50˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and ice attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a nonmobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-03061.description_en: All who are within the sphere are allowed benefits of either a Heat Resistance or a Cold Resistance spell (must be the same for all targets). The sphere is not mobile. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-03062.description_en: All within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer I or Bless I or Resistance I spell (must be the same for all targets). The sphere is not mobile. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-03063.description_en: As Prayer I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3 targets. One target would get a +15 bonus; three targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03064.description_en: As Bless I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3 targets. One target would get a +15 bonus; three targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03065.description_en: As Resistance I, except total bonus is 15 and bonus may be spread over 1-3 targets. One target would get a +15 bonus; three targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03066.description_en: As Temperature Sphere I, except radius is 20'.

sp-03067.description_en: As Protections Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer III or Bless III or Resistance III spell (must be the same for all targets).

sp-03068.description_en: As Prayer I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5 targets. One target would get a +25 bonus; five targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03069.description_en: As Bless I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5 targets. One target would get a +25 bonus; five targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03070.description_en: As Resistance I, except total bonus is 25 and bonus may be spread over 1-5 targets. One target would get a +25 bonus; five targets would get +5 each; etc.

sp-03071.description_en: As Protections Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer V or Bless V or Resistance V spell (must be the same for all targets).

sp-03072.description_en: Target gets a +30 bonus to his RRs, maneuver rolls, and DB and 30 is subtracted from all elemental attacks against him.

sp-03073.description_en: Causes up to 5 Undead to flee or disintegrate. All Undead have a class assigned to them. This spell will affect up to 5 points of Undead (Class I Undead count as 1 point, Class II Undead count as 2 points, etc.). Animated Dead (see the Evil Channeling List, Necromancy) are treated as Class I Undead and are not entitled to an RR (i.e., they automatically disintegrate if the spell does not fail). Creatures & Monsters provides complete descriptions of the different types of Undead. Each target is entitled to an RR. If the target fails the RR by 50 or less, it will flee (if the target cannot flee, it will remain motionless). If the target fails by more than 50, it disintegrates. One Base Attack Roll is applied to all targets. For the purposes of RRs, if no class is given for an Undead, use the following table to determine its class. Level Class 1-2 I 3-5 II 6-8

sp-03074.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR (before the caster of this spell makes a RR). For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell's RR is successful, it may target the caster normally; otherwise, the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-03075.description_en: Cancels a Channels I spell being transmitted or received within the range. Note that the Channels I spell gets no RR.

sp-03077.description_en: As Anti-Channels I, except affects up to a Channels III.

sp-03078.description_en: As Repel Undead V, except 9 points of Undead may be affected.

sp-03079.description_en: Dispels a curse if the curse fails an RR. The curse's level is the level of the caster of the original curse. If the curse is not dispelled, the caster cannot try again until he has gone up another level of experience.

sp-03080.description_en: Any active spell from the realm of Channeling that is on the target must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as the spell's level). If the spell fails it RR, it is dispelled.

sp-03082.description_en: As Anti Channels I, except affects up to a Channels V.

sp-03083.description_en: As Repel Undead V, except 12 points of Undead may be affected.

sp-03085.description_en: As Dispel Channeling I, except affects up to five targets.

sp-03086.description_en: As Anti Channels I, except affects up to a Channels X.

sp-03087.description_en: As Repel Undead V, except 15 points of Undead may be affected.

sp-03089.description_en: As Dispel Channeling I, except affects up to ten targets.

sp-03090.description_en: As Repel Undead V, except this spell automatically disintegrates any one Undead of Class V or lower. A Class VI Undead is automatically sent fleeing.

sp-03091.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] As Remove Curse, except for the RR modification.

sp-03092.description_en: As Anti-Channels except any Channels spell can be canceled. Spells channeled with the aid of a Holy Bridge (see Cleric Base list, Channels) are not affected.

sp-03093.description_en: Caster can intercept one channeled spell that is being transmitted or received within his range and cast that spell himself. The person sending the channeled spell gets a RR (the attack level of this spell versus his level—not the level of the spell being intercepted).

sp-03106.description_en: As Demonic Gate I, except a Type II Demon is summoned.

sp-03107.description_en: As Summons X, except it can be delayed for up to 1 day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): specified movements, specified sounds, touch, or specified actions.

sp-03108.description_en: As Demonic Gate I, except a Type III Demon can be summoned.

sp-03109.description_en: As Summons II, except a number of options equal to the caster's level are chosen.

sp-03110.description_en: As Summons I, except for the duration and the level of the creature is random.

sp-03111.description_en: Caster can pull any being through a “gate” to the caster's location. If the being is intelligent, he must be willing to come. An intelligent being will get a feeling of the general “alignment” of the caster and a vague idea of the reason and significance for the “gate.”

sp-03094.description_en: Caster magically summons a 1st-level, nonintelligent creature from the surrounding area. The caster can specify the type of creature, but the GM should determine the type of creature that answers the summons. If the creature can understand the caster (e.g., Animal Tongues), the creature can be controlled through normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained only through concentration of the caster. If the creature summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in its own perception), the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level.

sp-03095.description_en: As Summons I, except caster chooses one of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-03096.description_en: As Summons II, except 2 options are chosen.

sp-03097.description_en: As Summons II, except 3 options are chosen.

sp-03098.description_en: As Summons II, except 4 options are chosen.

sp-03099.description_en: As Summons II, except 5 options are chosen.

sp-03100.description_en: As Summons II, except 6 options are chosen.

sp-03101.description_en: As Summons II, except 7 options are chosen.

sp-03102.description_en: As Summons II, except 9 options are chosen.

sp-03103.description_en: Caster summons a Type I Demon that appears over the course of 2 rounds. The caster can only control it by concentrating. After the caster stops concentrating, the demon will fade out over the course of 2 rounds. However, during this two rounds, it will attack the closest being.

sp-03104.description_en: As Summons II, except 14 options are chosen.

sp-03105.description_en: As Summons II, except 19 options are chosen.

sp-04469.description_en: I — Detects the total number of “enemies” (giving approximate direction and distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily represented type of enemy (by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a different 50'R each round.

sp-04470.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-04471.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.

sp-04472.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.

sp-04474.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can read and speak one “enemy” language with skill rank 8.

sp-04478.description_en: As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.

sp-04480.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead target through the eyes of the deceased. He also gets a view of the killer (if any). The caster must be within 10' of the corpse. Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to caster's level.

sp-04481.description_en: Caster can make contact with any 1 known target he his acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being. This spell is often used with a Channels spell (see Cleric Base List 2.4.1).

sp-04483.description_en: As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.

sp-04485.description_en: Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a “yes” or a “no” answer to a question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day.

sp-04486.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead target within 10 feet. Caster gets an understanding of the reason(s) the deceased died, exactly who the killer was (if any), and who was ultimately responsible (if anyone). Corpse may be of any age.

sp-04487.description_en: As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.

sp-04488.description_en: As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept.

sp-04489.description_en: As Channel Opening I, except caster can open a channel to anyone he chooses, regardless of whether or not he is acquainted with the being The caster must specify the type of being he is seeking (e.g., a priest of a specific deity, a warrior with blue eyes, etc.).

sp-04490.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question.

sp-04491.description_en: Causes Undead to flee or disintegrate. All Undead have a class assigned to them. This spell will affect 1 point of Undead (Class I Undead count as 1 point, Class II Undead count as 2 points, etc.). Animated Dead (see the Evil Channeling List, Necromancy) are treated as Class I Undead and are not entitled to an RR (i.e., they automatically disintegrate if the spell does not fail). Creatures & Monsters provides complete descriptions of the different types of Undead. Each target is entitled to an RR. If the target fails the RR by 50 or less, it will flee (if the target cannot flee, it will remain motionless). If the target fails by more than 50, it disintegrates. One Base Attack Roll is applied to all targets. For the purposes of RRs, if no class is given for an Undead, use the following table to determine its class.

sp-04492.description_en: Detects the presence of Undead in the area of affect. Caster can move the area of effect 5' each round.

sp-04493.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except affects 3 points of Undead.

sp-04494.description_en: For as long as the caster concentrates, Type I Demons that are in the area of effect may not leave, and Type I Demons that are outside the area of effect may not enter.

sp-04495.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except affects 5 points of Undead.

sp-04496.description_en: As Repel Demon I, except affects up to Type II Demons.

sp-04497.description_en: Banishes the target Type I Demon from this plane of existance for the duration of the spell.

sp-04499.description_en: I — As Repel Demon I, except affects up to Type III Demons.

sp-04500.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except affects 10 points of Undead.

sp-04501.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except affects up to a Type II Demon.

sp-04502.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except affects 12 points of Undead.

sp-04503.description_en: As Repel Demon I, except affects up to Type IV Demons.

sp-04505.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except affects 15 points of Undead.

sp-04506.description_en: As Repel Demon I, except affects up to Type V Demons.

sp-04507.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except affects up to a Type III Demon.

sp-04509.description_en: As Repel Demon I, except affects up to Type VI Demons.

sp-04510.description_en: As Repel Undead I, except one Undead of type V or less is disintegrated. Type VI Undead are sent fleeing.

sp-04511.description_en: As Repel Demon VI, except for area of effect.

sp-04512.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] Dispels a curse if the curse fails an RR. The curse's level is the level of the caster of the original curse. If the curse is not dispelled, the caster cannot try again until he has gone up another level of experience.

sp-04513.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except affects up to a Type IV Demon.

sp-04514.description_en: Adds +15 to the caster's melee or missile attack for the current round.

sp-04515.description_en: After casting this spell, there is a chance that the caster's next attack (melee or missile) will be treated as “Magic” for the purposes of resolving criticals (usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures). The chance is equal to 10% plus 5% for each round that the caster concentrates (i.e., prays) immediately prior to preparing and casting this spell. The attack affected by this spell must occur within 1 minute per level after this spell was cast.

sp-04516.description_en: Caster gains a +5 to his strength stat bonus for the purposes of o n e manuever. In combat, this results in a +10 to melee attacks and +5 to missile attacks.

sp-04517.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +20.

sp-04518.description_en: As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Mithril.”

sp-04519.description_en: As Righteous Blow I, except the criti cal is treated as “Holy” and the chance is equal to 20% plus 2% for every extra Power Point used to cast this spell. A maximum number of PPs equal to the caster's level may be used to cast this spell. For example, a 6th level Paladin has a maximum chance of 20%; a 10th level Paladin could attain a 28% chance (by investing 10 PPs in the casting of the spell).

sp-04520.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +25.

sp-04521.description_en: As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Holy.”

sp-04522.description_en: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive an 'A' severity critical (type to be determined by the GM; based upon the nature of the creature).

sp-04523.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +30.

sp-04524.description_en: As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Slaying” (creature type must be chosen when spell

sp-04525.description_en: As Holy Strength I, except strength stat bonus is +10 for a manuever (+20 to melee attacks; +10 to missile attacks).

sp-04526.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +35.

sp-04527.description_en: As Holy Aura I, except delivers a 'B' critical.

sp-04528.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +40.

sp-04529.description_en: III — As Holy Strength I, except strength stat bonus is +15 for a manuever (+30 to melee attacks; +15 to missile attacks).

sp-04530.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +45.

sp-04531.description_en: As Holy Aura I, except delivers a 'C' critical.

sp-04532.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +50.

sp-04533.description_en: As Holy Focus, except attack is automatically Holy.

sp-04534.description_en: The caster exposes all within the area of effect to the raw power of his deity. All in the area of effect suffer a +100 Fireball attack (centered on the caster). All concussion damage is doubled and an extra Slaying Critical (on the Large Creature Critical Strike Table) is delivered. The caster acts as the center-point for the blast and is not immune to any of the damage. For the caster, no objects, spells, etc. will protect him from the blast.

sp-04535.description_en: Target is healed of d10 concussion hits.

sp-04536.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round. Target may not be moved, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-04537.description_en: Target is healed of one area of mild frostbite or first degree burn.

sp-04538.description_en: Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is one day.

sp-04539.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 3d10 concussion hits.

sp-04540.description_en: I — Target is relieved of one round's worth of accumulated stun. See Section 7.1.1 for more information.

sp-04541.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can also repair compound fractures. Recovery time is one day.

sp-04542.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target gets an additional RR versus any disease(s).

sp-04543.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target gets an additional RR versus any poison(s).

sp-04544.description_en: Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that bleeds at up to 2 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).

sp-04545.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 5d10 concussion hits.

sp-04546.description_en: I — Allows caster to repair (not replace) one damaged muscle or tendon. Recovery time is 1 hour.

sp-04547.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe damage (e.g., third degree burns) or a combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area of damage.

sp-04549.description_en: Caster can cure any one paralyis problem.

sp-04550.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 10d10 concussion hits.

sp-04551.description_en: As Frost Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 4 mild or 2 moderate or 1 mild and 1 severe or 2 mild and 1 moderate areas of damage.

sp-04552.description_en: Caster can remove any one disease from the target.

sp-04553.description_en: Caster can remove any one poison from the target.

sp-04554.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except relieves all rounds of stun.

sp-04555.description_en: As Healing I, except heals 15d10 concussion hits.

sp-04556.description_en: As Healing I, except heals all concussion damage.

sp-04557.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-04558.description_en: Everyone in the area of effect who is aligned with the caster (GM's discretion) subtracts 5 from all elemental attacks against them. They may also add 5 to all RRs versus spells. These bonuses are not conferred to the caster.

sp-04559.description_en: Creates a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks against him.

sp-04560.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” shield.

sp-04561.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This aubtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-04562.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-04563.description_en: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 10.

sp-04564.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10' of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This cause 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-04565.description_en: As Aura, except it makes the caster appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from all attacks against him.

sp-04566.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-04567.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 50% can be sustained.

sp-04568.description_en: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 15.

sp-04569.description_en: As Deflections I, except will deflect up to two missiles.

sp-04570.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes the missile to automatically miss.

sp-04571.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 2 attacks.

sp-04572.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 75% can be sustained.

sp-04573.description_en: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 20.

sp-04574.description_en: As Deflections I, except will deflect up to three missiles.

sp-04575.description_en: I — As Aim Untrue I, except affects up to three missiles.

sp-04576.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 3 attacks.

sp-04577.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 100% can be sustained.

sp-04578.description_en: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 25.

sp-04579.description_en: As Deflections I, except will deflect one missile per level of the caster.

sp-04580.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-04581.description_en: For the duration of this spell, all within the area of effect (including the caster) may make a second RR versus any fear or panic effect. This second RR is made with an additional +10 modifier.

sp-04582.description_en: Caster inspires all allies who are within the area of effect (they must be aware of the caster). All allies gain +5 to melee attacks and moving manuevers for the duration of the spell. This spell will only work during combat or highly religious moments (e.g., an oratory presentation prior to a large battle). These bonuses do not apply to the caster.

sp-04583.description_en: For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target's best interest.

sp-04584.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +10.

sp-04586.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +15.

sp-04587.description_en: For as long as the caster speaks, the target will become more cautious (less rash) and will tend to obey the caster's warnings without hesitation or doubt.

sp-04588.description_en: Target must obey the caster. However, he will not perform any act that is completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-04589.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +20.

sp-04590.description_en: As Voice of Friendship, except will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-04591.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +25.

sp-04592.description_en: As Command I, except affects two targets.

sp-04593.description_en: As Voice of Reason, except will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-04594.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +30.

sp-04595.description_en: As Courage, except the second RR automatically succeeds.

sp-04597.description_en: s — As Voice of Caution, except will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-04598.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +40.

sp-04599.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he knows it). All targets who fail their RR will believe the caster is speaking the absolute truth.

sp-04600.description_en: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +50.

sp-04601.description_en: As Voice of Conviction, except will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-04602.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell from this list once per round.

sp-04603.description_en: Target is protected from natural heat up to 170˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a nonmobile target that is subsequently moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-04604.description_en: Target is protected from natural cold down to 20˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures below 20˚F, add 50˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and ice attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a nonmobile target that is subsequently moved, the spell is dispelled.

sp-04605.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to his RRs and DB.

sp-04606.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to his manuever rolls and DB.

sp-04607.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to his RRs and manuever rolls

sp-04609.description_en: As Resistance I, except bonus is +10.

sp-04610.description_en: As Bless I , except bonus is +10.

sp-04611.description_en: As Prayer I , except bonus is +10.

sp-04612.description_en: Caster is protected from any natural heat and natural cold down (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). Caster also receives +40 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+40 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks); as well as +40 to all RRs versus cold spells and ice attacks (+40 DB versus elemental cold and ice attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if the caster does not move. If the caster moves, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-04613.description_en: As Resistance I, except bonus is +15.

sp-04614.description_en: As Bless I, except bonus is +15.

sp-04615.description_en: As Prayer II, except bonus is +15.

sp-04616.description_en: As Resistance I, except bonus is +20.

sp-04617.description_en: As Bless I, except bonus is +20.

sp-04618.description_en: As Prayer II, except bonus is +20.

sp-04619.description_en: Allows target to attempt to throw off any 1 disease by making another RR with a special +50 modification. This spell may only be cast once per target per disease until the caster gains another level See Section 7.1.4).

sp-04620.description_en: An RR is make for the curse (the caster's level is the attack level, the original attack level of the curse is the target level). If the RR fails, the curse is removed. This spell may only be cast once per target per curse until the caster gains another level (See Section 7.1.4).

sp-04621.description_en: Allows target to attempt to throw off the effects of any poison by making a RR with a special +50 modification. This spell may only be cast once per target per poison until the caster gains another level (See Section 7.1.4).

sp-04622.description_en: Caster gets +25 to his DB, RRs, and maneuver rolls.

sp-04623.description_en: Caster can run on any nearly horizontal rocky and earthen surfaces as if he was on level ground. He will expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-04624.description_en: Allows caster to walk along tree limbs as if he were on level ground.

sp-04625.description_en: Target can swim without expending energy (i.e., will expend no exhaustion points).

sp-04626.description_en: Caster can walk on water as if he were on level dry ground. This may not be used on rough water.

sp-04627.description_en: Caster can run on sandy surfaces as if he was on level ground. He will expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-04628.description_en: As Limbwalking, except caster can move at two times normal pace (i.e., Run pace). He will expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-04629.description_en: Caster can walk without leaving tracks or other visible signs of his passing.

sp-04630.description_en: Caster can hide the tracks of any 1 being. This spell and Traceless Passing can be used simultaneously and caster will still maintain 50% activity (i.e., he can concentrate on both spells at the same time).

sp-04631.description_en: As Waterwalking, except caster can move at two times normal pace (i.e., Run pace). He will expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-04632.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 2 beings' tracks.

sp-04633.description_en: As Swimming, except target can swim as fast as he could run. He will expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-04634.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 5 beings' tracks.

sp-04635.description_en: As any of the Running spells above, except any one of the spells can be used each round (e.g., the caster could run on sand, then on water, then on limbs, etc.).

sp-04636.description_en: As Traceless Passing, except caster need not concentrate.

sp-04637.description_en: Caster can merge into organic material (live or dead). While merged, the caster cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster cannot move “through” material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet.

sp-04638.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides10 beings' tracks.

sp-04639.description_en: As Traceless Passing, except caster can move at two times normal pace (i.e., at a Run pace).

sp-04640.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 15 beings' tracks.

sp-04641.description_en: As Traceless Passing True, except caster can move at two times normal pace (i.e., Run pace).

sp-04642.description_en: As Merging Organic, except caster may turn within material and perceive the world outside the material.

sp-04643.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 20 beings' tracks.

sp-04644.description_en: As Great Merging Organic, except caster may use spells on himself while merged.

sp-04645.description_en: As Hide Tracks I, except caster can either absolutely hide his own tracks (preventing discovery via any method, including magic) or he can hide the tracks of a number of beings equal to his level.

sp-04646.description_en: Allows caster to take on the physical coloration of any 1 organic object. The caster must be in contact with object when the spell is cast. In many situations this will give a +10 to +50 bonus (GM's discretion) to Hiding attempts (and perhaps to some Stalking attempts).

sp-04647.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect deepen. All Hiding manuevers gain a bonus of +25 (+10 to all Stalking manuevers).

sp-04649.description_en: Caster can move silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more than 1' from his body. In many situations, this will give a +10 to +50 bonus (GM discretion) to Stalking and/or Hiding attempts.

sp-04650.description_en: Caster blends into surrounding terrain. This results in a +75 bonus to Hiding attempts. Caster may not move (appreciably) without loosing this bonus.

sp-04651.description_en: Lights a 10'R area surrounding point touched.

sp-04653.description_en: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between +25 and +75).

sp-04654.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal or plant for use with spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels.

sp-04655.description_en: Allows caster to appear as any one type of plant that he has studied. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the plant (i.e., it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules).

sp-04656.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's mental patterns will appear to be those of any animal he has studied. The caster cannot move while this spell is active.

sp-04657.description_en: As Study Form, except a specific animal or plant form may be studied. For example, the woodsman's dog (as opposed to just a dog) may be studied.

sp-04658.description_en: Allows caster to appear as any one type of animal that he has studied. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the animal (i.e., it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules).

sp-04659.description_en: As Animal Thoughts, except caster can move (though he must maintain concentration).

sp-04660.description_en: Allows caster to take the form of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to 200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the plant.

sp-04661.description_en: Allows caster to take the form of any one animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to 200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the animal.

sp-04662.description_en: As Plant Form I, except caster may also assume the scent and physical abilities of the plant. Caster can vary his size from 50% of normal to 400% of normal.

sp-04663.description_en: As Animal Form I, except caster gains the movement abilities of the chosen animal. Caster can vary his size from 50% of normal to 400% of normal.

sp-04664.description_en: As Plant Form II, except the caster can change his form to any other plant he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.

sp-04665.description_en: As Animal Form III, except the caster can change his form to any other animal he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.

sp-04674.description_en: The caster can use any lower level spells on this list, except that one animal per level will be summoned. For example, a 10th level Ranger could summon 10 guardians. All of the animals will serve only the caster.

sp-04675.description_en: This spell produces ground covering of grasses and small plants of other varieties. The plants must already exist in the area of effect. This spell simply allows them to multiply and grow faster (coverage takes 20+d100 hours).

sp-04676.description_en: Caster prayers to his deity for fog. The chance that the prayer is answered is 2% per level of the caster. See note #6 below.

sp-04677.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except generates a light rain.

sp-04678.description_en: As Spread Plants I, except will also spread saplings and small trees.

sp-04679.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except will generate a heavy thunderstorm.

sp-04680.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except generates a hail storm.

sp-04681.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except will generate a lightning storm.

sp-04682.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except will generate weather that results in a tornado.

sp-04683.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except will ensure clear weather.

sp-04684.description_en: As Fog Prayer, except caster's deity will grant whatever weather would be most beneficial to the caster's current goal.

sp-04685.description_en: As any of the Prayer spells on this list, except chance of getting the effect is 95%.

sp-04666.description_en: An animal will arrive bearing some form of nourishment for the caster. This may take the form of berries, nuts, or tubers (always some form of vegetable matter). The animal will drop the food and return to the wilderness.

sp-04667.description_en: A heavily-furred animal will arrive and lie down near the caster. The animal will allow the caster (and only the caster) to lie down next to it.

sp-04668.description_en: An animal who knows the path to a specific location will arrive to guide the caster to that location. The animal will only guide the caster as long as he concentrates on the desired location.

sp-04669.description_en: A suitable large animal will arrive. This animal will attempt to protect the caster from hostile attacks for the duration of the spell. The animal will be one that is capable of inflicting at least Medium animal attacks. The animal will only protect the caster as long as the caster remains in the same general area that the spell was cast (i.e., if the caster leaves the area, the animal will not travel with him).

sp-04670.description_en: A large animal will arrive and serve as a mount for the caster.

sp-04671.description_en: An animal will arrive bearing a recently killed prey for the caster (some form of meat). The animal will drop the food close by and then return to the wilderness.

sp-04672.description_en: An animal with a specified heightened sense will arrive. For the duration of the spell, the animal will “perceive” for the caster. The caster can concentrate to have the animal communicate what he has been perceiving.

sp-04673.description_en: A “group” of animals will arrive and stay near the area where the spell was cast. For the purposes of this spell, the animals summoned must normally travel in groups (e.g., wolves, deer, birds, etc.).

sp-04686.description_en: Caster has a 75% chance of detecting a trap in the area of effect. The caster can concentrate on a different area each round. There must be living plants or animals in the area of effect or no information will be gained.

sp-04687.description_en: Caster can locate any natural source of running water, exposed groundwater, etc. exceeding 1 gallon. He will learn the approximate size and quality of source.

sp-04688.description_en: I — Allows caster to set a fire of 1'R. Fire will burn as long as there is fuel. A target in the 1'R will take an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-04689.description_en: Caster learns location, type, and approximate quantity of edible food (e.g., dead animal matter, plants, etc.). The food source must exceed 1 pound.

sp-04690.description_en: Allows caster to purify a number of gallons of water equal to his level.

sp-04691.description_en: Caster learns location, type, and approximate size of any waterproof, covered space exceeding 125 cubic feet. The shelter must have an entry (exceeding 2'R) opening onto open air.

sp-04692.description_en: This spell creates a minor, normal trap (constructed magically). The trap can deliver up to a 'B' critical strike (must be either a Slash, a Krush, or a Puncture; specified by the caster at the time of casting) to any one target. The size of the trap can vary from 1'R to 10'R. The time to construct the trap is 1 round per 1'R.

sp-04693.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting time, type, and severity of weather over next 24 hour period.

sp-04694.description_en: Caster can mointor animate activity in the area (e.g., he will be aware of sublte movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot move.

sp-04695.description_en: As Water Finding I, except range is 10 miles.

sp-04696.description_en: Allows caster to set up a natural “alarm system” in the area of effect. Any disturbing activity will cause caster to be alerted.

sp-04697.description_en: As Food Finding I, except range is 10 miles.

sp-04698.description_en: As Lesser Traps, except trap can deliver an 'E' critical hit.

sp-04699.description_en: As Shelter Finding I, except range is 10 miles.

sp-04700.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-04701.description_en: Finds the closet water source (as defined in Water Finding I). This spell gives only direction and distance; no information about the size and quality of the water source is gained.

sp-04702.description_en: Finds the closest source of food (as defined in Food Finding I) This spell gives only direction and distance; no information about the quantity or quality of the food source is gained.

sp-04703.description_en: Find the closet shelter (as defined in Shelter Finding I). This spell gives only direction and distance; no information about the size or type of shelter is gained.

sp-04704.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-04706.description_en: As Waiting Awareness II, except that the radius is 50'.

sp-04707.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for the area of effect.

sp-04708.description_en: Caster learns origin and nearest “destination” of any path within the area of effect.

sp-04709.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight.

sp-04710.description_en: Caster gets a +50 bonus for all Tracking attempts.

sp-04711.description_en: Caster acquires visual image of any user(s) of a given path, up to 1 hour in the past per level of the caster.

sp-04712.description_en: Caster learns the location(s) of any path(s) within 1 mile. This spell reveals the nearest point on path, but not the path's course.

sp-04713.description_en: Caster learns origin of tracks, and acquires a visual image of the one who left them. Caster will gain a +25 bonus when tracking this particular being or animal.

sp-04714.description_en: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being's hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).

sp-04715.description_en: Caster acquires visual and aural (sound) image of any being or animal that has passed within a 50'R of a specific object. The being or animal can have passed up to 1 hour per level earlier. If more than one being or animal has passed, the caster will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest image).

sp-04716.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 5 miles.

sp-04717.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.

sp-04718.description_en: Caster acquires a visual image of all beings or animals who left tracks in the area. This provides a +50 bonus when later tracking that particular being or animal. If more than one being or animal has left tracks, the caster will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest image).

sp-04719.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.

sp-04720.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except for range.

sp-04721.description_en: As Detect Ambush I, except area of effect is 100'R.

sp-04722.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 “stone.”

sp-04723.description_en: As Tracking I, except bonus is +75.

sp-04724.description_en: As Detect Ambush I, except area of effect is 150'R.

sp-04725.description_en: As Pathfinding I, except range is 1 mile per level and exact route(s) within the range are ascertained.

sp-04726.description_en: As Detect Ambush, except area of effect is 10'R/lvl.

sp-04727.description_en: Allows caster to ascertain the proper path to what he seeks (includes the course along that path). For example, he will always know the best way to Syclax.

sp-04728.description_en: As Tracking, except that it will negate any Hide Tracks spell (except for Hide Tracks True), and will always give tracker a special +100 Tracking bonus.

sp-04729.description_en: Allows caster to know entire course of the tracks in the area of effect (i.e., exactly where and how they go). This will not negate Hide Tracks True.

sp-03112.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round. For 1 hour, the caster may not be moved or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-03113.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding from one wound that is bleeding at a rate of 1 hit per round.

sp-03114.description_en: Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that bleeds at up to 3 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).

sp-03115.description_en: As Clotting I, except caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is bleeding up to 5 hits per round.

sp-03116.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) for up to 3 hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hits per round wound or one 2 hits per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be healed.

sp-03117.description_en: Allows caster to repair 1 damaged blood vessel of any size, including severed veins and arteries. Recovery time is 1-10 days (depending on severity of wound).

sp-03118.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Bone Ways, Muscle Ways, and Organ Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.

sp-03119.description_en: As Clotting V, except caster can stop a bleeding in a wound that is bleeding a number of hits per round equal to his level. For example, a 9th lvl Healer could stop the bleeding in a wound that is bleeding 9 hits per round.

sp-03120.description_en: As Cut Repair III, except that caster can stop a number of hits per round equal to his level. For example, a 12th level Healer could stop bleeding wounds that were bleeding a total of 12 hits per round.

sp-03121.description_en: Allows caster to remove any one blood clot. This will counter Clotting Curse (on the Evil Cleric list, Curses). This spell has no effect on bleeding wounds that have clotted (i.e., “clots” in this sense apply only to internal blood clotting).

sp-03122.description_en: As Major Vessel Repair I, except caster can repair up to 3 veins and/or arteries.

sp-03123.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03124.description_en: As Major Vessel Repair I, except caster can repair up to 5 veins and/or arteries.

sp-03125.description_en: As Unclotting, except all blood clots are removed.

sp-03126.description_en: Caster can regulate his own blood flow and completely eliminate any blood loss without fear of harm. The duration of this spell is for as long as the caster is immobile. If the caster moves, the spell ends. For example, a Healer is bleeding for twenty-seven hits per round lies down and casts this spell. As long as he doesn't move, he will not bleed and he may still cast other spells from this list (i.e., Cut Repair, etc.).

sp-03127.description_en: Caster can restore all of the blood lost from his body. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03128.description_en: Caster can eliminate any blood disease from his body. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03129.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower spells on this list once per round.

sp-03130.description_en: Allows caster to mend on simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03131.description_en: Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time is 1-2 hours.

sp-03132.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except that caster can also repair compound fractures.

sp-03133.description_en: Allows caster to mend one fracture in his skull (but not a shattered area). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03134.description_en: Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered) joint. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03135.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03136.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Blood Ways, Muscle Ways, and Organ Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.

sp-03137.description_en: As Cartilage Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03138.description_en: As Major Fracture Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03139.description_en: As Skull Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03140.description_en: As Joint Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03141.description_en: Allows caster to repair any broken or shattered bone. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03142.description_en: Caster can regenerate any one area of cartilage. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03143.description_en: Caster can regenerate any one bone. Recovery time is 1-10 hours. This spell will not work on the skull.

sp-03144.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03145.description_en: As Shatter Repair, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03147.description_en: As Bone Regeneration, except will only work on the skull.

sp-03148.description_en: As Bone Regeneration, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03149.description_en: As Shatter Repair, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03150.description_en: As Cartilage Regeneration, except that caster can regenerate all of the lost cartilage in his body. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03151.description_en: As Bone Regeneration, except that caster can regenerate all of the lost bones in his body (including his skull). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03152.description_en: Caster can regenerate all of the lost bone and/or cartilage in his body. Recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03153.description_en: Caster transfers one injury or addiction from the target to himself. The power point cost for this spell is equal to the cost of the healing spell necessary to heal the injury. This transfer spell must be cast multiple times for multiple injuries. If a single wound would take more than one healing spell to cure, this spell must be cast multiple times for the entire wound to be healed (though the Healer may choose to not transfer all the wounds). Note that the Healer does not have to know the spell needed to heal the wound before he can transfer the wound. In the case of concussion hits, the caster must decide how many hits he wants to heal and then transfer according to the healing spell that could heal that many points with one spell. To transfer a severed limb, the caster must know all 4 Joining spells and he must spend 28 PPs (7 for each Joining spell). However, the caster may choose to only spend 7 PPs and leave the target with a stub (i.e., only casting the Joining spell from Blood Ways). For example, Rana the Healer is 10th level and has 75 power points (PPs). Ringlin the Fighter has just suffered: a severed hand, a damaged arm (two severed muscles, and a minor fracture), 80 concussion hits of damage, a gash that is bleeding 5 hits per round, and a serious skull fracture. Rana must cast 8 Transfers: one for the severed muscles (4 PPs for Muscle Repair III), four for the severed hand (28 PPs for all the Joining spells), one for the minor fracture (1 PP for Minor Fracture Repair), one for the bleeding wound (4 PPs for Clotting V), and one for the concussion damage (12 PPs for Heal X). Total PP expenditure would be 49. Ringlin would be completely unwounded and Rana must go about healing herself. Note that Rana could have chosen to not transfer the severed hand (if she did, her own hand would fall off). In this case, if she transferred enough for 1 Joining spell (from Blood Ways), Ringlin would have a stub and a spare hand (perhaps to be joined later—if the hand can be preserved); and Rana would have 21 more PPs.

sp-03154.description_en: Stops infection and/or spread of a disease after the disease is acquired. No further damage will occur in the uninfected areas of the body.

sp-03155.description_en: Neutralizes any 1 poison in the caster's system. Note: Damage already sustained is not cured.

sp-03156.description_en: Caster's “dead” body is preserved for the duration of the spell. This prevents any further deterioration (i.e., stat deterioration) or damage from already existing wounds. The caster will be in a coma and healing spells will continue to work (as they are all subconscious). This spell will not prevent the caster's soul from leaving his body (i.e., he must be healed to above the “death” threshold in a short amount of time or his soul will leave his body). If the soul leaves the body before the body is healed, only Lifegiving can return the soul.

sp-03157.description_en: The caster must only check for withdrawal from a specific addiction once every two weeks (instead of once per week).

sp-03158.description_en: The caster has one addiction level lowered by one. See Gamemaster Law for more on addiction and withdrawal.

sp-03159.description_en: As Ease Addiction I, except the target must only check once per month.

sp-03162.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by three.

sp-03163.description_en: As Transfer, except for target can be up to 1' per level away.

sp-03164.description_en: One disease is removed from the caster's system.

sp-03165.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by three.

sp-03166.description_en: One poison is removed from the caster's system.

sp-03167.description_en: Allows the caster to repair a minor psychosis (recovery time of 1-10 hours). Minor psychosis include mild to moderate phobias (see GM Law for more on mind diseases).

sp-03168.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by five.

sp-03170.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by ten.

sp-03171.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by twenty.

sp-03172.description_en: As Heal Addiction I, except the level is lowered by one per level of the caster.

sp-03173.description_en: As Heal Addiction True, except affects all addictions the target has.

sp-03174.description_en: Caster can repair 1 sprain (no recovery time).

sp-03176.description_en: Caster can repair 1 damaged tendon. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03177.description_en: As Muscle Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.

sp-03178.description_en: A Tendon Repair I, except caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.

sp-03179.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Bone Ways, Blood Ways, and Organ Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.

sp-03180.description_en: As Muscle Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03181.description_en: As Tendon Repair I, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03182.description_en: Caster can repair a number of damaged muscles equal to his level. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03183.description_en: Caster can regenerate any 1 muscle. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03184.description_en: Caster can repair a number of damaged tendons equal to his level. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03185.description_en: Caster can regenerate any 1 tendon. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03186.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03187.description_en: As Muscle Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 minutes.

sp-03188.description_en: As Tendon Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 minutes.

sp-03189.description_en: Caster can regenerate any 1 muscle or tendon. Recovery time is instantaneous.

sp-03190.description_en: Caster can regenerate all of the muscles in his body. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03191.description_en: Caster can regenerate all of the tendons in his body. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03192.description_en: Caster can repair a number of damaged muscles and/or tendons equal to his level. Recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03193.description_en: Caster can repair any nose damage short of complete nose loss.

sp-03194.description_en: Caster can repair any minor nerve damage in 1 area. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03195.description_en: Caster can repair any external ear damage, including ear loss (regeneration takes 5-50 minutes)

sp-03196.description_en: Caster can repair any minor eye damage (e.g., corneal scratch, removal of foreign object, etc.).

sp-03197.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except caster can repair any 1 area of major nerve damage.

sp-03198.description_en: As Minor Ear Repair, except caster can also repair any internal ear damage (e.g., restore hearing). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03199.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb. Also requires the use of Bone Ways, Muscle Ways, and Blood Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional status. Limb will be fulling functional in 1-10 days.

sp-03200.description_en: As Minor Eye Repair, except caster can repair any eye damage short of complete eye loss. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03201.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03202.description_en: Caster can repair any damage to 1 organ (except the brain) that has not been completely destroyed. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03203.description_en: Caster can cure any paralysis problem. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03204.description_en: Caster can regenerate all the nerves in his body (outside brain area). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03205.description_en: As Major Nerve Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03206.description_en: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03207.description_en: As Paralysis Cures, except recovery time is 5-50 hours.

sp-03208.description_en: eration — As Mass Nerve Regeneration, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

sp-03209.description_en: Caster can repair brain damage (such as that caused by a skull fracture, etc. at the discretion of the GM). Experience lost by brain damage to the wounded being (the one from whom the damage is transfered) is not restored. Should the Healer have brain damage inflicted directly upon him (e.g., he is stuck in the head), he may suffer memory and/or experience loss. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03210.description_en: Caster can regenerate any 1 organ (external or internal), but not the brain. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

sp-03211.description_en: As Paralysis Cures, except recovery is instantaneous.

sp-03212.description_en: Caster may reunite his soul with his body, provided the body is functional. To restore a dead target to life, a Healer would first have to heal all of the target's wounds (without “killing” himself), and then restore the target's soul by giving up his own (for the target this process operates like the Lifegiving IV spell on the Cleric Base list, Life Mastery). While technically alive, but without his soul, the Healer would be affected as if he had been “absolved” (per Absolution Pure, on the Cleric Base List, Channels); thus, he could take no conscious actions and he would be at -75 for all subconscious actions. He may regain his own soul through the use of this spell or through someone else casting the appropriate spell.

sp-03213.description_en: Caster is healed of d10 concussion hits.

sp-03214.description_en: Will heal one area of mild frostbite or a 1st degree burn.

sp-03215.description_en: Caster is relieved of 1 round's worth of accumulated stun effects (see Section 7.1.1).

sp-03216.description_en: Reduces damage by 1 hit every round as long as caster concentrates. If caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration (see Section 7.1.1).

sp-03217.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except 2 areas of mild damage or 1 area of moderate damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn) are healed.

sp-03218.description_en: Caster is instantly awake from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-03219.description_en: As Heal I, except caster can heal 5d10 concussion hits.

sp-03220.description_en: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or a combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area can be healed.

sp-03221.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 3 rounds accumulated stun effects.

sp-03222.description_en: As Regenerate I, except 2 hits are healed every round. Spell Law

sp-03223.description_en: V — As Frost/Burn Relief I, except the area(s) of damage that can be healed are: 5 mild and 1 severe or 1 mild and 2 moderate or 1 moderate and 1 severe or etc.

sp-03224.description_en: As Heal I, except caster can heal 10d10 concussion hits.

sp-03225.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 5 rounds accumulated stun effects.

sp-03226.description_en: As Regenerate I, except 3 hits are healed every round.

sp-03227.description_en: As Heal I, except caster can heal 15d10 concussion hits.

sp-03228.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 10 rounds accumulated stun effects.

sp-03229.description_en: As Heal I, except caster can heal 20d10 concussion hits.

sp-03230.description_en: As Heal I, except caster is healed of all concussion hits.

sp-03231.description_en: Caster is relieved of all burns and/ or frostbite.

sp-03232.description_en: Caster is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.

sp-04412.description_en: Detects a curse on an item or person.

sp-04413.description_en: Target can see at night as if it were day, but he can only see in the day as if it were the darkest night.

sp-04414.description_en: Target can only eat bread or dairy products. Anything else will aggravate his ulcer (unless he makes an RR) and he will be incapacitated for 1-10 hours.

sp-04415.description_en: Trget cannot move faster than a walking pace on his own (he may be carried or ride at a faster pace).

sp-04416.description_en: Target can only eat green leaves. Eating other food incapacitates him (if he fails a RR) for 1-10 hrs.

sp-04417.description_en: Target will never voluntarily swim, enter any water (even a bath), or get into a boat.

sp-04418.description_en: All of target's fumble/failure ranges (weapon attacks, spell casting, and skill resolution) are doubled.

sp-04419.description_en: Target loses all Channeling power points (PPs). He cannot cast any Channeling spells (even through bonus items). A hybrid spell user of Channeling (e.g., Sorcerer or Healer) would only lose half his PPs. A character suffering from this curse suffers no exhaustion for the lost PPs.

sp-04423.description_en: Target's appearance is raised to the maximum possible (and then some). If anyone sees the uncovered face of the target or gets within 3' (and is of the opposite sexual persuasion and fails a RR), they will attempt to possess and carry off the the target (they will fight if necessary). Certain persons will get modifications to their RRs (eunuchs, hedonists, curties, morawoses, essceecees, icers, etc.).

sp-04424.description_en: Target's blood will coagulate and create a blood clot around the area of any cut or wound (bleeding at least one hit per round). The clot will cut off circulation to the area fed by the given vessel and target will lose the affected body section after 2-20 minutes due to system damage (e.g., a thigh wound might ultimately mean loss of leg; a neck wound would be fatal).

sp-04425.description_en: Target's appearance is lowered to 1. If a person sees the uncovered face of the target (or gets within 3'), he must make a RR. If he fails by 51 or more, he attacks the target. Even if the viewer is successful in his RR, he will experience extreme distaste (i.e., distain) for the target. For example, if the target went home after failing against this curse, his mother might resist (she gets a large modifier), but she might still make him sleep in the barn and eat on the porch.

sp-04426.description_en: Target will lie 50% of the time, regardless of the topic.

sp-04427.description_en: Target may only speak the truth.

sp-04428.description_en: Once per day (at a random time), the target will experience the pain from an old wound. For new characters, treat this as an 'A' Krush critical strike 50% of the time and a d10 concussion hits the other 50% of the time. Alternatively, the GM can re-open a specific old wound.

sp-04429.description_en: Target will move at fastest possilbe pace until he dies of exhaustion. He may be restrained, but whenever freed, he will begin to run again.

sp-04430.description_en: Every time the target is in a combat situation near friend(s) who are within 10', there is a 10% chance each round (non-cumulative) that he will attack one of his friends (random determination) and attempt to kill him. For these purposes a “friend” is any companion or associate.

sp-04432.description_en: s — Target may not attack any “evil” creature and the target learns all evil languages and the target will obey the commands of any evil person who is 10 or more levels higher than himself.

sp-04439.description_en: I — Caster may cast one of the Black Channel I spells (see Section 7.1.23).

sp-04440.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a fifth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-04441.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's “soul” is torn from his body. The soul remains in whatever place “souls” go for the duration. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. Target is unconscious until soul is restored. Even subconscious activity (healing, etc.) is performed with a -75 penalty.

sp-04442.description_en: As Black Channel I, except a Black Channel II spell can be cast (see Section 7.1.23).

sp-04433.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power source (usually a deity). The target is stunned.

sp-04434.description_en: When this spell is cast, the first level spell that the caster begins to cast the next round will be “channeled” to another spell user of the Channeling realm. The “channeled” spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately (i.e., the receiving spell user is now treated as the caster of the spell). All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver of the spell or know exactly where he is (direction and distance, or specific location). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (though he need not know exactly what spell is coming). For example, if a Cleric was at a certain altar at midnight of a full moon ready to receive a spell; then another spell user who knew this could use Channels to send him a spell.

sp-04435.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power source (usually a deity). The target falls into a deep, magical sleep.

sp-04436.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a third level spell may be transmitted.

sp-04437.description_en: Caster can make contact with any 1 known target he is acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being. This spell is often used with Channels spell.

sp-04438.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power source (usually a deity). The target is blinded.

sp-04444.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a seventh level spell may be transmitted.

sp-04445.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a tenth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-04446.description_en: As Absolution, except “soul” can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-04447.description_en: As Black Channel I, except a Black Channel III spell can be cast (see Section 7.1.23).

sp-04448.description_en: As Absolution Pure, except the “soul” is utterly destroyed.

sp-04449.description_en: Opens a direct channel to the evil cleric's deity; results depend on the deity's personality, motives and powers. Any spell the deity can cast can be transmitted through the gate.

sp-04450.description_en: Allows caster virtually total recall of any conversation or writing he encountered within a period of days equal to his level.

sp-04451.description_en: Detects “true good” in an animate or inanimate target. Caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-04452.description_en: As Detect Good, except detects blessings in an animate or inanimate target.

sp-04453.description_en: Detects extreme emotions in the living mind of a target, or in an object forged under extreme emotion. Caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-04454.description_en: Caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 1 item “of darkness” or “of evil.” The caster will not learn specific capabilities.

sp-04456.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring; limited to once per night. The caster must sleep a minimum of four hours.

sp-04457.description_en: Caster can determine the author, origin, and complete history of a given blessing. He also learns the nature and specific powers.

sp-04458.description_en: As Dark Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 2 items of darkness or evil or caster can determine the nature, origin point, and the exact significance of any 1 item of darkness or evil.

sp-04459.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-04460.description_en: Caster can determine the nature and origin of active extremes in emotion found within any 1 target (inanimate or animate). The degree and other details of such emotion can also be acquired.

sp-04461.description_en: As Dark Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 3 items of evil or darkness or caster can determine the age, origin point, nature, specific capabilities, and the name of the creator of any 1 item of evil or darkness. Caster also learns item's specific capabilities.

sp-04462.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-04463.description_en: As Dark Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 1 item “of light” or “of good.”

sp-04464.description_en: As Light Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 2 items of good or light or caster can determine the nature, origin point, and the exact significance of any 1 item of light or good.

sp-04465.description_en: Caster can ascertain the exact nature, origin, purpose, and history of any 1 item of evil or darkness; it allows caster to visualize all who have possessed the item.

sp-04466.description_en: As Light Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 3 items of good or light or caster can determine the age, origin point, nature, specific capabilities, and the name of the creator of any 1 item of good or light. Caster also learns item's specific capabilities.

sp-04467.description_en: As Black Lore, except it can only be used on an item “of darkness” or “of evil.”

sp-04468.description_en: As Black Lore, except caster can acquire the information on all items of evil or darkness within 100'.

sp-04348.description_en: Target gets a cold. Roll d100 for severity (high is bad for target).

sp-04350.description_en: Target has no sense of smell. Target never perceives by smell alone; and suffers a -25 to all perceptions involving smell and other senses.

sp-04351.description_en: Target has no sense of hearing. Target never perceives by hearing alone; and suffers a -25 to all perceptions involving hearing and other senses.

sp-04352.description_en: Over the course or 1 week the target's tongue will rot away. When tongue is fully gone, he will not be able to speak.

sp-04353.description_en: Target gets severe asthma. For every round of physical exertion (melee, running, firing a bow, rowing, etc.), the target will have a -5 modifier (cumulative) to any action involving physical exertion. When this modifier reaches -100 the target lapses into unconsciousness. Each -5 modifier requires 3 rounds of rest to eradicate.

sp-04354.description_en: Target gets leprosy. This causes a gradual loss of feeling in the extremities (and blood flow). Every day, the target suffers a -1 (cumulative) to all perceptions involving touch (maximum of -25). Also, target suffers a -1 to his appearance per day (down to a minimum of 1). After one week of leprosy, all concussion damage against the target is halved (this represents the loss of feeling in certain areas of the body).

sp-04355.description_en: Target becomes slightly allergic to a substance (not himself) of the caster's choosing. When in the presence of this substance, the target will be only be able to take 80% activity each round.

sp-04356.description_en: The roots of any one plant wither and die and no new roots can be grown. The plant will eventually die.

sp-04357.description_en: The target becomes a hemophiliac. All bleeding wounds (i.e., “hits/rnd”) and concussion hits are doubled. All critical strikes against the target have a 50% chance of giving an additional 1 hit per round. Healing hits requires double the normal expenditure.

sp-04358.description_en: The target contracts malaria. After the initial bout of high fever, delirium, coma, and incapacitation (lasting 1+2d10 days), the target will be subject to random “relapses” similar to the initial bout (5% chance per month). If the target receives no care during the initial bout, there is a 99% chance of death (only 1% chance if properly cared for during this time).

sp-04359.description_en: Caster may instantly kill any one plant he touches.

sp-04360.description_en: Target becomes an epileptic. In a tension situation, there is a 5% chance he will go into an epileptic fit. If someone treats them (i.e., holds them down and places an appropriate object in his mouth), he has only a 1% chance of dying; if not, he has a 5% chance of dying.

sp-04361.description_en: Target gets pneumonia. If the target is kept warm and completely immobile for 2 weeks, he will have only a 25% chance of dying (50% chance if not treated). The chance of dying is lowered by 5% for every 10 points by which caster's Constitution exceeds 50 (down to a minimum of 1%).

sp-04362.description_en: As Minor Allergy, except caster only gets 60% activity each round.

sp-04363.description_en: The target suffers any one of the diseases from this list (fifth level or lower) chosen by the caster. In addition, the target is contagious. All who come into contact (5'R) of the target makes an RR (with a +25 modifier; modifier drops to +0 with touching the target; drops to -25 with intimate contact with the target). If the original target makes his RR, he does not suffer the effects, but is still a carrier of the disease. All people who catch the disease from the target are not contagious.

sp-04364.description_en: Target gets elephantiasis. One of his extremities (not his head) swells and grows up to 5x normal size. Exact effect should be determined by the GM (but the extremity should be completely useless).

sp-04365.description_en: As Carrier I, except caster may select any disease from this list (10th level or lower).

sp-04366.description_en: Target gets leukemia. He will weaken at a rate of 2% per day (-2/day, cumulative, to activity in each round); when the total reaches 100%, the target is dead.

sp-04367.description_en: As Carrier I, except caster may select any disease from this list (15th level or lower).

sp-04368.description_en: Target gets rabies. After 21 days of no visible effect, the disease sets in.
