The target's organs contract; he foams at the mouth, becomes very thirsty and violent; and any one he bites or scratches must resist or catch the disease. The target dies 5-7 days after disease's onset.

sp-04369.description_en: Target gets a “plague.” If he fails his RR, he will die 95% of the time (in 10 minutes). The other 5% of the time, he believes that he resisted (and suffers no effects), but becomes a carrier instead. Anyone coming within 5' of a carrier must resist (+25 RR; +0 RR if touching the target; -25 RR if in intimate contact with the target) or face the same chances as the original target. Only the original target is contagious.

sp-04370.description_en: I — Caster can cause any dead body (within 50% of his own mass), to rise up and move. The caster must concentrate for the body to perform action; if he stops concentration, the body will stand motionless. The body can be maneuvered with a -25 modifier, and can melee with a -20 OB. Body cannot have been dead more than 1 day. Use Created Undead stats from Creatures & Monsters except the Undead with have a Move Rate of 25 and an OB of -20.

sp-04371.description_en: Caster can control one Class I Undead. When this spell is cast, there is a flat 2% per Class of the Undead that the Undead will resist the spell.

sp-04372.description_en: [RR Mod: -25] Caster may master 1 level of Undead per level of the caster. This spell must be caster seperately on each Undead. A mastered Undead allows the caster to control this specific undead without concentration. If the Undead is ever more than 10' per level from the master, this spell is dispelled. When this spell is cast, there is a flat 5% chance per Class of Undead that the Undead will resist the spell.

sp-04373.description_en: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 2 bodies (within the restrictions above) or one body with -15 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of -10.

sp-04374.description_en: Given a body that has been dead less than 1 week, the caster can turn the body into a Class I Undead. The Undead will attempt to attack the closest living being (if uncontrolled), but can take no other activity other than moving to the being and attacking. If controlled, the Undead will do anything (within its capabilities) that the caster commands. The Undead can be Dispelled, Repelled, or just smashed into little pieces.

sp-04375.description_en: As Control Undead I, except 1 Class II Undead or 2 Class I's can be controlled.

sp-04376.description_en: As Animate Dead I, except 3 bodies can be controlled or one body with -5 to maneuvers and a +0 melee

sp-04377.description_en: As Create Undead I, except 1 Class II Undead or 2 Class I Undead can be created.

sp-04378.description_en: As Control Undead I, except 1 Class III Undead or 3 Class I's or 1 Class II and 1 Class I can be controlled.

sp-04381.description_en: As Animate Dead I, except 5 bodies can be controlled at the basic penalties or 1 body with +10 to maneuvers and a +20 melee OB.

sp-04382.description_en: As Control Undead I, except caster can control 1 Class IV Undead or 4 Class I's or 2 Class II's or 1 Class III and 1 Class I or 1 Class II and 2 Class I's.

sp-04383.description_en: As Animate Dead I, except 6 bodies can be controlled at the basic penalties or 1 body with +15 to maneuvers and a +30 melee OB.

sp-04384.description_en: As Create Undead I, except caster can create 1 Class IV Undead or 4 Class I's or 2 Class II's or 1 Class III and 1 Class I or 1 Class II and 2 Class I's.

sp-04385.description_en: Any undead that is currently mastered (with the Undead Mastery spell), will follow simple, straight forward orders. This cancels the Undead Mastery spell. After completing the orders (which it will attempt to do for up to 1 day per level of the caster), the Undead returns to a normal Undead status (i.e., it attacks closest living being).

sp-04386.description_en: As Control Undead I, except caster can control 1 Class V Undead or 5 Class I or etc.

sp-04387.description_en: As Create Undead I, except caster can create 1 Class V Undead or 5 Class I's or 1 Class IV and 1 Class I or etc.

sp-04388.description_en: As Control Undead I, except caster can control any one Undead or any one Undead (Class V or lower) without concentration or all Class III or lower Undead within a 100'R. Range for controlling a single Undead is extended to 300'.

sp-04389.description_en: This ritual is considered to be one of the most evil of all magics. Using it, the caster transforms himself into a Lich, one of the most evil of the Undead. During the ritual, the caster's vital organs are “transferred” into a ready container (jar, box, item, etc.). If the spell succeeds (failure results in final death), the caster will be totally sustained by magic and will have slipped between the realms of life and unlife. He can only be irrevocably destroyed by the destruction of the container and his organs. See Creatures & Monsters for typical statistics of a Lich.

sp-04390.description_en: As Create Undead I, except caster can create any Undead that exists in the world system in use (e.g., Ring Wraiths, Vampires, etc.).

sp-04391.description_en: I — Causes d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04392.description_en: Causes one muscle to cramp in the target. Target will be at -10% to activity per 10 failure.

sp-04393.description_en: Target will bleed at the rate of 1 hit per round.

sp-04394.description_en: As Wounding I, except does 3d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04395.description_en: One external sensory organ (eye, nose, ear, etc.) is damaged. Foe will operate without that organ until healed. In addition, he will have a -10 modification per 10 failure to all actions that partially use that organ (-100 for all actions involving that organ directly).

sp-04396.description_en: One of target's limbs suffers a minor fracture.

sp-04397.description_en: As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 3 hits per round.

sp-04398.description_en: As Wounding I, except does 5d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04399.description_en: As Sensory Damage I, except 2 organs are affected.

sp-04400.description_en: The area touched by the caster on the target is paralyzed.

sp-04401.description_en: As Wounding I, except does 7d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04402.description_en: Target is drained of d10 Temporary Constitution points. If target's Constitution drops to 0 or below, he becomes a Class I Created Undead.

sp-04403.description_en: Target loses 1 hit per round that the caster concentrates (and remains within 2' of the target). As each point is drained, the caster is restored 1 point (up to his maximum).

sp-04404.description_en: As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 5 hits per round.

sp-04405.description_en: As Wounding I, except does 10d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04406.description_en: As Energy Drain I, except drains 2 hits per round.

sp-04407.description_en: As Drain Soul I, except drains 2d10 points and target becomes a Class II Created Undead if Constitution drops to 0 (or below).

sp-04408.description_en: As Wounding I, except does 15d10 concussion hits of damage.

sp-04409.description_en: As Drain Soul I, except drains 1 point per level of the caster and target becomes a Class III Created Undead if Constitution drops to 0 (or below).

sp-04410.description_en: As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 1 hit for every 5 levels of the caster.

sp-04411.description_en: As Wounding I, except target loses all his hits and takes an additional 1 hit for each level of the caster.

sp-00722.description_en: A random part of a random limb is sprained. If it is part of a leg: movement is cut by 25%, melee and missile attacks are modified by -10. If it is part of an arm, melee and missile attacks are modified by -20.

sp-00723.description_en: A random limb is in intense pain. For a leg, the target cannot walk (target may crawl at 10% of his normal movement); for an arm, that arm cannot be used.

sp-00724.description_en: The bones and tissues of the target's body are disrupted as if the target had fallen a long distance. If the target fails his RR by 1-10, he takes an 'A' Impact critical; by 11-20, he takes a 'B'; by 21-30, he takes a'C'; by 31-40, he takes a'D'; by more than 41, he takes an 'E'.

sp-00725.description_en: One of the target's joints locks. Target suffers the effects of Limb Pain. A moving target with a locked leg falls. A target with a locked arm drops anything he is carrying.

sp-00726.description_en: A random limb is broken. A broken arm is useless. One broken leg cuts movement by 50% and combat is modified by -75.

sp-00727.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 20'.

sp-00728.description_en: Target's skin will flake and peel all over his body. There is no tactical penalty, but target's Appearance is lowered by -50 (to a minimum of 1). Lasts until dispelled and 1 month passes. Magical healing could reduce this time.

sp-00729.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 50'.

sp-00730.description_en: One of the target's ears (random) is disrupted. His hearing is at 50% of normal until cured. This results in a -25 penalty to Perception involving hearing; -50 to Perception only involving hearing. If this spell is cast upon the same ear twice, the target is deaf in that ear.

sp-00731.description_en: One of the target's limbs (random) will wither and die. Target loses 5% of the use of the limb per day; when the total reaches 100%, the limb falls off. Can be cured through circulation and nerve repair spells up to the 80% point, then it must be regenerated. If the limb is a leg, movement is reduced by half the percentage lost (e.g., if a leg is 60% withered, movement is cut by 30%). If the limb is an arm, combat suffers a -1 penalty per 1% withered (e.g., if an arm is 75% withered, all combat will suffer a -75 penalty).

sp-00732.description_en: As Ear Disruption, except an eye is affected (as well as visual perception).

sp-00733.description_en: One of the target's lungs collapses. He is at 50% of normal for all activity until the lung is repaired.

sp-00734.description_en: As Limb Death, except a random muscle is affected (not muscle organs, e.g., not the heart).

sp-00735.description_en: As Limb Death, except a random bone (not part of spine or skull) gradually disintegrates.

sp-00736.description_en: One of the Black Channel I spells may be used (see Section 7.1.23).

sp-00737.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00738.description_en: As any single lower level spell, except it may be cast upon as many targets as the caster has levels.

sp-00739.description_en: The target's bones will gradually petrify; a loss of activity (as in Limb Death) occurs due to loss of blood production.

sp-00740.description_en: As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel II spells may be used.

sp-00741.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 300' and always delivers an 'E' Impact critical if the target fails to resist.

sp-00742.description_en: As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel III spells may be used.

sp-00744.description_en: For each level of the caster, he may freeze 10 cubic feet of liquid. Caster is immune to the cold.

sp-00745.description_en: Causes 1,000 cubic feet of liquid to rapidly evaporate (over the course of 1 hour).

sp-00746.description_en: Instantly disintegrates 100 cubic feet of water.

sp-00747.description_en: Water within the area of effect is calmed. Waves are cut 20' in center and less towards the perimeter.

sp-00748.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Water Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00749.description_en: No precipitation will occur in the area of effect for the duration of this spell.

sp-00750.description_en: Removes all the liquid (usually water) from 1 cubic foot of inanimate material.

sp-00751.description_en: As Evaporate I, except 10,000 cubic feet are affected.

sp-00752.description_en: As Unwater I, except 1000 cubic feet are affected.

sp-00753.description_en: As Unrain, except area of effect and duration.

sp-00754.description_en: As Dehydrate, except affects 10 cubic feet.

sp-00755.description_en: As Evaporate I, except affects 100,000 cubic feet.

sp-00756.description_en: As Unwater I, except affects 10,000 cubic feet.

sp-00757.description_en: As Calm Water, except waves are cut by 50' in center.

sp-00758.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00759.description_en: The target immediately begins to dehydrate and weather as if in a wind-blown, sandy desert. The target is immediately at -10% to activity and takes 1% of his total hits. For each round that the caster concentrates, the target loses another 5% activity and 1% of his total hits. If the caster maintains concentration for 28 consecutive rounds, animate targets will be reduced to dried out husks (i.e., when the activity penalty reaches 150%). If the caster is prevented from completing his rounds of concentration or the target gets out of the range of the spell, the target keeps the accumulated activity penalty and hits lost. The hits may be healed normally, but the activity penalty only recovers at the rate of 10% per day. Alternatively, the GM may allow the activity penalty to be removed with a Cure Disease spell (or its equivalent) cast after all of the hits are restored.

sp-00760.description_en: For every minute that the caster concentrates, the humidity drops 1% of the original humidity (up to 50%). The humidity will gradually increase at a rate of 5% (of original humidity) per day until the original humidity is reached. Note that this change in humidity levels could affect an area's climate (in turn affecting the area's vegetation).

sp-00761.description_en: As Evaporate I, except 1,000,000 cubic feet can be affected.

sp-00762.description_en: As Calm Water, except area of effect is 1,000'R per level of the caster.

sp-00763.description_en: Every minute that the caster concentrates, the humidity drops 5% of the original humidity (up to 95%). The humidity increases as in Dehumidify. Note that this change in humidity levels could affect an area's climate (in turn affecting the area's vegetation).

sp-00764.description_en: Disperses all fog in a 10'/lvl R.

sp-00765.description_en: Cuts all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) by 30 mph in a 10'R (will not affect breathing).

sp-00766.description_en: Creates a 5'R near vacuum; anyone within the radius must make a successful RR or take a 'B' Impact critical as the air leaves and rushes back in.

sp-00767.description_en: Caster can remove the oxygen in a 10'R at the rate of 1% of the original oxygen each round.

sp-00768.description_en: As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00769.description_en: As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.

sp-00770.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00771.description_en: Changes any gas to normal air at a rate of 1cubic per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-00772.description_en: As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 100'.

sp-00773.description_en: As Vacuum I, except delivers a 'D' Impact critical.

sp-00774.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except removal rate is 5% per round.

sp-00775.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 50'.

sp-00776.description_en: As Great Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.

sp-00777.description_en: As Mass Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00778.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00779.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removeal rate is 10% per round.

sp-00780.description_en: As Vacuum I, except delivers an 'E' Impact critical.

sp-00781.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removal rate is 20% per round.

sp-00782.description_en: As Major Vacuum, except affects a 10'R.

sp-00783.description_en: Destroys gases in a single enclosure (e.g., usually a building) up to a size of 100'x100'x100' (or 1,000,000 cu'). The building has a chance of collapsing (dependent on construction) and everyone inside takes an 'E' Impact critical from falling debris. This results in a very loud explosion. If the building collapses, everyone within 100' of the building takes a 'C' Impact critical from the explosion.

sp-00784.description_en: Target takes 25% of his remaining concussion hits (i.e., those not already taken). These hits are restored when the duration is up, provided target has not died.

sp-00786.description_en: Target must subtract 25 from all orientation and perception rolls, and 5 from all initiative rolls.

sp-00787.description_en: Target must subtract 25 from all maneuver rolls.

sp-00790.description_en: As Minor Pain, except 50% of remaining hits are taken.

sp-00791.description_en: Target forgets a period of (1 minute per level) of his past, as desired by the caster.

sp-00792.description_en: As Major Pain, except hits must be healed normally.

sp-00793.description_en: As Disorientation, Unbalance, and Distortions (all at once).

sp-00794.description_en: Target mind blanks out for a period of 10 minutes each day at random. Target is incapable of activity or thought during this period.

sp-00796.description_en: Target's mind is completely blank for the duration. He cannot perceive events, time, or activity. At the end of the duration of this spell, he is stunned for 1 round after his mind comes back.

sp-00797.description_en: As Disorientation, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00798.description_en: Target is a blathering idiot. He can be lead around, but he can take no action.

sp-00799.description_en: As Unbalance, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00800.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00801.description_en: As Distortions, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00802.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] The target believes he is being engaged by a creature of the his own worst fears. The target will be attacked each round by the creature (who has a +100 Martial Arts Strikes Rank I attack; the damage is real). Regardless of the damage done by the target (to the creature), the creature will only be defeated when the target makes his RR (one RR each minute), or when he loses consciousness.

sp-00803.description_en: Target loses 5% of his collected experience (usually experience points). Note that the target will not lose a level, only experience points (which means he will have to gain that many more experience points to gain his next level).

sp-00804.description_en: As Major Pain, except as many targets as the caster's level are affected, the duration is until healed, and the range is 300'.

sp-00805.description_en: As Mind Shock, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected and the range is 300'.

sp-00806.description_en: As Unminding, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected and the range is 300'.

sp-00807.description_en: For each level of the caster, he may melt up to 10 cubic feet of ice.

sp-00808.description_en: Loosens 100 cubic feet of earth to the consistency of plowed ground.

sp-00809.description_en: For each level of the caster, he causes a 100 cubic foot section of inorganic material to erode and deteriorate at 1,000 x normal rate.

sp-00810.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' (not 1,000 cubic feet) section will extend to their limit. See Section 7.1.13.

sp-00811.description_en: Will vaporize a non-magic door up to 6" thick, 10' high, and 10' wide (if the door is thicker than 6" it will vaporize the closest 6 inches). This will only work on an object that is used as a door (e.g., a caster cannot Undoor a section of wall).

sp-00812.description_en: Changes 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth. Change is gradual (taking 3 rounds for full effect).

sp-00813.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes earth to soft mud.

sp-00814.description_en: Creates a 3'x6' corridor that is 1' per level long. It can cut through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate of 1' (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-00815.description_en: Can shatter an inorganic object, up to 1 cubic foot. All within a 5'R take an 'A' Impact critical and holder takes a 'C'. Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.

sp-00818.description_en: As Undoor, except any single door is vaporized.

sp-00819.description_en: As Unearth, except affects 1 cubic foot of metal.

sp-00820.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00821.description_en: Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up to 10' wide, up to 100' deep, and up to 200' long. The crack takes 2 rounds to open.

sp-00822.description_en: As Unearth, except it will disintegrate 1 cubic foot per level of the caster of any inanimate solid.

sp-00823.description_en: Causes a very minor earthquake which could cause shoddy construction to collapse (can be very terrifying). This is approximately 5.5 on the Richter scale.

sp-00824.description_en: Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10' per level deep, 1' per level wide and 20' per level long). The crevice takes 2 rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for 3 rounds to close the crevice.

sp-00825.description_en: Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to 1 rnd/ lvl. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a d100 roll: (01-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6, (46-65) = 6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0.

sp-00826.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question (presuming that the target can understand the question).

sp-00827.description_en: Target is possessed by a minor Demon. Caster has no control over the target or the Demon. The Demon will force the target to do random (not necessarily destructive) things. Target gets an RR every other round to attempt to get rid of the Demon.

sp-00828.description_en: Target has an extreme dislike for any specific thing the caster chooses. Target has a 50% chance of overcoming the neurosis when given a choice. For example, a neurosis concerning horses would mean that every time the target tried to get on or near a horse he would only have a 50% chance. This chance is modified by three times his Self Discipline stat bonus.

sp-00829.description_en: Target becomes guilty over some action in his past. The GM should choose some significant event in the target's past. He will not perform similar actions again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt.

sp-00830.description_en: Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/dangerous situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by Self Discipline bonus x 3) that he will not put his safety in the hands of others.

sp-00831.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target gets an RR only once every minute.

sp-00832.description_en: Target will flee in panic in any personally dangerous situation, unless he successfully makes an RR. Target is required to make an RR only once per combat. Fleeing equates to movement away for d10 rounds at maximum pace.

sp-00833.description_en: Target's “soul” and the caster's “soul” are interchanged; the caster can operate at 50% of his normal activity in the body of the target. The target in the caster's body is inactive. The caster can cancel the spell at any time (takes 1 rnd), the target can only cancel the spell if he makes a successful RR (he gets one every 10 minutes). If either body is killed, both “souls” will be affected as by an Absolution.

sp-00834.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target only gets an RR once every 10 minutes.

sp-00835.description_en: Part of the target's “soul” is taken and placed in an organic object on the caster's person. The body of the target will act as the caster directs whenever he concentrates. The spell is canceled when: the caster cancels it or the object is destroyed or the target is more than 100' from object or the object leaves caster's person. If the caster is not concentrating the target is free to do anything he wants (though he is at -30 to all actions). While being commanded, the target is aware of all the actions he is performing (but he is helpless to stop them).

sp-00836.description_en: Part of the target's soul is transferred to a random object somewhere within 100 miles. The target is at -30 to all activities until the spell is dispelled or he touches the object. The target will always know the direction of his “soul.”

sp-00837.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target only gets an RR once every hour.

sp-00838.description_en: Target flees in total panic from caster. Fleeing equates to movement away for d10 rounds at maximum pace.

sp-00839.description_en: As Word of Panic, except affects all within 20' of caster.

sp-00840.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00841.description_en: The target is put into a state of deep sleep from which he will not awaken or age. He will only die if his body is killed. This sleep will continue until dispelled or until a single, non-magical event (specified by the caster at the time of casting) is accomplished. Note that the caster must specify the non-magical condition (i.e., it is not an option).

sp-00842.description_en: As Subjugation, except the “soul” is only released if the caster cancels the spell or the object is destroyed or the target touches the object.

sp-00843.description_en: As Transferral, except the caster can operate at 90% of normal activity, and the target can only make an RR once every hour.

sp-00844.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's “soul” is torn from the target's body; it remains in whatever place “souls” go, for 30 days per 10 failure. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. The target is unconscious and at -75 for subconscious activities (including all healing and subconscious spells) while his soul is absent.

sp-00845.description_en: As Absolution, except “soul” can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-05778.description_en: Caster may mentally speak with another Astrologer.

sp-05797.description_en: Caster an cause his voice to be heard at a point up to 100' per level away (in amplified tones). If the location is out of sight, the caster must have been there.

sp-05798.description_en: As Mind Voice I, but range is 1 mile per level.

sp-05801.description_en: Caster (on a clear night, when stars are visible) gains perfect directional and distance sense. For the duration of this spell, he will always know where he is in relation to known landmarks.

sp-05806.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05809.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05810.description_en: Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a “yes” or a “no” to a question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day.

sp-05815.description_en: As Commune I, except caster receives answers to three questions.

sp-05819.description_en: As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept.

sp-05820.description_en: As Dream I, except caster is able to manipulate his dream in a limited way to gain more information on a specific topic. For example, while he is in the dream he can ask a question (but there is no guarantee it will be answered).

sp-05821.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question.

sp-05822.description_en: Beam of light (like flashlight) springs from the caster's palm (with a 50' effective range). If the caster closes his hand (into a fist), the light will “turn off.” If the fist is opened before the duration expires, the light will “turn on.”

sp-05824.description_en: Lights a 20'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move with the target.

sp-05825.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R sphere of intense light, all within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-05826.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster. The attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-05832.description_en: As Light, except that the range is 100' and caster may generate a single source of up to 60'R or three 20'R sources

sp-05842.description_en: Focuses star or moonlight as a lens, must be focused initially on a fixed point. After 1 round it can be moved at the rate of 1' per round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of 6" per round (in wood), 1" per round (in stone), or 0.5" per round (in metal).

sp-05843.description_en: As Starfires, except the range and focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster is immune) and it can be moved at the rate of 10' per round. It can be used in a combat, striking as a Fire Bolt with an OB of 30 (plus the caster's directed spell bonus with Starhand). Concentration is not required if being used in melee.

sp-05844.description_en: As Starfires or Starhand, but star/moonlight is not required.

sp-05868.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within his range.

sp-05872.description_en: Caster stores mental pattern of target. This information can be used later to recognize the target or locate the target through Finding.

sp-05882.description_en: As Finding, but both the caster and target must be outdoors while stars are visible.

sp-05887.description_en: As Location, except range is 20 miles.

sp-05888.description_en: As Direction, except no range limitations.

sp-05889.description_en: As Finding, except no range limitations.

sp-05891.description_en: Caster is able to communicate basic ideas in a specific language (hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language.

sp-05895.description_en: As Speech I, except caster can communicate in more complex concepts, although there is a good chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.

sp-05899.description_en: As Speech I, except caster is reasonably fluent in the language. Caster's accent is imperfect, but there is only a slight chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the language.

sp-04084.description_en: Caster magically summons a first level, nonintelligent animal from the surrounding area, which arrives at the end of the round. The GM will determine the type of creature that answers the summons. If the creature can understand the caster, the creature can be controlled through normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained only through concentration by the caster. If the creature summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in its own perception), the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level (which may already have expired).

sp-04085.description_en: As Summons I, except caster chooses two of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled. The same option may be chosen more than once.

sp-04086.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small creature (of creature intelligence) to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the creature through normal means and cast this spell on the creature once per day for 2 weeks (concentrating for 4 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50 feet per level). See Section 10.2 in the Essence Companion for more information about True Familiars.

sp-04087.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 5 options are chosen.

sp-04088.description_en: I - The caster can make a semi-intelligent being a companion. The companion can be no more than 50% of the caster's mass. The companion cannot be more intelligent than the caster. The relationship between the caster and the companion is not magical (and the caster must strive to maintain good relations with the companion or it will leave him). The relationship should be treated as a parent/child relationship. The companion will almost always obey a "do not" command (e.g., "Do not drink that potion"); but the companion may make a RR to resist a "do" command (e.g., "Go and steal the eggs from the chickens). The GM should determine when a command is a "do not" command and when a command is a "do" command (i.e., the commands do not have to have "do" or" do not" in them-it is the intent of the command that should be examined).

sp-04089.description_en: Caster issues a magical summons to the nearest intelligent fantastic creature of no greater level than 4. If the creature fails its RR. it will do everything within its power to move to the caster. If it hasn't found the caster in four days, it will abandon the summons. When the creature arrives, it will not be hostile to the caster.

sp-04090.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 9 options are chosen.

sp-04091.description_en: As Summons III, except 12 options are chosen.

sp-04092.description_en: As Summons III, except 14 options are chosen.

sp-04093.description_en: As Fantastic Summons IV, except that the creature may be up to 6th level and it will attempt to answer the summons for six days.

sp-04094.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 16 options are chosen.

sp-04095.description_en: As Companion I, except the companion can be up to 100% of the caster's weight. The companion can also be intelligent (but not as intelligent as the caster), with the relation• ship being treated as a parent/young adult relationship.

sp-04096.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 20 options are chosen.

sp-04097.description_en: As Fantastic Summons IV, except that the creature may be up to 10th level and it will attempt to answer the summons for ten days.

sp-04098.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 24 options are chosen.

sp-04099.description_en: As Companion I, except there is no size limitation. The companion can also be very intelligent (but not as intelligent as the caster), with the relationship being treated as one between equals, the companion acting on its own without commands from the caster.

sp-04100.description_en: As Summons Ill, except 29 options are chosen.

sp-04101.description_en: As Fantastic Summons IV, except that the creature may be up to 20th level and it will attempt to answer the summons for twenty days.

sp-04102.description_en: As Summons III, except 39 options are chosen.

sp-04103.description_en: As Summons III, except 50 options are chosen. SrECIAL Nons Fantastic creatures are intelligent creatures of the caster's plane (i.e., fou r,-o'!lh1,-oc

sp-04104.description_en: Detects the presence of any extra-planar creatures within the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-04105.description_en: Caster summons an extra-planar entity that gradually appears over the course of 2 rounds. Roll d 100 (not open-ended) for Type. A result of 01-80 is a Type I; a result of 81-100 is a Type II.

sp-04106.description_en: Allows the caster to totally control a Type I Entity (the chance ofnon-control is the Entity's Type x 2%). The Entity leaves when the caster stops concentrating. The Entity will not speak with the summoner. This spell will take control of the entity regardless of its present state of control (mastered/controlled by another spell user, free, berserk, etc. If the entity was being controlled or mastered by another spell user, the original spell may make a RR to prevent this spell from taking control.

sp-04107.description_en: Gives the caster a +15 bonus for the duration to lore skills that apply to the particular type of entity summoned by the spells on this list (e.g., Demon Lore, Elemental Lore, etc.)

sp-04108.description_en: As Planar Summons I, except roll using the following results: (01-50) Type I, (51-90) Type II, (91-100) Type III.

sp-04109.description_en: As Control Entity I, except that the caster need not concentrate to control the Entity. The chance of failure is 5 times the Entity's Type. The Entity will remain and obey the caster until the caster is killed or the Entity is outside the range limit or the caster releases him. One caster may master a maximum of two Entities at one time.

sp-04110.description_en: I -As Control Entity I, except Type II Entities can be controlled.

sp-04112.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Type II Entities can be mastered.

sp-04113.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Type III Entities can be controlled.

sp-04114.description_en: As Planar Summons I, except roll using the following results: (01-50) Type III, (51-85) Type IV, (86-95) Type V, (96-100) Type VI.

sp-04116.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Type IV Entities can be controlled.

sp-04117.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Type IV Entities can be mastered.

sp-04118.description_en: As Planar Summons I, except roll using the following results: (01-50) Type IV, (51-90) Type V, (91-100) Type VI.

sp-04119.description_en: The target of this spell is any Mastered Entity. The Entity can be given a simple, straightforward task that it will attempt to complete within the duration of the spell. When this spell expires, the Entity returns to its plane.

sp-04120.description_en: The target of this spell is any Mastered Entity. The Entity is contained within an object (must be within 50% of the Entity's actual size). A specific trigger (specified by the caster at the time of casting) will release the Entity. Possible triggers include touching the object, proximity to the object, specific words spoken, etc.

sp-04121.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Type V Entities can be controlled.

sp-04122.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Type V Entities can be mastered.

sp-04123.description_en: As Planar Summons I, except roll using the following results: (01-50) Type V, (51-90) Type VI, (91-100) Something bigger (an Elemental Savant, Demon Lord, Demon Beyond the Pale, etc.; GM's discretion). Note that no method has yet been found to master Entities of Types greater than VI.

sp-04124.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Type VI Entities can be controlled.

sp-04125.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Type VI Entities can be mastered. Snc1AL Noru 1) Spells from this list should summon and control/master entities/ creatures that are appropriate to the caster's faith. An entity for the purposes of this is any extra-planar creature. They could be Angels, Elementals, Demons, Genii, or any other such creatures that a deity could send to help the caster. These spells will only work on that specific type of creature. 2) The actions of any uncontrolled Entity will depend on the nature of the creature. For example, Demons will likely attack their summoner, Elementals will go berserk and attack the nearest creature, Genii might demand some sort of payment, Angels might think the caster is unworthy of their service and leave, etc. See Section 15 .22 in Spell !Aw for more information. 3) If no type for an entity is given, use the following table to determine an entity's type. Level Type Level Type

sp-04127.description_en: Caster knows the exact distance and direction to any one bonded creature.

sp-04129.description_en: The caster may communicate with any bonded creatures.

sp-04132.description_en: One of the caster's intelligent, bonded creatures • is given the ability to cast one spell of the caster's. This spell cannot be greater than half of the caster's level. All power points for this spell will come from the caster.

sp-04134.description_en: All concussion damage delivered this round to one of the caster's bonded creatures is transferred to the caster instead.

sp-04136.description_en: Caster can teleport to the side of one specified bonded creature, or he can teleport the creature back to him.

sp-04137.description_en: Caster is given the ability to cast a spell that one of his bonded creatures has the innate ability to cast. The spell may not be greater level than half the caster's level. All power points for this spell will come from the caster.

sp-04140.description_en: One of caster's bonded creatures may share the effects of one of caster's protection spells (i.e., Blur, Shield, Protection II, etc.). This spell ends when the protection spell ends.

sp-04141.description_en: The caster may mentally communicate with any bonded creatures.

sp-04142.description_en: As Strengthen Creature, except the creature will take on a new, major physical characteristic appropriate to the caster and his faith.

sp-04143.description_en: As Summoned Sense, except three senses may be used.

sp-04144.description_en: If the caster dies, his soul goes into the body of the target bonded creature. If the creature is from another plane, it remains on the caster's plane. Caster's soul is stored there until it can be restored to a condition where it can survive again or until 1 day per level of the caster has elapsed. If the creature dies while carrying the caster's soul, both souls depart as normal.

sp-04145.description_en: Caster and one bonded creature share their PPs, hits, exhaustion points, innate protections and protection spells for the duration. In addition, if the caster dies, his soul goes into the body of the target bonded creature, and the caster's soul takes total control over the creature's body until his soul can be restored to a condition where it can survive again or until 1 week per level of the caster has elapsed.

sp-04146.description_en: I - When a Circle of Summoning is drawn, it is dedicated to a type of creature (e.g., animal, Demon, Elemental, faerie, etc.). While the caster is within this circle, he receives a special +25 to his Summoning skill for that particular creature. He also receives a +5 on all Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for Summoning spells that summon the specified type of creature.

sp-04147.description_en: Allows the caster to irnbed one 1st level spell into a circle. The spell is then activated through the circle, having an area of effect based on the size of the circle. The spell to be imbedded into the circle must be cast within one minute of the Circle spell.

sp-04148.description_en: When a Circle of Containment is drawn, it is dedicated to a type of creature (e.g. human, animal, Demon, Elemental, Faerie, etc.). Whenever such a creature tries to cross the border of the circle, it must make an RR with a special modification of -50 or take a 'C' Impact critical. If the creature makes his RR, the Circle is canceled. The caster can summon creatures into a Circle of

sp-04150.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 3rd level, non-attack spells can be imbedded.

sp-04151.description_en: Allows the caster to place two circles around each other, thereby combining their effects without negating each another. If this spell is not used, where two or more circles of any type intersect or overlap in physical location or effect, both will be canceled.

sp-04152.description_en: As Circle of Summoning I, except the bonus to Summoning skill is +35, and the bonus to Spell Casting Static Maneuvers is +10.

sp-04154.description_en: As Circle ofContainment I, except the creatures RR modification is -75, and the effect is an 'E' critical.

sp-04155.description_en: As Multi-Circle II, except up to three circles may be placed in conjunction.

sp-04156.description_en: As Circle I, except up to a 7th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-04157.description_en: Any creature summoned within a Circle of Binding must answer one question or perform one task for the caster. This spell does not grant the caster the ability to communicate with the creature, but does bind the target to follow the first suggestion the caster commands.

sp-04158.description_en: As Circle ofSummoning/, except the bonus to Summoning skill is +45, and the bonus to Spell Casting Static Maneuvers is +15.

sp-04159.description_en: As Circle I, except up to a 10th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-04160.description_en: The caster's next Circle spell with an imbedded spell can be delayed for up to one day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following (decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific action.

sp-04161.description_en: As Circle of Containment I, except the creature's RR modification is -100, and the effect is two separate 'E' criticals.

sp-04162.description_en: As Circle I, except up to a 15th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-04163.description_en: As Circle of Summoning/, except the bonus to Summoning skill is +55, and the bonus to Spell Casting Static Maneuvers is +20.

sp-04164.description_en: As Multi-Circle II, except up to four circles may be placed in conjunction.

sp-04165.description_en: As Circle I, except up to a 20th level spell can be imbedded.

sp-04166.description_en: As Circle of Containment /, except the creature's RR modification is -125, and the effect is three separate 'E' criticals.

sp-04167.description_en: Allows the caster to "link" multiple circles (all within a mile of each other) for the transfer of power points or spells. A caster in any linked circle may send spells or power points to any other spell user in a circle within the matrix. The recipient of any spell must cast the spell immediately as an instantaneous spell. The recipient still may only cast one spell per round, and if multiple spells are transferred to him, he will cast each in the order that they were sent to him ( each one round apart). Any spell sent to a recipient must include the appropriate number of power points, and both the sender and recipient must make Spell Casting Static Maneuvers to check for spell failure.

sp-04168.description_en: As Circle I, except up to a 30th level spell can be imbedded for a longer duration.

sp-04169.description_en: Caster can tell if there has been any Summoning spells cast within the area of effect and within 1 hour per level into the past.

sp-04170.description_en: When caster casts any spell from the Animal Summons list, and desires a specific creature, he will get it 15% of the time. The Summons spell must be cast within a minute of this one.

sp-04171.description_en: Caster can double the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04172.description_en: This spell will only work between the time a Summons spell has been cast, and when the creature arrives. It allows the caster to prevent the creature from arriving if it fails a RR versus the caster's level. Will only work on creatures that are not higher level than the caster. The target of this spell can be either the summoner or the creature (if it is visible and still forming).

sp-04173.description_en: Caster's next summoned creature (arriving within one minute of this spell) will serve the caster for twice as long as normal.

sp-04174.description_en: As Specify Creature I, except the chance is 30%.

sp-04175.description_en: The caster's next summoned creature will arrive at the end of the round that he casts the Summoning spell (within one minute of this spell).

sp-04176.description_en: Caster can triple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04177.description_en: While this spell is active, all Summoning spells become Instantaneous, and each controlled creature only requires 25% activity to control.

sp-04178.description_en: Caster's next summons spell from the Planar Summons spell list has all rolls for how powerful of an entity is summoned modified by +10.

sp-04179.description_en: As Servitude II, except the creature will serve for three times as long as normal.

sp-04180.description_en: The next creature summoned by the caster will serve the caster for the duration of this spell.

sp-04181.description_en: This spell is cast before a Summoning spell (that cannot be higher than 10th level) is cast. It will delay the arrival of the summoned creatures up to 1 day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following ( decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific action. The caster may specify (at the time of casting) a single task for the creature(s) to perform when it (they) arrive.

sp-04182.description_en: Caster can quadruple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04183.description_en: As Potent Summons, except the modifier is +20.

sp-04184.description_en: As legion, except controlled creature only requires 10% activity to control.

sp-04185.description_en: As Specify Creature I, except the chance is 70%.

sp-04186.description_en: Caster can quintuple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04187.description_en: As Waiting Summons, except it can be cast with any level Summons spell.

sp-04188.description_en: Caster gains permanent control of the next creature he summons and controls. This creature will receive a RR against this spell. If the creature fails the RR, it is permanently bound to the caster's plane, and is placed under the control of the caster and will unfailingly obey him. The caster can have as many of these creatures under his control as he wishes.

sp-04189.description_en: Caster knows one target for the purposes of the Calling and Teleportal spells on this list. The caster can only "Know" one target per level of experience.

sp-04190.description_en: Caster learns the distance and a direction to one target that he "Knows." The target must be within the range of this spell or only the direction is learned.

sp-04191.description_en: Caster is able to call on someone that he "Knows" and is within range of this spell. Caster gains no power to make the target do anything; he only gains the power to talk to him for the duration (one way communication only).

sp-04193.description_en: As Locate I, except for range.

sp-04194.description_en: Caster opens a gate within 10' of someone that the caster "Knows," and is within range of this spell. The spell provides no communication with that person, it only provides transportation. The teleportal will only remain open for the duration of this spell. If the person steps through (it is his choice), the teleportal immediately disappears and another gate opens within 1O' of the caster, and the summoned person arrives and the gate disappears. The spell can be re-cast (within 1 hour) to automatically return the target to where he was before.

sp-04195.description_en: As Calling I, except for range.

sp-04196.description_en: Caster's next Teleportal spell that he casts (within 1 minute of this spell) will allow three appropriate targets to step through before it closes.

sp-04197.description_en: As Locate I, except for range .

sp-04198.description_en: As Teleportal I, except for range. Alternatively, the caster may use the range of Teleportal I and force one target that he "Knows" to move through the gate. The target may make an RR, but if he fails, he is forced through the portal.

sp-04200.description_en: Caster learns to where the target gate or magical portal leads.

sp-04201.description_en: As Teleportal II, except for range. The range for forcing a target is as in Teleportal JI.

sp-04202.description_en: As Locate I, except for range.

sp-04203.description_en: Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, teleportal or other magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR versus the level of the caster with a special modifier of -30. Failure indicates that the being takes a 'C' Impact critical and does not pass through the gate.

sp-04204.description_en: As Calling I, except for range.

sp-04205.description_en: As Locate I, except for range.

sp-04206.description_en: As Teleportal II, except for range. Range for forcing a target is as in Teleportal Ill.

sp-04207.description_en: As Enhance Teleportal III, except it allows up to ten targets to enter the teleportal before it closes.

sp-04208.description_en: As Calling I, except for range.

sp-04209.description_en: As Teleportal II, except for range. The range for forcing a target is as in Teleportal IV

sp-04210.description_en: As Enhance Teleportal III, except it will allow one target per level of the caster to enter the teleportal before it closes.

sp-04211.description_en: The caster can open up a teleportal next to any target that he "Knows" (regardless of range). Alternatively, the caster can open a gate in any location that he is very familiar with. This spell is accompanied with a visual image of the caster that can verbally and visually communicate two-way with anyone on the other side of the teleportal. SrECIAL Nons

sp-04213.description_en: All of target's RR's suffer a penalty of -5 for the duration.

sp-04219.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -10 for the duration.

sp-04225.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -15 for the duration.

sp-04231.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -25 for the duration.

sp-04234.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list once per round.

sp-04235.description_en: The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects in the area. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-04237.description_en: Target Channeling spell user loses some of his faith in his church, religion, deity, etc. For the duration of this spell, all of target's spells will require a spell casting static maneuver with a special penalty of -20 (-10 if target is a Hybrid spell user, -5 if target is an Arcane spell user).

sp-04238.description_en: Target becomes guilty over some action in his past. The GM should choose some significant event in the target's past. He will not perform similar actions again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt.

sp-04239.description_en: The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration. In addition, target may not "regain" spent PPs for the duration.

sp-04240.description_en: Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/ dangerous situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by Self Discipline bonus x 3) that he will not put his safety in the • hands of others.

sp-04242.description_en: As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -30 (-15 for hybrids; and -10 for Arcane users).

sp-04243.description_en: The target believes he has fallen into disfavor with

sp-04244.description_en: Target loses all faith in other beings. He believes that no one can or should help him in any way and that he should face all his problems alone. He refuses to accept help from anyone.

sp-04245.description_en: Target loses all Channeling power points. He cannot cast any Channeling spells (even through bonus items). A hybrid spell user of Channeling would only lose half of his PPs. Certain Channelers with high Divine Status may gain a bonus to their RRs versus this spell.

sp-04246.description_en: As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -50 (-25 for hybrids; and -15 for Arcane users).

sp-04247.description_en: Target may not call upon his deity for help for the duration.

sp-04249.description_en: One of the Black Channel I spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell Law).

sp-04250.description_en: As Block Channel, except for the duration.

sp-04252.description_en: As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -80 (-40 for hybrids; and -20 for Arcane users).

sp-04253.description_en: As Paranoia, except target will never put his safety in the hands of others and will believe that everyone is out to get him.

sp-04255.description_en: One of the Black Channel II spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell Law).

sp-04257.description_en: One of the Black Channel III spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell Law). SPECIAL Nons

sp-04259.description_en: This spell influences the target's decision about who to attack. If the target of this spell is (or will be within 2 rounds) choosing his mdee opponent, this spell will influence that decision 20% away from the caster. Other opponents must be available for this spell to work.

sp-04260.description_en: The caster causes the target to believe that he is being watched all the time and puts him at -10% to activity.

sp-04262.description_en: The target will not attack the caster.

sp-04265.description_en: Target will flee in terror as fast as he can from the caster.

sp-04268.description_en: The target must obey the caster's suggestions as long as the suggestions are not alien to him (e.g., suicide, blinding himself, etc.).

sp-04270.description_en: As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04271.description_en: As Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -75.

sp-04272.description_en: Target is given one task; failure results in a penalty to be determined by the GM.

sp-04273.description_en: As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -50.

sp-04274.description_en: As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04276.description_en: As Look of Diifigure I, except the penalty is -100.

sp-04277.description_en: As Unncroing Eye I, except the penalty is -75.

sp-04278.description_en: A;;. Look of Terror I, except the penalty is

sp-04279.description_en: Target's appearance is so revolting that almost no one will deal with him. Resolve as Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -150.

sp-04280.description_en: Target must resist or die. SrECIAL Non

sp-04281.description_en: Gives the caster a + 10 to his Research skill for any activity that involves researching new curses, researching for a magic ritual that involves a curse, etc.

sp-04282.description_en: s - Detects any curses on the target.

sp-04283.description_en: Target will get the compulsion to talk and talk. The target will get this compulsion whenever he hears someone else talking.

sp-04284.description_en: Target does not wish to talk at all. He must be motivated heavily to get him to talk.

sp-04285.description_en: Target is limited in a certain skill that the caster chooses. All attempts to use that skill are at -10. Also, when the target increases in level, a rank is lost in that skill (to a minimum of zero ranks).

sp-04286.description_en: Target cannot get enough to drink. He will empty any container of drinkable fluid, then want more.

sp-04287.description_en: Caster can determine the nature and origin of any one curse including the name of the one who bequeathed it.

sp-04289.description_en: Places a curse on one room. Some options for the curse might include: a decline in business, room becomes haunted, room falls into disrepair, etc. (GM's discretion).

sp-04290.description_en: As Curse Craft I, except the penalty is -20 and the target loses 2 ranks upon gaining a level.

sp-04292.description_en: Dispels a curse if the curse fails a RR.

sp-04293.description_en: Anytirne the target rolls a 66 or a 100, his back will spasm causing him to be paralyzed for 2d20 rounds.

sp-04294.description_en: As Room Curse, except for the area of effect.

sp-04295.description_en: As Curse Craft I, except the penalty is -30 and the target loses 3 ranks upon gaining a level.

sp-04296.description_en: Target is Hexed and misfortune befalls him and his companions. A Hex is an invisible mark magically written on a target. The target will slowly become enveloped in things going wrong (e.g., weapons breaking, ropes being cut in two, stepping on a branch while stalking, slipping on a dry floor, etc.). Hex is removed by discovering and removing the mark. The Hex has power in it, and improper removal of it will deliver a 'C' Impact and 'B' Heat critical to all within a 30' foot radius.

sp-04297.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] Dispels a curse if the curse fails an RR.

sp-04299.description_en: As Curse Craft I, except the penalty is -40 and the target loses 4 ranks upon gaining a level.

sp-04300.description_en: As Room Curse, except for it can curse a small town.

sp-04301.description_en: As Curse Craft I, except the penalty is -60 and the target loses 6 ranks upon gaining a level.

sp-04302.description_en: As Room Curse, except for it can curse an entire city.

sp-04303.description_en: As Room Curse, except for it can curse an entire kingdom (GM's discretion).

sp-04304.description_en: Allows caster to make his body somewhat malleable and flexible to avoid attacks. Gives +5 to DB. The bonus only applies to attacks that the caster perceives.

sp-04305.description_en: The fingers on one of the caster's hands transform into sharp talons. The caster can make Small Claw attacks with these talons.

sp-04306.description_en: Caster can move one small part of his body to another location. For example, an eye could be moved to the tip of a finger to look down a small hole, a finger could be moved to the wrist to untie a rope bond, etc. This spell can only be used to move a small body part.

sp-04307.description_en: Caster's mouth fills with razor-sharp teeth. Caster may make Small Bite attacks.

sp-04308.description_en: Caster grows a set of large bat-like wings that he can use to fly at 50 feet per round. While doing so, the caster expends exhaustion points as if moving at a running pace.

sp-04309.description_en: As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Medium Claw attacks.

sp-04311.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 100 feet per round.

sp-04312.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Medium Bite attacks.

sp-04313.description_en: Caster's tongue becomes a 3-foot-long whip that can make a Large Grapple attack.

sp-04314.description_en: One of the caster's anns transforms into a snake that can make Large Grapple attacks.

sp-04315.description_en: As Miner Body Switch, except that any part of the body (excepting the head) can be moved to a different location. For example, an arm could be moved to a place where it could be more useful.

sp-04317.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 200 feet per round.

sp-04318.description_en: As Shifting Defense, except bonus is

sp-04319.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Large Bite attacks.

sp-04321.description_en: As Snake Arm, except caster can make Huge Grapple attacks.

sp-04322.description_en: As Talon Fingers I, except caster may make Huge Claw attacks.

sp-04323.description_en: As Bat Wings, except movement rate is 300 feet per round. In addition, anyone who makes contact with the caster must make a RR or take a 'B' Heat critical.

sp-04324.description_en: As Viper Jaw I, except caster may make Huge Bite attacks.

sp-04325.description_en: Target that meets the caster's gaze must make an RR or be turned to stone for 1 minute per 5% failure level. Caster can only gaze at one such target per round.

sp-04326.description_en: Caster can make any one of the lower level changes on this list permanent. Once per year, the caster can choose another effect to make permanent.

sp-04327.description_en: This spell allows the caster to determine if a particular location, object, or person has any kind of connection with the caster's fate. A connection with the caster's fate is anything that the caster would consider important to his future.

sp-04328.description_en: Caster causes any fate, omen reading, or other such spells to fail on him when tried.

sp-04329.description_en: Caster improves his luck for one action. This spell may only be cast once per action that requires a die roll. The die roll has +1 added to it (and this modification may make the roll openended). This spell may not be cast after the dice are rolled, does not require any separate action or activity, and it is considered part of the action that is being resolved.

sp-04330.description_en: Caster is able to determine the target's remaining Fate Points. If the target makes his RR. or cancels this spell, the caster will still know whether or not the target has any Fate Points at all.

sp-04331.description_en: Caster places a blessing on the target. Target gains a special bonus of +10 on his next action.

sp-04332.description_en: Caster worsens the luck of the target. The target suffers a special penalty of -1 per level of the caster for all his actions.

sp-04333.description_en: Caster alters his own luck. After caster's next action and dice roll are made, he may choose which die is the "tens" die and which one is the "ones" die.

sp-04334.description_en: Predicts the most probable actions of the target in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on targets or what spell). This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent after hearing what the target has decided to do.

sp-04335.description_en: Causes the caster to be excluded from random rolls made concerning a group of which the caster is a member. If the GM rolls randomly for the group concerning encounters, surprise attacks, random spell effects, random choosing of targets, etc., the caster is excluded from all such rolls, and his presence does not affect his group's rolls.

sp-04336.description_en: Caster causes terrible luck to come upon one target. Causes the target's next action to be resolved as if he rolled a 0 1.

sp-04337.description_en: Caster's luck versus one spell is altered. Caster may re-roll any one RR within the duration.

sp-04338.description_en: As Luck I, except roll is modified by +2.

sp-04339.description_en: Caster gains a Fate Point. This can only be done once per level.

sp-04340.description_en: Caster separates one target from destiny. This causes the target to lose one Fate Point.

sp-04341.description_en: Caster alters his own fate. Caster can cause any one roll made within the duration that is directly related to him to be rerolled.

sp-04342.description_en: Brings good fortune to one target. Causes the target's next action to be modified by +d100.

sp-04343.description_en: As Luck I, except roll is modified by +3.

sp-04344.description_en: Caster gains a +1 per level bonus to the next Divine Intervention maneuver that he makes.

sp-04346.description_en: Brings horrible luck to the target. Causes all the target's actions to be treated as if he rolled a 01.

sp-04347.description_en: Causes the target's next action to be resolved as if the target rolled a 100.

sp-04730.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of+ 10 to his next maneuver using a skill in the Urban skill category.

sp-04731.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question (presuming that the target can understand the question).

sp-04732.description_en: Caster has a dream about what mission his deity or church might have for him next. The dream is vague, and the caster must figure out what the dream means.

sp-04733.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g., roll a 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).

sp-04734.description_en: Caster's next spell within the duration is cast as if the caster were shouting, but the spell does not make a sound.

sp-04736.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he takes a specific action.

sp-04737.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +30 to all maneuvers using the Religion skill for the duration.

sp-04738.description_en: As Urban Lore I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04739.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity). The target of the spell is stunned.

sp-04740.description_en: As Question I, except the target must respond to up to 10 single concept questions.

sp-04741.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any one dead target through the eyes of the deceased. He also gets a view of the killer (if any). The caster must be within 10 feet of the corpse. The corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster's level.

sp-04742.description_en: Caster can make contact with any one known target he is acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being.

sp-04743.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 5 minutes into the future.

sp-04744.description_en: As Holy Vision, except the caster is shown details about the mission, and the place to begin.

sp-04745.description_en: As Stunning, except the target is blinded for the duration.

sp-04747.description_en: Causes target to misperceive events. Caster can choose whether the target sees nothing or just something vague and different from an actual event. The spell cannot make out of place events seem normal (e.g. fighting will always be seen for what it is), but an intruder could be misperceived as a passing sentry.

sp-04748.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's "soul" is torn from his body; it remains in whatever place souls go for the duration of the spell. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. Target is unconscious until soul is restored. Even subconscious activities (i.e., healing, etc.) suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-04749.description_en: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any one dead target within 10 feet. Caster gets an understanding of the reason(s) the deceased died, exactly who the killer was (if any), and who was ultimately responsible (if anyone). Corpse may be of any age.

sp-04750.description_en: As Commune, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only one concept.

sp-04751.description_en: As Absolution, except "soul" can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-04752.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question. SPECIAL Nons

sp-04753.description_en: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster, and adds 5 to all of the caster's RRs versus spells. If the spells are cast by a Channeling spell user that is a member of the caster's current studied faith (see "The Mask" spell list), the bonuses become +10.

sp-04754.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any fear RRs.

sp-04755.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any poison RRs.

sp-04756.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.

sp-04757.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are +10 and + 15 respectively.

sp-04758.description_en: Grants +10 DB versus melee and missile attacks. Not cumulative with Aura or Blur spells.

sp-04759.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10 feet of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-04760.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 3.

sp-04761.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-04762.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are + 15 and +20, respectively.

sp-04763.description_en: For the duration, the caster gains a bonus of +30 against any attempts by others to convert him. The same bonus applies to the caster's RRs vs. spells of any other religion that attempt to convert or corrupt him.

sp-04764.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 8.

sp-04765.description_en: As Deflections I, except affects two missiles.

sp-04766.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +15.

sp-04767.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are + 20 and +30, respectively.

sp-04768.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects two attacks.

sp-04769.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 12.

sp-04770.description_en: Gives the caster a bonus of +20 against any Absolution spells or against any Black Channel spells. This bonus is cumulative with other protection spells.

sp-04771.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04772.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 20.

sp-04773.description_en: As Protection I, except the bonuses are +30 and +50, respectively.

sp-04774.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04775.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list once per round. SPECIAL Nons

sp-04781.description_en: All of the caster's Tracking maneuvers receive a Memory's Path caster self 1 hr/lvl bonus of +50.

sp-04782.description_en: Detects all invisible objects or beings in the The Eye caster 100' varies area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 10'R each Tracking True caster self C round. All attacks against something so detected are modified by 50'R Perceive Power True 1 min/lvl(C) 500' -50. See Spell Law Section 15.5 for rules on invisibility. Location caster 300'
