sp-04784.description_en: As Detect Magic, except it will also give an caster varies self estimate of the power (i.e. the level) of the person, item, or spell caster self 1 rnd/lvl examined. " •1 ~•. '-' ~•I 1......

sp-04785.description_en: As Detect Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.

sp-04795.description_en: As Detect Enemies I, except for range and

sp-04789.description_en: Attempts to learn from the target's mind what this list once per round. Divine Status level he has. See Section 6.0 for more information on Divine Status.

sp-04790.description_en: Caster can remember an exact route he traveled, whether or not he was without one or more of his senses when he made his original journey (e.g. a 12th level caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip even if he had been blindfolded). To be effective, this spell must be cast within one month of the journey.

sp-04791.description_en: Caster receives a divine vision of one of the caster's "Marks" specified at the time of casting. The vision will only reveal general activities of the target (i.e., target is fighting, target is sleeping, target is gambling, etc.). The caster's "Mark" must be within range of this spell, location of the "Mark" will not be revealed.

sp-04792.description_en: As Tracking, except the bonus is +75.

sp-04793.description_en: As Perceive Power, except for range and area of effect.

sp-04794.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other

sp-04799.description_en: Caster studies the books, teachings, and churches of a given faith. A faith needs to be studied with this spell every day for a week. The caster may only have one faith studied in this way at a time.

sp-04800.description_en: This spell can either be cast as a spell to tell whether one is lying to the caster (granting a special bonus of + 15 to Lie Detection maneuvers), or as a spell to lie better to others (giving a special penalty of -15 to the Lie Detection maneuvers of those using the skill against the caster). Also provides a special bonus of +15 to resist spells designed to get the truth from the caster ( Question spells, etc.).

sp-04801.description_en: Caster studies a Channeling spell he can see, storing the image of it so that he can use it with the Spell Facade spells on this list. The caster can have as many spells studied as he has levels.

sp-04802.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect deepen. All Hiding maneuvers gain a bonus of +25 (+10 to Stalking maneuvers).

sp-04803.description_en: For the duration, all skills used to infiltrate other faiths gain a bonus of +10. Examples include, Acting, Duping, Diplomacy, Public Speaking, etc. "Infiltrating another faith" is defined as making others believe that you are a member of, or are sincerely interested in joining, their religion.

sp-04804.description_en: All sounds originating within the area of effect cannot be heard outside the area of effect. This results in a +25 bonus to Stalking maneuvers.

sp-04805.description_en: [RR Mod: -50) When tliis spell is cast on a person, it reveals the mannerisms and habits of a faith's follower to the caster, storing the images and knowledge of the target for use with the Follower Facade spell on this list. The caster can only have one such studied follower per three levels (round up).

sp-04806.description_en: For the duration, all "incoming" magical detection spells must make an RR versus the level of the caster or fail. In addition, all deeds performed while this spell is active are "shadowed" to divination spells. The information gained about the caster will be shrouded in shadows.

sp-04807.description_en: This spell is used to simulate the effects of another religion's "studied" spells. For example, if an order of Rangers wants proof that the caster is on their side, this spell can be used to simulate a Ranger spell (i.e. starting a fire, darkening an area). The simulated spell has no other property than to convince people. (This spell is purely an illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules.) This spell lasts as long as the "studied" spell or 1 minute per level (whichever is less).

sp-04808.description_en: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow, and are thus almost invisible in dark areas. In many situations, this could be handled with a Stalking and/or Hiding bonus between +25 and +75.

sp-04809.description_en: As Deception I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04810.description_en: Creates a thin fog in the air up to the area of effect (caster can choose to make it smaller). Normal visibility in the mist is about 3 feet.

sp-04811.description_en: As Divine Secrecy, except that if the incoming spell fails its RR, the caster of the incoming spell learns false information about the caster. (GM's discretion as to exactly what is learned.) In addition, all deeds performed while this spell is active are completely masked to divination spells.

sp-04812.description_en: As Silence I, except for area of effect.

sp-04813.description_en: Allows the caster to appear as any one type of follower that he has studied. Caster retains his size, and will not smell or feel like the follower. Caster will not appear as a specific person, only as a general follower, looking nothing like his normal self (i.e. this is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules).

sp-04814.description_en: As Deception I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04815.description_en: As White Lies, except the bonus is +50, or -50, as appropriate.

sp-04816.description_en: As Divine Obscurity, except that if the incoming spell misses its RR, then the caster of the incoming spell learns very misleading information about the caster. (GM's discretion as to exactly what is learned.)

sp-04817.description_en: As Spell Facade, except that caster Channels power straight from his deity to actually create the physical effects of the spell. This will provide such effects as giving heat to a fire or sound to a vacuum refilling, but the created effects will not deliver damage as the simulated spell (e.g., a simulated Fire Bolt will be hot, but not do damage).

sp-04818.description_en: As Mist, except for area of effect and duration. In addition, if the caster concentrates, he can see through the mist normally.

sp-04819.description_en: As Deception I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-04820.description_en: For the duration, caster cannot be the target of detection spells, and his deeds performed while this spell is active cannot be learned through any divination spell, nor can they be learned from the caster at a later date by another person (they cannot be learned by any spell, skill, torture, etc.). SPECIAL Non

sp-04821.description_en: Adds + 10 to one maneuver the round after this spell is cast. No other action can be performed until this maneuver is resolved.

sp-04823.description_en: Caster can ignore up to -10 in accrued penalties from injuries or concussion hit loss.

sp-04824.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round; for 1 hour, caster can move at no more than a walking pace, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.

sp-04825.description_en: Caster is relieved of one round's worth of accumulated stun effects.

sp-04826.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-04827.description_en: Will reduce damage to the caster by 1 hit every minute as long as the caster concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him without concentration.

sp-04828.description_en: As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is bleeding up to 3 hits per round.

sp-04829.description_en: As Tolerance I, except up to -20 in accrued penalties can be ignored.

sp-04830.description_en: As Inner Focus I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04831.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 50% can be sustained.

sp-04832.description_en: As Regeneration /, except caster's damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute of concentration.

sp-04834.description_en: Caster can cure any one paralysis problem.

sp-04835.description_en: As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e. hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-04836.description_en: As Unpain I, except an additional 75% can be sustained.

sp-04837.description_en: As Tolerance I, except up to 30 points in accrued penalties can be ignored.

sp-04838.description_en: As Stun Relief, except relieves all accrued stun.

sp-04839.description_en: Caster can remove any one poison from his system.

sp-04840.description_en: As Inner Focus I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-04841.description_en: As Regeneration I, except caster's damage is reduced by 5 hits per minute of concentration.

sp-04842.description_en: As Tolerance I, except up to -50 in accrued penalties can be ignored.

sp-04843.description_en: The caster is aided by his deity for the duration of one mission (GM's discretion as to what a mission constitutes). The caster ignores all penalties from wounds and hit loss, and he can take double his normal hits total before falling unconscious. He is also at + 10 activity to all actions that further the mission.

sp-04844.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +20 to any Ambush maneuvers made within the duration. This spell adds no ranks to caster's Ambush skill, it only helps to succeed in the Ambush maneuver roll.

sp-04845.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +20 to any Silent Kill maneuvers made within the duration.

sp-04846.description_en: Caster can summon a weapon within range to his hand. The weapon travels at 100 feet per round (with no acceleration), avoiding obstacles if possible. If the weapon is restrained, it cannot break free.

sp-04847.description_en: I -The next attack against the caster's "Mark" (see The Eye Spell List) or against an "enemy" of the caster's religion inflicts an additional Holy Weapon critical that is two levels less severe than any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, a 'B' critical would deliver an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would deliver an additional 'A' critical with a special modification of-50.) The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-04848.description_en: Any attacks made by the caster receive a special bonus of +10.

sp-04849.description_en: The caster can strike one target up to 100 feet away with a melee weapon. The weapon never leaves the caster's hands; the caster swings the weapon through the air and the wounds mysteriously appear on the target. The caster must have an unobstructed line of sight to the target. Normally, this attack cannot parry or be parried. The target will be without his shield defensive bonus (and perhaps without other DB modifica· tions at the GM's discretion). The caster may only use one quarter of his normal OB. Spells that modify the caster's melee attack will work with this spell, but melee combat skills (such as Ambush) may not be used.

sp-04850.description_en: Target gets an illogical fear of the caster. The target will be at a -10 on all actions that affect the caster.

sp-04851.description_en: The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration.

sp-04852.description_en: Target suffers a 'B' Holy Spell critical strike each time he tries to cast a Channeling spell or use the Channeling skill. If the target fails his RR by more than 20, he is unaware that this spell has been cast upon him.

sp-04853.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is one level less severe.

sp-04854.description_en: As Blessed Attack I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04855.description_en: As Phantom Strike I, except for range, and that the caster may use one half of his normal OB.

sp-04856.description_en: Caster is covered in holy flames. If the caster's "Mark" or an "enemy" of the caster's religion is within 10' of the caster or makes contact with the caster, he must make an RR or suffer a 'C' Holy Spell critical.

sp-04857.description_en: As Mythical Fear I, except the penalty is -20.

sp-04858.description_en: As Faith Chains I, except that the effect is a 'C' critical.

sp-04859.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-04860.description_en: As Blessed Attack I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04862.description_en: The target of this spell must be an "enemy" of the caster's religion, and also be one of the caster's current "Marks." Caster causes holy fires to envelope the target. The target suffers an 'E' Holy Spell critical and takes d10 hits for every 5 points the RR failed by.

sp-04863.description_en: As Mythical Fear/, except the penalty is -30.

sp-04864.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is one level greater in severity (with a maximum of an 'E' critical).

sp-04865.description_en: As Phantom Strike /, except for range, and the caster may use his full normal OB.

sp-04866.description_en: All attacks made by the caster versus the caster's "Mark" or against one "enemy" of the caster's religion are resolved as "slaying" attacks.

sp-03233.description_en: Allows caster to take the physical form of a Jellyfish (the caster gains the abilities of this new form). The transformation takes ten complete rounds of concentration to occur.

sp-03234.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a normal Starfish, and the transformation takes only nine rounds.

sp-03235.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a small fish, and the transformation takes only eight rounds. Upon reaching 5th level the caster may use the medium variety and upon reaching 10th level the caster may use the large variety.

sp-03236.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a normal Crab, and the transformation takes only seven rounds.

sp-03237.description_en: As jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Snake, and the transformation takes only six rounds.

sp-03238.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of an Eei and the transformation takes only five rounds. Upon reaching 5th level use Moray Eel stats, upon reaching 10th level use Conger Eel stats and upon reaching 15th level use Electric Eel stats.

sp-03239.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Turtle. Upon reaching 10th level use large Turtle stats, and the transformation takes only four rounds.

sp-03240.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of an Octopus, and the transformation takes only three rounds. Upon reaching 10th level use Medium stats and upon reaching 15th level use Large stats.

sp-03241.description_en: As Jellyfish Form, except caster takes the form of a Portugese Man-o-war, and the transformation takes only two rounds.

sp-03243.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Dolphin. Up to 9th level use River Dolphin stats. Upon reaching 10th level use Dolphin stats, upon reaching 15th level use Porpoise stats and upon reaching 25th level use Killer Whale stats.

sp-03244.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Ray. Up to 5th level use Manta Ray stats, upon reaching 10th level use Sting Ray stats, upon reaching 15th level use Electric Ray stats and upon reaching 20th level use Sawfish stats.

sp-03245.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Water Hound.

sp-03246.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sailfish or Swordfish.

sp-03247.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Merman.

sp-03248.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Shark. Up to 15th level use Small stats. Thereafter use Large stats.

sp-03249.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Lake Worm.

sp-03250.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Whale. Up to 15th level use Toothed, Small stats, upon reaching 30th level use Toothed, Large stats and upon reaching 50th level use Baleen stats.

sp-03251.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Troll.

sp-03253.description_en: Form - As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Dragon Salamander.

sp-03254.description_en: As Seal Form, except caster takes the form of a Sea Drake.

sp-03266.description_en: As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 20.

sp-03267.description_en: Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, teleportal, or other magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR versus the level of the caster with a special modifier of-30. Failure indicates that the being takes an 'E' Impact critical and does not pass through the gate.

sp-03268.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type IV entity.

sp-03269.description_en: As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity 'E', and it affects up to a Type V entity.

sp-03270.description_en: As Entity Protection I, except the modifier is 25.

sp-03271.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type V entity.

sp-03272.description_en: As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity 'E', and it affects up to a Type VI entity.

sp-03273.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type VI entity.

sp-03274.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects any one entity, and lasts forever.

sp-03255.description_en: Detects the presence of all "entities" that this spell list affects that are within the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-03256.description_en: Subtracts 5 from all attacks against the target made by entities.

sp-03257.description_en: All Type I Entities in the area of effect take an 'A' Holy Spell critical. Furthermore, as long as the caster concentrates, Type I entities that are in the area of effect may not leave without making an RR, and Type I entities that are outside the area of effect may not enter without making an RR.

sp-03258.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Banishes the target Type I entity from this plane of existence for the duration of the spell. The caster also learns the name of the entity and may ask it one question which it must answer truthfully.

sp-03259.description_en: As Entity Protedion I, except the modifier is 10.

sp-03260.description_en: As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity 'B', and it affects up to a Type II entity.

sp-03261.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type II entity.

sp-03262.description_en: As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity •c;•, and it affects up to a Type III entity.

sp-03264.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Banish Entity I, except affects up to a Type III entity.

sp-03265.description_en: As Repel Entity I, except the critical is of severity 'D', and it affects up to a Type IV entity.

sp-03275.description_en: Leaves an invisible marker on a specific target. Caster will always know the distance and direction of marked individuals. This marker also alerts the caster if any 'marked' target is currently dying. Caster may only have one marker per level.

sp-03276.description_en: Restores d 10 exhaustion points to target.

sp-03277.description_en: Creates a magical 'stretcher' that can be used to 'float' a given number of bodies. Will carry one body (no larger than man-sized) for every three levels of the caster.

sp-03278.description_en: When this spell is cast, a first-level spell that the caster begins to cast the next round will be channeled to another spell user of the Channeling realm. The channeled spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately (i.e., the receiving spell user is now treated as the caster of the spell). All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver of the spell or know exactly where he is (direction and distance, or specific location). The receiver must know exactly what spell is coming. For example, if a spell-user was at a certain altar at midnight of a full moon ready to receive a spell; then another spell user who knew this could use Channels to send him a spell.

sp-03279.description_en: Caster receives knowledge of one target on which he has used the Marker spell. This spell provides detailed information about the target's health.

sp-03282.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a third-level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03283.description_en: Caster can double the potency of any one herb (growing or dead). This spell may be employed only once per herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.

sp-03284.description_en: Caster receives a quick vision of one target on which he has used the Marker spell. The vision will also show a 10'R area surrounding the target.

sp-03285.description_en: Gives the caster a special bonus of +25 to any Second Aid static maneuvers and +50 to any First Aid static maneuvers.

sp-03286.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a seventh level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03288.description_en: Caster may send any vision previously gained by Healer's Vision to anyone of whom he knows the exact location, or anyone on whom has used a Marker spell.

sp-03289.description_en: Gives the caster a special bonus of +25 to any Surgery static maneuvers, +SO to any Second Aid static maneuvers, and +75 to any First Aid static maneuvers.

sp-03291.description_en: As Herb Mastery II, except potency is five times normal.

sp-03292.description_en: Target item (weighing no more than 10 pounds) will return to or from the casters predefined Sanctuary.

sp-03293.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a tenth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03294.description_en: Caster is returned to a predefined place (this is a type of teleportation). Caster must have lived in the place for at least 30 days (meditating for 16 hours each day) to define this as his wsanctuary." A spell user may only have one such place defined at any one time.

sp-03295.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a twentieth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03296.description_en: For up to 1 round per level after he has used Sanctuary, the caster may cast this spell and be returned to within 20' of the point at which he used Sanctuary.

sp-03297.description_en: Allows the caster to mentally "link up" with all other 'Marked' targets in the given area of effect. The linked targets may freely transfer power points, spells, and information to each other via this link.

sp-03298.description_en: Allows caster to communicate with his deity on how best to conduct his divine duties. He will receive a general feeling about how best to run the ceremonies of his religion so as to increase the faith and dedication of its members. Will also add a special bonus of +10 to any Religion static maneuvers.

sp-03299.description_en: Puts the blessing of the caster's church on an important event. Any activities at the event will receive a special bonus of +5 to appropriate maneuvers.

sp-03300.description_en: Seals marriage vows and renders the union acceptable by the caster's deity.

sp-03303.description_en: The target's vestment becomes AT 3 with a special bonus of +10 to DB. For the duration of the spell, the vestment will resist all soiling. Will not clean a dirty vestment. The vestment must first be consecrated with Holy Vestment.

sp-03304.description_en: Places the target under a vow to accomplish a goal for the church. Violation will result in penalties and consequences to be determined by the church (i.e., the GM). Success or failure may also result in changes in the target's Divine Status.

sp-03305.description_en: Converts 4 ounces of clear spring water to holy water. Holy water is used for ceremonies and to combat Undead. Undead take 'B' Holy Spell criticals when splashed. The water should be stored in as pure a container as possible or it will lose its potency quickly.

sp-03306.description_en: Errant member of caster's faith is placed under a probation. Target may still attend ceremonies, but is prevented from participating and gaining benefits of attending. This spell can be cast again on target to reverse the effects.

sp-03307.description_en: Target becomes officially recognized as a priest of his faith.

sp-03308.description_en: As Vestments of Combat, exceptthe vestment is treated as AT 4 with a special bonus of +20 to DB.

sp-03309.description_en: As Holy Water I, except the holy water inflicts a 'C' Holy Spell critical against Undead.

sp-03310.description_en: Makes a Channeling spell user the proper leader of a congregation. This leader is blessed with special divine knowledge about the worshipers under his watch. He will generally know the Divine Status of all people for whom he is responsible.

sp-03311.description_en: Errant member of caster's faith is removed from caster's church. He is banned from all ceremonies. This spell can be cast again on target to reverse the effects.

sp-03312.description_en: This ceremony is used to advance a member of caster's faith one level of Divine Status. It may take more than a mortal to grant the higher ranks of status (GM's discretion).

sp-03313.description_en: Creates a protective, immobile, hemispherical shell with a S0'R around the caster. Creatures "of darkness" in the sphere must make an RR each round or they will take a 'C' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03314.description_en: Target is made the church-sanctioned ruler of a people.

sp-03315.description_en: Apostate member of caster's faith is branded with a zymbol of the church's displeasure with a mark on target's palm, cheek, forehead, etc. He is banned from all ceremonies, and loses all Channeling PPs. This spell can be cast again on target to reverse the effects.

sp-03316.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to any Magic Ritual maneuver made to further the goals of his faith. The maneuver must be made before this spell expires.

sp-03318.description_en: As Holy Water I, except the holy water inflicts a 'D' Holy Spell critical against Undead.

sp-03319.description_en: Summons crusaders, Paladins, Priests, and other Channelers of the caster's faith to fight against a common enemy, infidels, etc. The result may be a crusade. GM's discretion. SO. Invocation-Opens a direct channel to the caster's deity. Results depend on the deity's personality, motives, and powers. SPECIAL Nons 1) Certain spells (marked with a V in the sub-type) require that the caster wear a vestment that has been consecrated by Holy Vestmmt. A caster may only have one vestment at a time, and to be usable it must be dean (i.e., excessive dirt, sweat, etc. will make the vestment unusable until deaned and the vestment is consecrated again with the Holy Vestment spell). If the vestment is worn into battle in connection with Vestmmt of Combat or Vestmmt of War, the vestment will remain dean for the duration of those spells. 2) Vestments created by this list can normally only be worn by members of the caster's faith. 3) For level purposes, treat holy water as having a level equal to the level of the Holy Water spell used to create it (i.e., either eighth, twelfth, or twenty.fifth). 4) For more information on Holy Water and Vestment spells, see Treasure Companion Section 4.2.

sp-03321.description_en: Caster cleanses his thoughts and spirit to reduce the chance of him tainting a summoned spirit. This spell reduces the chance of the caster tainting the spirit by 50%. This spell must be cast prior to summoning a spirit.

sp-03322.description_en: Caster removes d 10 levels of taint from a given spirit. This spell is used usually after, and sometimes before, a spirit will do something requested by the caster. Each level of taint that a spirit has gives it a special bonus of +5 to its RR

sp-03323.description_en: Caster's spirit leaves his body to wander the physical world, and can travel at normal walking speed for the duration of this spell. While in spirit form, the caster is invisible, and cannot affect the physical world in any way. The caster's spirit cannot do anything that his normal physical body cannot do (e.g. fly, walk through walls, etc.). If the caster's spirit has not returned to the caster's body before the end of the spell, the caster must make an RR versus his own level or he will die. This RR must be made every minute past the end of the spell in which the caster's spirit is not back in his body.

sp-03324.description_en: The caster will have a vision related to a topic chosen prior to this spell being cast. A single topic may be the subject of one vision per day, additional attempts will repeat the previous vision. Note that this spell will always take an hour, even though the visions created by it may seem to last but a moment, or an eternity.

sp-03328.description_en: When cast prior to any other chant from this list, (which must be cast within one minute of finishing this spell) the caster may include in the chant up to one additional target per every five full levels of the caster. Each participant must be touching at least one other participant of the spell.

sp-03329.description_en: As Spirit Walk I, except that caster may move at double his normal walking pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of 10 feet per round.

sp-03330.description_en: As Warning Chant, except that the caster will know exactly what condition was broken. This will give the caster all information that he would be able to normally detect using his senses (e.g., if a person entered the radius of the Awareness Chant, he would know who entered and from what direction, but if that person were invisible, he would only know that the radius of the spell had been crossed and where it was crossed; he would not be able to tell who broke the condition of the spell).

sp-03331.description_en: As Vision Chant I, except that the caster can have up to three visions, each lasting one hour each. Each vision must be on a separate topic.

sp-03332.description_en: As Healing Chant II, except that all wounds are healed at a rate of three times normal.

sp-03333.description_en: When cast, this spell instantly returns the caster's spirit to his body without penalty. This works for both Spirit Walk and Spirit Travel spells.

sp-03334.description_en: As Spirit Walk II, except that the caster may move at up to triple his normal walking pace, and may pass through non-magical substances (e.g. walls) at a rate of one foot per round.

sp-03336.description_en: As Vision Chant III, except that the caster may have up to five separate dreams.

sp-03337.description_en: As Healing Chant ll, except that the caster may heal at up to four times his normal healing rate.

sp-03338.description_en: As Spirit Walk III, except that the caster may move at up to four times his normal walking pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of up to 100 feet per round.

sp-03339.description_en: As Vision Chant Ill, except that the caster may have visions relating to up to ten different topics.

sp-03340.description_en: As Spirit Walk IV, except that the caster may move at up to five times his base walking rate, and he is able to pass through non-magical solid matter at a rate of up to 10 feet per round.

sp-03341.description_en: As Healing Chant IV, except the caster may heal himself at five times his normal healing rate.

sp-03343.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to his History (Battles) maneuvers.

sp-03344.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to on his Military Organization maneuvers.

sp-03345.description_en: Grants the caster a special bonus of +10 bonus to all recruitment activities in one settlement.

sp-03347.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +10 to his Tactics maneuvers.

sp-03348.description_en: Caster's entire unit gains a special bonus of +5 to all melee attacks and morale maneuvers this round.

sp-03349.description_en: The caster becomes more easily recognizable as the leader of a unit. Commands from the caster carry more weight. This adds a special bonus of +10 to the caster's Leadership maneuvers.

sp-03350.description_en: All maneuvers using skills in the Awareness group that relate to battle are made with a special bonus of +15.

sp-03351.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to any Frenzy maneuver performed the round after this spell is cast.

sp-03352.description_en: Caster's unit gains a special bonus of +25 to any morale maneuvers for the duration. This bonus also applies to RRs versus fear and influence effects.

sp-03353.description_en: As Troop Fanning, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03354.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +10.

sp-03355.description_en: Caster's voice is amplified so that it can be heard over the din of battle in the given area. This spell confers no command ability, but merely allows the caster to be heard.

sp-03356.description_en: As Clarion Call, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03357.description_en: Causes the members of caster's unit to become aware of the next battle maneuver that the caster performs as their leader (that is performed within one minute of completing this spell). They will be notified of an impending regroup, rally, or retreat and their part in it, granting a special bonus of +30 to the maneuver.

sp-03358.description_en: As Tactics, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03359.description_en: As Battle Awareness, except that caster is also aware of the general health (unwounded, lightly wounded, seriously wounded, unconscious, dying) of each of the members of his unit.

sp-03360.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +15.

sp-03361.description_en: As Leadership, except that the bonus is +30.

sp-03362.description_en: Allows the caster to perceive a battlefield area from a different perspective. This should be an extremely good view of the situation and may grant the caster bonuses to his Tactics maneuvers and other maneuvers as the situation dictates and as the GM allows. For example, General Durathor casts this spell and is able to observe the battle from a height of 500 feet over the center of the battle.

sp-03363.description_en: Causes caster's unit to have perfect morale and be immune to fear and influence effects for the duration. The caster must be alive and visible to the unit for the benefits to be received.

sp-03364.description_en: As War Cry I, except the bonus is +25.

sp-03365.description_en: Caster takes on the appearance of (or temporarily becomes at the GM's discretion) an Avatar to his deity. This causes friendly troops within sight to have perfect morale, and also gain a special bonus of +30 to OB, DB, and RRs. The caster gains the same bonuses. The spell also opens a channel to the caster's deity, in which the deity can direct the caster in battle if it is necessary. SPECIAL Non

sp-03366.description_en: Target is physically aged d10 months in one minute.

sp-03367.description_en: Caster touches target and destroys his life force. If the target fails his RR by 1-10, he takes an 'A' Cold critical; by 11-20, he takes a 'B' Cold critical; by 21-30, he takes a 'C Cold critical; by 31-40, he takes a 'D' Cold critical; by 41 +, he takes an 'E' Cold critical.

sp-03368.description_en: Target loses some of his life Essence. Target subtracts d10 points from his temporary Constitution. If the target's temporary constitution drops below 0, his soul has withered away and he becomes a Class I Created Undead.

sp-03369.description_en: Target suffers a 'B' critical strike on any spell critical hit table of the caster's choice. (The Gamemaster has discretion as to what tables are available for the caster to use.)

sp-03370.description_en: As Destroy Life Essence I, except 2d 10 points are lost, and target may become a Class II Created Undead.

sp-03372.description_en: As Lesser Death, except critical is of severity 'C.'

sp-03373.description_en: As Destroy Life Essence I, except 3d 10 points are lost, and target may become a Class III Created Undead.

sp-03374.description_en: All wounds on the target will take twice as long to heal. (Note: Healing time is based upon the guidelines presented in RMFRP Section 24.1. This spell will not affect any form of healing other than normal, mundane time.)

sp-03375.description_en: As Lesser Death, except critical is of severity 'D.'

sp-03376.description_en: As Aging I, except target ages 3d10 years.

sp-03378.description_en: As Lesser Death, except critical is of severity 'E'.

sp-03379.description_en: As Death's Call, except wounds will take four times as long to heal.

sp-03380.description_en: Any spell up to 10th level may be cast from this list, with a range of 300 feet.

sp-03381.description_en: As Aging I, except target ages 1Od10 years.

A single topic may be the subject of one vision per day, additional attempts will end up repeating the previous vision. Note that this spell will always take an hour, even though the visions created by it may seem to last but a moment, or an eternity.

sp-03547.description_en: For as long as the caster concentrates, any wounds he has will heal at double normal rate. This spell will also stop fatal (non-instantaneous) criticals from killing the caster, providing he stays in the trance long enough to heal the death dealing damage. Note that healing time is based upon the guidelines presented in RMFRP Section 24.1. This spell will not effect any form of healing other than normal, mundane time.
