The weapon attacks on its normal table with the following modifications: up to one tenth maximum range +20 up to quarter maximum range +10 up to half maximum range -20 up to maximum range -50

sp-03580.description_en: Caster's weapon is personalized to himself. Others that pick up the weapon must make an RR or take a 'C' Holy Spell critical. Anyone who is an "enemy" of the caster's faith or a creature "of darkness" who picks up the weapon must make a RR or take an 'E' Holy Spell critical instead.

sp-03581.description_en: Caster's weapon will "dance" and defend the caster's body if the caster falls unconscious. The weapon will have an OB of half the caster's normal OB. It has an AT of 20, a DB of 0, and can take 10 hits per level of the caster (before this spell is dispelled).

sp-03582.description_en: Caster's next attack this round delivers triple concussion hits.

sp-03583.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-03584.description_en: Returns caster's weapon to his hand, via teleport, from any place, up to 1 mile away per level of the caster.

sp-03585.description_en: As Parrying Weapon, except the bonus is +1 for eveiy 2 points of OB.

sp-03586.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is one level greater in severity (with an 'E' critical inflicting an 'E' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of +10.)

sp-03587.description_en: Caster's next melee strike this round is treated as "Slaying" for purposes of resolving criticals against Large and Super Large creatures.

sp-03588.description_en: Caster's weapon will deliver Slaying criticals in addition to any normal criticals delivered to one target of the caster's choosing. SrECIAL Norrs

sp-03589.description_en: Gives the caster a 95% chance of predicting the time and severity of any winds or storms(+/- 15 minutes) over the next 24 hours.

sp-03590.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-03591.description_en: Target will float upon the air. While floating, the target is at the mercy of the prevailing winds and cannot control any aspect of his flight without access to some other motive force (i.e., being towed, etc.).

sp-03592.description_en: Caster causes a breeze to come forth that will drive out any gaseous matter (clouds, etc.) and subtract 10 from all missile attacks. Once set, the direction of the breeze will not change. Wind speed is between 10-20 miles per hour.

sp-03593.description_en: As Air Wall I, except for duration.

sp-03594.description_en: _ Caster summons a concentrated blast of air to strike one target. Target must resist or suffer a 'B' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03595.description_en: Caster creates an intense, directed updraft of air that can support a weight of up to 500 pounds (so long as the weight is concentrated in the area of effect). The combination of height lifted in feet times weight in pounds is always equal to 500. For example, a 100-pound man would be lifted 5 feet into the air; a 500 pound object would be lifted 1 foot into the air; and a 2 pound object wold be lifted 250 feet into the air. Any unwilling target may make an RR to remove himself from the area of effect.

sp-03596.description_en: As Breeze Call, except for area of effect, range, it subtracts 30 from all missile attacks, and the wind speed is between 21-31 miles per hour.

sp-03597.description_en: Caster can control the speed and direction of normal winds. Caster can increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mile per hour times his level (e.g., if the wind speed is normally 20 miles per hour, a 15th level caster could change the wind speed to any speed between 5 and 35 miles per hour). By directing the wind against missile attacks, he can cause a -1 modifier for each mph of wind speed.

sp-03598.description_en: As Air Blast I, except it delivers a 'C' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03599.description_en: Target can walk on calm air. This spell only allows for horizontal movement. Vertical movement must be achieved by other means.

sp-03600.description_en: As Air Wall I, except for area of effect and duration.

sp-03601.description_en: As Breeze Call, except for area of effect, range, it subtracts 80 from all missile attacks, and the wind speed is 32-63 miles per hour. This spell may have various other effects on movement and combat (GM's discretion).

sp-03602.description_en: As Air Blast I, except it delivers a 'D' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03603.description_en: As Wind Mastery I, except caster can vary wind speed by 2 miles per hour per level.

sp-03604.description_en: As Pillar of Wind, except the combination of height lifted in feet times weight in pounds is equal to 1000.

sp-03605.description_en: Caster creates a small, but very powerful windstorm. The storm moves randomly about at a rate of 10' per round. All struck by or within the Cyclone, receive a 'D' Unbalancing critical and are thrown 5d10 feet away from the Cyclone.

sp-03606.description_en: As Windwalking, except target can move at a running pace.

sp-03607.description_en: Caster may call forth a wind storm with maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to circumstance (and the GM's discretion).

sp-03608.description_en: As Cyclone, except for area of effect and range, it delivers an 'E' Impact critical, and it throws targets 10d10 feet away.

sp-03609.description_en: As Windrunning, except target can run up to twice normal speed on calm air and expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.

sp-03610.description_en: As Air Blast I, except for range, and it delivers an 'E' Unbalancing critical.

sp-03611.description_en: Caster summons a chariot made of pure air that is solid enough for the caster and one other being per ten full levels of experience to ride in. The air chariot has a movement rate of 50 feet per round per level of the caster.

sp-03612.description_en: Detects the total number of "enemies" (giving approximate direction and distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily represented type of enemy (by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a different 50'R each round.

sp-03613.description_en: As Deted Enemies I, except it detects creatures "of darkness."

sp-03614.description_en: Adds +15 to the caster's melee or missile attack for the current round. -----~

sp-03615.description_en: Caster calls down a vertical column of holy light upon one target. Target must make a RR or suffer an 'A' Holy Spell critical. If the creature is an "enemy" or "of darkness," the RR is modified by -20, and the critical is of severity 'B.'

sp-03616.description_en: The caster's next melee or missile attack against an "enemy" of the caster's religion or a creature "of darkness" inflicts an additional Holy Weapon critical that is two levels lower than any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, a 'B' critical would inflict an 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -50).The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-03617.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03618.description_en: Target "enemy" or target creature "of darkness" takes 2d10 hits. He also operates at -20 to all actions for the duration.

sp-03619.description_en: As Holy Blast I, except that the critical is a 'B' for normal targets, and a 'C' if an "enemy" or "of darkness."

sp-03620.description_en: As Deted Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.

sp-03621.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +25.

sp-03622.description_en: As Holy Strike I, except the critical is one level lower in severity (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03623.description_en: As Holy Blast I, except the critical is a 'C' for normal targets, and a 'D' if an "enemy" or "of darkness."

sp-03624.description_en: As Heathen 's]udgment I, except target takes 4d10 hits and the penalty is -40.

sp-03625.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03626.description_en: As Heathen's Judgment I, except target takes 8d10 hits and is paralyzed.

sp-03627.description_en: As Holy Blast I, except that the critical is a 'D' for normal targets, and an 'E' if an "enemy" or "of darkness."

sp-03628.description_en: As Heathen's Judgment I, except target takes 6d10 hits and the penalty is -60

sp-03629.description_en: As Holy Attack I, except the bonus is +35.

sp-03630.description_en: As Deted Enemies I, except for range and area of effect.

sp-03631.description_en: As Holy Blast I, except that the critical is an 'E' for normal targets, and two 'E' criticals if an "enemy" or "of darkness."

sp-03632.description_en: As Heathen's ]udgment I, except target takes 10d10 hits and is knocked unconscious.

sp-03633.description_en: As Holy Blast IV, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-03634.description_en: Caster exposes all within the area of effect to the raw power of his deity. All in the area of effect must make a RR. Failure indicates one 'E' Holy Spell critical for evezy 10 failure. (Failure by 1-10 = 1 critical; by 11-20 = 2 criticals; etc.) The caster is immune to the damage. Creatures "of darkness" and "enemies" of the caster suffer a special penalty of -20 to their RR. SPECIAL Nons

sp-03635.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of + 15 to any Animal Mastery maneuvers that deal with horses.

sp-03636.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any Animal Healing maneuvers performed on horses.

sp-03637.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to all Riding maneuvers for the duration.

sp-03638.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to all attempts to track someone who is riding a horse.

sp-03639.description_en: Adds +20 to the caster's Mounted Attack combat maneuvers for the current round.

sp-03640.description_en: Caster's horse can travel at double its normal rate and spend exhaustion points as if it were walking. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is canceled.

sp-03641.description_en: Caster can ride at a normal pace without leaving tracks or other visible signs of his passing. This can normally be resolved as a special penalty of -60 to the Tracking maneuvers of those who attempt to track the caster using mainly visual signs.

sp-03642.description_en: As Riding I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03643.description_en: Caster can ride silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more then 10 feet from his body.

sp-03644.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +30; in addition, the charge attack delivers an Unbalancing critical two levels lower in severity to any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Unbalancing critical, a 'B' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -50). The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-03645.description_en: Caster can "call" any one known specific horse that the caster has ridden before. If it is physically possible, the animal will come to him if the horse is within range when this spell is cast.

sp-03646.description_en: As Charging I, except affects up to one target per level.

sp-03647.description_en: As Riding/, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03648.description_en: Caster's horse can travel at triple its normal rate and not spend any exhaustion points. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is canceled.

sp-03649.description_en: As Riding II, except up to one target per level is affected.

sp-03650.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +40; in addition, caster delivers an Unbalancing critical one level less in severity to any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Unbalancing critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03651.description_en: As Hide Tracks, except it affects one horse per level.

sp-03652.description_en: As Stamina, except it affects one horse per level.

sp-03653.description_en: As Horse Calling, except it calls up to one horse per level (up to ~ ' as many are as are able to come).

sp-03654.description_en: As Riding I, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03655.description_en: As Charging I, except the bonus is +50; in addition, caster delivers an Unbalancing critical of equal severity to any normal critical delivered.

sp-03656.description_en: As Charging II, except affects up to one target per level.

sp-03657.description_en: As Hide Tracks and Silent Ride, except it affects one horse and rider per level of the caster and each horse is allowed to ride at double normal movement rate and not break the effects of the spell. SrtctAL Non

sp-03658.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 bonus for all Tracking maneuvers.

sp-03659.description_en: Adds +15 to the caster's missile attack for the current round.

sp-03660.description_en: Caster can monitor animate activity in the area of effect (i.e., he will be aware of subtle movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot move.

sp-03661.description_en: Removes any diseases or poisons from one animal that the caster has killed.

sp-03662.description_en: As Tracker I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-03663.description_en: Makes one wooden weapon difficult to break for the duration. That weapon receives a special modification of+ 75 to any strength checks for the duration.

sp-03664.description_en: Caster's next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) has all range penalties halved (round up).

sp-03665.description_en: Caster learns origin of tracks and acquires a visual image of the one who left them. Caster will gain a special bonus of +25 when tracking this particular being or animal.

sp-03666.description_en: As Aiming I, except the bonus is +25.

sp-03667.description_en: Caster receives special bonus of+ 25 to his Fletching skill.

sp-03668.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of+ 30 to any Hiding or Stalking maneuvers for the duration. Caster's scent is also masked, resulting in all attempts to track the caster by smell receiving a special modification of -50.

sp-03669.description_en: As Nature's Awareness I, except for area of effect.

sp-03670.description_en: Caster receives special bonus of +25 to his Bowing skill.

sp-03671.description_en: Caster acquires a visual image of all beings or animals who left tracks in the area. This provides a +50 bonus when later tracking any of these beings or animals. If more than one being or animal has left tracks, the caster will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest image).

sp-03672.description_en: As Aiming I, except the bonus is +35.

sp-03673.description_en: Caster's next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) has all range penalties quartered (round up).

sp-03674.description_en: As Hiding, except the bonus is +50, and caster's scent is completely neutralized resulting in all attempts to track the caster by smell receiving a special modification of -100.

sp-03675.description_en: Caster's next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) inflicts a 'C' Holy Weapon critical in addition to any other critical delivered.

sp-03676.description_en: As Nature's Awareness/, except for area of effect.

sp-03677.description_en: As Aiming I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-03678.description_en: Caster's next missile attack (within the duration of this spell) inflicts an 'E' Holy Weapon critical in addition to any other critical delivered.

sp-03679.description_en: As Tracker I, except the bonus is +100.

sp-03680.description_en: Caster may use one lower level spell from this list each round.

sp-03681.description_en: All insects flee the area. All insects with a level will receive a RR.

sp-03682.description_en: Caster summons 1d100 Type I insects from the surrounding area. Caster has limited control over the summoned insects. They will follow simple, one-word commands (e.g., fly, eat, stay, etc.).

sp-03683.description_en: As Summon Insects I, except it summons Type II insects.

sp-03684.description_en: For the duration, caster receives an additional RR versus all poisons.

sp-03685.description_en: As Summon Insects I, except it summons Type III insects.

sp-03686.description_en: As Repel Insects, except for area of effect.

sp-03688.description_en: Caster causes one insect to grow to a Small size. The insect will be capable of attacking on an attack table appropriate to its type (e.g., pincer, stinger, bite).

sp-03689.description_en: As Summon Insects[, except it summons Type IV insects.

sp-03690.description_en: Caster either has total control over all normal insects in the area, or one Small-size insect within the radius.

sp-03691.description_en: Caster takes on one aspect of an insect (eyes, stinger, etc.). If used in combat, the caster may make Medium attacks (of some appropriate type).

sp-03692.description_en: As Insect Growth [, except that size is Medium.

sp-03693.description_en: One group (d100 times ten) of up to Type II insects is summoned and sent on some quest which it will relentlessly pursue until finished. The target of the quest must be visible to the caster when this spell is cast. There must be enough available insects in the surrounding area when this spell is cast, or it has no effect.

sp-03695.description_en: As Insect Control I, except for area of effect, and it can control up to one Medium-sized insect or two Small sized insects.

sp-03697.description_en: As Minor Insect Plague, except up to Type IV insects may be summoned.

sp-03698.description_en: As Insect Growth I, except that size is Large.

sp-03699.description_en: As Insect Control I, except for area of effect, and it can control up to one Large-sized insect or a combination of up to two Medium-sized or four Small-sized insects.

sp-03700.description_en: Caster summons 10,000-100,000 insects of all types to perform special missions for the caster (e.g., block out the sun, destroy crops, defend against an invading army). GM's discretion.

sp-03701.description_en: As Insect Growth I, except that size is Huge.

sp-03702.description_en: Allows caster to take the physical form of an ant. Caster has and can perform all of the abilities of an ant. The transformation takes ten complete rounds of concentration to occur. For exact details and statistics see Creatures & Monstm.

sp-03703.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a normal-sized spider and the transformation takes nine complete rounds to occur.

sp-03704.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a rat, mouse, squirrel, chipmunk, etc., and the transformation takes eight complete rounds to occur.

sp-03705.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a frog and the transformation takes seven complete rounds to occur.

sp-03706.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a chameleon and the transformation takes six complete rounds to occur.

sp-03707.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a small lizard and the transformation takes five complete rounds to occur.

sp-03708.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a Small Bird and the transformation takes four complete rounds to occur.

sp-03709.description_en: As Ant Form, except the caster takes the physical form of a Raccoon and the transformation takes three complete rounds to occur.

sp-03710.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a Deer and the transformation takes two complete Tounds to occur.

sp-03711.description_en: As Ant Form, except caster takes the form of a Boa (Snake) and the transformation takes one complete round to occur.

sp-03712.description_en: As Boa Form, except the caster takes the form of a Falcon.

sp-03713.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Wolf.

sp-03714.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Tiger.

sp-03715.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of an Alligator or Crocodile.

sp-03716.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Small Bear. Upon reaching 15th level the caster may use the Large Bear.

sp-03717.description_en: As Boa Form, except the caster takes the physical form of a Centaur.

sp-03718.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Faerie Dragon.

sp-03719.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of an Elephant.

sp-03720.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Forest Troll.

sp-03721.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a White Unicom. Note: Upon reaching 20th level the caster gains the Unicorn's spell casting capabilities.

sp-03723.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Forest Giant. Note; Upon reaching 20th level the caster gains the ability to utilize Ice Law as a normal Forest Giant.

sp-03724.description_en: As Boa Form, except caster takes the form of a Young Gas Drake. Note; Upon reaching 25th level the Druid gains the stats of a Mature Gas Drake and upon reaching 50th level the Druid gains the stats of an Old Gas Drake.

sp-03725.description_en: Puts any animal to sleep. Will not affect enchanted creatures or creatures with greater than animal intelligence.

sp-03726.description_en: Creates a 10-foot radius area where no form of plant life will grow until the area is healed. Plant life currently in the area will die.

sp-03727.description_en: Loosens 100' cubic feet of earth to the consistency of plowed ground.

sp-03728.description_en: Allows the caster to control the actions of any 1 animal.

sp-03729.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in any natural material up to a 10 feet x 10 feet x 10 feet section will extend to their limit.

sp-03730.description_en: As Blight I, except for the area of effect.

sp-03731.description_en: As Animal Sleep I, except it can put up to 3 animals to sleep.

sp-03732.description_en: Changes 100 feet of stone to packed earth. This change is gradual (taking three rounds for complete change).

sp-03733.description_en: Creates an area of very sharp spiked stones from rock occurring in the affected radius. The spikes take one round to form, so anyone in the radius when it is cast may make a moving maneuver to avoid taking a critical. Any creature caught in the area when the spikes form suffers a 'B' Puncture critical. In addition, anyone moving through the area must make a moving maneuver or suffer an 'A' Puncture critical. (GM determines all maneuver difficulties based on the situation.)

sp-03734.description_en: Creates a wall of rough-cut stones up to 10 foot x 10 foot x 1 foot. It can be chipped through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.

sp-03735.description_en: Creates a 3 foot by 6 foot corridor that is 1 foot per level long. It can cut through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate of 1 foot (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-03736.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except it changes packed earth to solid stone and loose earth to gravel.

sp-03737.description_en: As Animal Mastery I, except the caster can control 3 animals.

sp-03738.description_en: As Blight I, except for the area of effect.

sp-03739.description_en: As Spike Stones I, except for the area of effect, and the criticals inflicted are 'C' and 'B,' respectively.

sp-03740.description_en: Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left) 100 cubic feet of earth.

sp-03741.description_en: For as long as he concentrates, caster may mold 1 cubic foot of stone with his hands as if it were putty; then the stone will harden.

sp-03742.description_en: As Stone/Mud, except changes stone to mud.

sp-03743.description_en: As Unearth, except it affects stone.

sp-03744.description_en: Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up to 10 feet wide, up to 100 feet deep, and up to 200 feet long. The crack takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03745.description_en: As Blight I, except for the area of effect.

sp-03746.description_en: Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10 foot per level deep, 1 foot per level wide, and 20 foot per level long). The crevice takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03747.description_en: Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to 1 md/ lvl. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a d100 roll: (10-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6.0, (46-65) = 6.5, (6680) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0.

sp-03748.description_en: Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to preaching his religion to groups of people. This can normally be resolved as a special bonus of +10 to the Public Speaking skill.

sp-03749.description_en: For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target's best interest.

sp-03750.description_en: Caster's voice is amplified two times. This is useful for talking to large crowds.

sp-03751.description_en: For as long as the caster speaks, the target will believe that the reasoning and ideas that the caster expresses are correct and valid.

sp-03752.description_en: Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of language developed (i.e., DP's spent), results in two ranks being learned. It is assumed that this spell is cast and in effect while the language is being learned.

sp-03753.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-03754.description_en: As Sounding II, except amplification is four times.

sp-03755.description_en: As Voice of Friendship, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03756.description_en: The caster is subtly directed (hints and clues) towards a specific person or group of people that the caster's deity believes should hear the caster's message. The exact form of the guidance will vary from deity to deity (e.g., a deity of the wind would have the wind constantly blow the same way, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the caster must concentrate to be led in the correct direction.

sp-03757.description_en: As Learn language II, except rate is tripled (three ranks are gained for every one).

sp-03758.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-03759.description_en: As Voice of Reason, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03760.description_en: Caster's basic needs are met by his deity in various ways (i.e., people bring the caster food, and offer him shelter for the evening, etc.).

sp-03762.description_en: As Learn language II, except rate is quadrupled (four ranks are gained for every one).

sp-03763.description_en: [RR Mod: -50) After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he knows it). All targets who fail their RR will believe the caster is speaking the absolute truth.

sp-03764.description_en: As Conversion I, except the bonus is +40.

sp-03765.description_en: Caster is able to speak any language (even one that he has never heard before) as if he was a native speaker.

sp-03766.description_en: As Voice of Conviction, except it will affect all who can hear the caster.

sp-03767.description_en: If the caster's deity agrees, a divine sign or miracle will be shown to an appropriate group of people.

sp-03768.description_en: Caster's eyes appear as those of a snake. Those who view the caster see his eyes as slits. This has no value other than as an illusion and can be detected as such.

sp-03769.description_en: Caster charms one snake. That snake will not attack him, and will follow his non-violent suggestions.

sp-03770.description_en: Caster magically summons a viper that will arrive in two rounds. It will act as the caster directs it.

sp-03771.description_en: Caster's mouth fills with razor-like teeth that can be used to make Small Bite attacks.

sp-03772.description_en: Caster's eyes become hypnotic to one target. Target must make a RR or be stunned for the duration.

sp-03773.description_en: As Summon Viper, except it summons a cobra.

sp-03774.description_en: As Charm Snake I, except it can effect up to two snakes.

sp-03775.description_en: As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Medium Bite attacks.

sp-03776.description_en: As Summon Viper, except it summons a python.

sp-03777.description_en: Caster's next summoning spell from this list (cast within the duration) will summon two snakes.

sp-03778.description_en: Caster gains total control over the actions of one snake.

sp-03779.description_en: The caster's bite this round will inject a mild poison into the target with any critical that is delivered. Type of poison should be determined by the Gamemaster.

sp-03780.description_en: Caster summons a special type of snake that is common to the terrain he is in. In the forest, this could be a Horned Snake; in the snow, a Giant Furred Snake; etc.

sp-03781.description_en: As Snake Bite I, except caster can make Large l3ite attacks.

sp-03782.description_en: As Marter Snake I, except it can affect up to two snakes.

sp-03783.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects a moderate poison.

sp-03784.description_en: Caster summons a giant snake. The details are left to the GM.

sp-03785.description_en: As Multi-Summoning II, except three snakes will be summoned.

sp-03786.description_en: As Master Snake I, except it can affect up to three snakes.

sp-03787.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects a severe poison.

sp-03789.description_en: As Poison Bite I, except it injects an extreme poison.

sp-03790.description_en: Caster opens up a magical gate to a mythical or legendary snake creature or perhaps a powerful snake lord. Details are left up to the GM.

sp-03793.description_en: Caster can totally control one first level spirit for as long as he concentrates. This spell can keep a spirit for longer than the appropriate Summon spell, but the caster needs to concentrate the entire time. When the caster ceases concentration, or if the spirit moves more than 100 feet from the caster, the spirit is free to attack the caster and/or return to the spirit world (most spirits opt to return to the spirit world to get away from the caster).

sp-03795.description_en: As Control Spirit I, except the caster need not concentrate, and this spell has a set duration. When not doing as commanded by the caster, the spirit will wait idly by for the next command.

sp-03796.description_en: [RR Mod: +25]- This spell causes a spirit become enslaved to the caster for the duration of the spell. This enslavement is not limited by range or any other factors. A caster may only have one thrall for every five full levels the caster has attained. An enslaved spirit may not attack the caster and must obey all commands within its abilities.

sp-03797.description_en: This spell may only be cast upon a spirit that has been made into a Spirit Thrall for the caster. Once cast, the thrall is linked to the caster through a psychic bond. This bond has two effects. First, the caster may, through concentration, view the world using the senses of the spirit thrall. Second, any damage acquired by the caster is distributed evenly between the caster and

sp-03798.description_en: This spell forces a spirit to haunt or attack a given person or place. The spirit cannot travel more than 100 feet from the object of the haunting for the duration of the spell.

sp-03799.description_en: As Control Spirit I, except the caster may control up to a fifth level spirit.

sp-03800.description_en: As Taint Spirit, except the spirit will receive a number of levels of taint equal to the caster's level divided by three (rounded up).

sp-03801.description_en: As Spirit Mastery I, except the caster may master up to a fifth level spirit.

sp-03802.description_en: As Spirit Trap/, except that up to fifth level spirit may be trapped for one use, or a first level spirit may be trapped for two uses (i.e., the spirit is not released after the first use).

sp-03803.description_en: As Spirit Thrall, except the duration is permanent.

sp-03804.description_en: As Control Spirit V. except that the caster may control up to a 10th level spirit.

sp-03805.description_en: As Spirit Link, except the duration is permanent.

sp-03806.description_en: As Spirit Mastery V. except the caster may master up to a 10th level spirit.

sp-03807.description_en: As Spirit Trap V, except that a first level spirit may be trapped for up to three uses, or up to a fifth level spirit may be trapped for two uses, or a tenth level spirit may be trapped for one use.

sp-03808.description_en: As Bedevilment, except the duration is permanent. For this spell, that means until the death or destruction of the focus of the haunting, or until the banishment of the spirit.

sp-03809.description_en: As Control Spirit X, except that any level of spirit may be controlled.

sp-03810.description_en: As Spirit Mastery X, except any level of spirit may be mastered.

sp-03811.description_en: As Spirit Trap X, except that a first level spirit may be trapped for four uses, or up to a fifth level spirit may be trapped for three uses, or up to a tenth level spirit may be trapped for two uses, or a spirit of any higher level may be trapped for one use. If this spell is cast a second time upon the trapped spirit, it turns it into a daily item with a number of uses each day equal to the original number of uses. The trapped spirit gets an additional +25 to his RR for the second casting of this spell.

sp-03812.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any spirit within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a. different area each round. Caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-03813.description_en: Informs the caster of the type of a given spirit as well as its general power level.

sp-03814.description_en: This spell must be cast every day for one week. At the end of that week, the caster's totem will come to the caster to help and guide him. This totem will have the physical form, natural enemies and allies of a normal animal of this species. The exact species of the totem should be either chosen by the GM to match the personality of the caster (or the caster's faith), or be rolled randomly on the chart in Section 12.5. The totem will always be a young animal that gains experience as the caster does. If the caster's totem is ever killed, he will be at -100 to all maneuver the first week,-90 the second week, and ·so on until the penalty is gone. After ten weeks, the caster may cast this spell again, any new totem will always be the same species as the first totem the caster ever gained Any bonuses or abilities gained from the totem are lost when the totem is lost (until a new one can be summoned). See Section 12.5 for more details about Totem Familiars.

sp-03815.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a first-level spirit of a type chosen by the caster prior to the casting of this spell. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the spirit through this spell. The spirit will appear before the caster as a wavering form.

sp-03816.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand spirits.

sp-03817.description_en: The caster binds the spirit of one dead person to his own spirit, for the purpose of taking that spirit to the spirit world. This spell functions in part so that the caster may bring such a spirit across to the spirit world, and thus to the proper nexus for the spirit to travel to its afterlife domain.

sp-03818.description_en: Allows the caster to bind a spirit into an item. This imbues the item with the power of the spirit. The spirit remains bound until the item is used. When used, all within a 100 foot radius must make an RR versus the level of the spirit or they will suffer the effects of the spirit's power. Once the item has been activated, the spirit is free to return to the spirit world.

sp-03819.description_en: Caster imbues himself with a spirit of calm. All within the area of effect are overcome with a feeling of calmness.

sp-03820.description_en: Caster imbues himself with a spirit of harmony. All within the area of effect are overcome with a feeling of unity and a desire to work together.

sp-03821.description_en: The target of this spell is banished back to the spirit world. This spell may also be used against Undead that contain spirits. Animated Undead are unaffected by this spell.

sp-03822.description_en: As Summon Spirit I, except that the caster may summon up to a fifth level spirit.

sp-03823.description_en: As Spirit Binding I, except that the caster may bind up to a fifth level spirit into an item, or he may bind a first level spirit into an item for two uses of its abilities (i.e., the spirit is not released after the first use).

sp-03824.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of discord. All within the area of effect will feel a great dissatisfaction and refuse to agree with anyone about anything.

sp-03825.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of friendship. All within the area of effect are overcome by a tremendous feeling of camaraderie and goodwill.

sp-03826.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] -As Spirit Guide, except that the spirit suffers a penalty to its RR, and the caster will know exactly where on the spirit world, the proper nexus is located.

sp-03827.description_en: As Summon Spirit V. except the caster may summon up to a tenth level spirit.

sp-03828.description_en: As per Spirit Binding V. except that the caster may bind up to a tenth level spirit for a single use of its abilities, or he may bind up to a fifth level spirit for two uses of its abilities, or he may bind a first level spirit for three uses of its abilities.

sp-03829.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of anger. All within the area of effect are overcome with anger and go berserk.

sp-03830.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit offear. All within the area of effect are overcome with fear, and either seek to flee or become incapacitated if they cannot flee.

sp-03831.description_en: [RR Mod: -20)-As Banish Spirit, except that the spirit suffers a penalty to his RR.

sp-03832.description_en: As Summon Spirit X. except that the caster may summon up to a 20th level spirit.

sp-03833.description_en: As Spirit Binding X, except that the caster can bind a spirit of up to twentieth level into an item for a single use, or he may bind a spirit of up to fifteenth level into an item for two uses, or he may bind a spirit of up to tenth level into an item for three uses, or he may bind a spirit of up to fifth level into an item for four uses, or he may bind a first level spirit into an item for five uses. A second casting of this spell upon a bound spirit will bind the spirit permanently into an item until the item is destroyed, the spirit is released by the caster, or a condition set up prior to the casting of this spell (the second time) is fulfilled. If made into a permanent item, the item-bound spirit powers a daily item with a number of uses equal to the number of uses gained when this spell was cast the first time. This spell could also be used to make any one lower level Spirit Binding spell permanent.

sp-03834.description_en: The caster imbues himself with a spirit of awe. All within the area of effect are overcome with feelings of awe and worship towards the caster. SPECIAL Nons

sp-03835.description_en: Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to one Meditation Static Maneuver performed next round.

sp-03836.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight.

sp-03837.description_en: For the duration of the spell the caster receives a special bonus of +30 to RRs versus outside corruption influences.

sp-03838.description_en: Detects "evil" in an animate or inanimate target; caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-03839.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen within the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-03841.description_en: Caster can sense if there is a disharmony in the "natural order" of the world within the area of effect. The caster gets an impression of something wrong, but not the reason why. For example, the caster could sense that magical effects were altering nature, or that some curse lay upon the area, etc.

sp-03842.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can been seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-03843.description_en: Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-03844.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 2 minutes into the future.

sp-03845.description_en: Caster's spirit leaves his body to wander the physical world, and can travel at normal walking speed for the duration of this spell. While in spirit form, the caster is invisible, and cannot affect the physical world in any way. The caster's spirit cannot do anything that his normal physical body cannot do (e.g., fly, walk through walls, etc.). If the caster's spirit has not returned to the caster's body before the end of the spell, the caster must make a RR versus his own level or his spirit cannot rejoin with his body (i.e., he dies). This RR must be made every minute past the end of the spell, in which the caster is not back in his body.

sp-03846.description_en: Awakens caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-03848.description_en: As Sense Disharmony, except for the duration and range. Caster can concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-03849.description_en: Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to him).

sp-03850.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 5 minutes into the future.

sp-03851.description_en: As Spin"t Walk I, except that caster may move at twice his normal walking pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of 10' per round.

sp-03852.description_en: Caster can see through any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the other senses.

sp-03853.description_en: During normal sleep, the caster may make Awareness maneuvers (that are not based solely on sight), at no penalty.

sp-03854.description_en: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.

sp-03855.description_en: As Spirit Walk II, except that the caster may move at up to four times his normal walking pace, and he may pass through non-magical substances (e.g., walls) at a rate of 10' per round.

sp-03856.description_en: Caster can ascertain exact nature, origin, purpose, and history of any 1 "holy item;" it allows caster to visualize all who have possessed the item.

sp-03858.description_en: Stones within 10 foot radius of the caster are hurled at the target. The attack is resolved on the Ram/Butt/Bash Attack Table (in Arms Law) with a maximum result of Small. The casters OB will equal his Directed Spell skill bonus for 'stones.'

sp-03859.description_en: Caster may repair damage, cracks, or breaks in a stone object or a mass of stone up to 20 foot radius.

sp-03860.description_en: Caster can communicate with any one stone (if it possesses animate qualities) or one Earth Elemental. Caster may only use this spell on only one stone at a time.

sp-03861.description_en: As Small Stone, except for area of effect and the maximum attack result is Medium.

sp-03862.description_en: The next stone that the caster throws (within the duration) will deliver an additional critical that is two levels lower in severity to any normal critical delivered. (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' critical, a 'B' critical would deliver an additional 'A' critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would deliver an additional 'A' critical with a special modification of -50). The critical type can either reflect the nature of the deity or it can be treated as a Holy Spell critical. The attack must occur in the round this spell is cast.

sp-03863.description_en: Caster summons a Weak Earth Elemental (a Type II Elemental) that gradually appears over the course of two rounds. The caster can concentrate to get the elemental to perform actions or he may use Stonespeech to command it verbally. Otherwise, it will stand motionless. The elemental departs after the duration expires.

sp-03864.description_en: As Small Stone, except for area of effect and the maximum attack result is Large.

sp-03865.description_en: As Holy Stone I, except the critical severity is one lower (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03866.description_en: Creates an area of veiy sharp spiked stones from rock occurring in the affected radius. The spikes take one round to form, so anyone in the radius when it is cast may make a moving maneuver to avoid taking a critical. Any creature caught in the area when the spikes form suffers a 'B' Puncture critical. In addition, anyone moving through the area must make a moving maneuver or suffer an 'A' Puncture critical. (GM determines all maneuver difficulties based on the situation.)

sp-03867.description_en: Creates a wall of rough-cut stones up to 10 foot x 10 foot x 1 foot. It can be chipped through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.

sp-03868.description_en: Creates a 3 foot by 6 foot corridor that is 1 foot per level long. It can cut through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate of 1 foot (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-03869.description_en: As Earth Elemental II, except it summons a Type III Earth Elemental.

sp-03871.description_en: As Holy Stone I, except the critical severity is one lower.

sp-03872.description_en: As Spike Stones I, except for the area of effect, and the criticals inflicted are 'C' and 'B,' respectively.

sp-03873.description_en: As Earth Elemental II, except it summons a Type IV Earth Elemental.

sp-03874.description_en: For as long as he concentrates, caster may mold 1 cubic foot of stone with his hands as if it were putty; then the stone will harden.

sp-03875.description_en: If there is a suitable round boulder nearby (no more than 10 pounds per level), caster can cause it to roll in a direction he specifies. Resolve the attack on the Trample/Stomp Attack Table (in Arms Law) using a maximum of Large results. The OB will equal the caster's Directed Spell skill bonus for 'stones' with a special bonus of +20.

sp-03877.description_en: Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up to 10 feet wide, up to 100 feet deep, and up to 200 feet long. The crack takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03879.description_en: Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10 foot per level deep, 1 foot per level wide, and 20 foot per level long). The crevice takes two rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for three rounds to close the crevice.

sp-03880.description_en: Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to one round per level. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a d 100 roll: (10-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6.0, (4&65) = 6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0. SPECIAL Nons

sp-03882.description_en: The next attack against the caster's chosen creatures inflicts an additional Holy Weapon critical that is two levels less severe than any normal critical delivered (i.e., a 'C' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, a 'B' critical would deliver an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would deliver an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of-50). The attack

sp-03883.description_en: Caster learns whether there are any magical gates, teleportals, or other magical portals in the area of effect.

sp-03884.description_en: This spell will only work between the time a summons spell has been cast, and when the creature arrives. It allows the caster to prevent a creature from arriving if it fails its RR for this spell. This spell will only work on creatures that are fourth level or less.

sp-03885.description_en: This spell breaks control over any one creature presently being controlled by a Control spell.

sp-03886.description_en: As Hunter's Strike I, except the critical is one level less severe (i.e., a 'B' critical would inflict an additional 'A' Holy Weapon critical, an 'A' critical would inflict an 'A' Holy Weapon critical with a special modification of -25).

sp-03887.description_en: Places a barrier in front of a gate, teleportal, or other magical portal. To cross the gate, a being must make an RR versus the level of the caster or take a 'B' Impact critical and not pass through the gate.

sp-03888.description_en: As Block Summons I, except it will work on creatures that are eighth level or less.

sp-03889.description_en: As Break Control I, except it will also break the control of any Mastery spell.

sp-03890.description_en: As Hunter's Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-03891.description_en: All of the caster's chosen creatures who are within the area must make a RR, or suffer an 'B' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03892.description_en: As Block Summons I, except it will work on creatures that are twelfth level or less.

sp-03893.description_en: As Break Control II, except it will affect the target's control over two creatures.

sp-03894.description_en: Will magically dispel any magical gate, teleportal, or other magical portal. The gate will stay open if it makes a RR versus the caster (gates save as the level of the caster who opened them).

sp-03895.description_en: As Hunter's Strike I, except the critical is one level greater in severity, with a maximum of an 'E' critical.

sp-03896.description_en: As Block Summons I, except it will work on creatures that are fourteenth level or less.

sp-03897.description_en: As Break Control II, except it will affect the target's control over three creatures.

sp-03898.description_en: Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, or magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR versus the level of the caster with a special -30 modifier. Failure indicates the being takes an 'E' Impact critical and does not pass through the gate.

sp-03900.description_en: As Hunter's Aura, except for the effect is a 'D' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03901.description_en: As Close Gate, except for range, and it will close all gates within the area.

sp-03902.description_en: As Break Control II, except it will affect all the target's controlled creatures.

sp-03903.description_en: For the duration, caster will inflict Slaying criticals to his chosen creatures in addition to any normal criticals.

sp-03905.description_en: Target receives a special penalty of d10 to all initiative Area of Effect Duration Range Type Lvl Spell rolls for the duration. F 100' 1 target 0 1) Time Drain *

sp-03910.description_en: As Sloth I, except the penalty is 2d10. F 4 rnds 100' 1 target □ 15) Slow IV*

sp-03914.description_en: As Quickness I, except the bonus is 2d10. self 1 min/lvl caster □ 50) Time Walk

sp-03915.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts three rounds. w..

sp-03916.description_en: Predicts the most probable actions of a being in the next round. The target's specific action and targets are 25. Foreknowledge - Caster gains momentary insights into the learned (e.g., attack whom with what weapon in melee, cast a future.
