sp-03917.description_en: As Time Stretch, except the duration is tripled. 50. Tune Walk-Caster is presented with a vision of any event from

sp-03918.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts four rounds. anytime in his past. Caster may then use any of his skills, spells,

sp-03921.description_en: All spells cast within the radius will have their durations cut in half. In addition, all maneuvers performed within the radius will take twice as long to complete.

sp-03922.description_en: Caster enters a deep sleep in which he does not age. Caster must set conditions from which he can awaken (e.g., a specific time, a certain event).

sp-03926.description_en: Allows caster to understand and "speak" the language of any one tree species.

sp-03927.description_en: Allows the caster to appear as any one type of tree. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the tree (i.e. it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules; see Spell Law Section 15.14 for more on illusions).

sp-03928.description_en: Heals 3d 10 hits of damage on a tree.

sp-03929.description_en: Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to 10'x10'x5'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 50%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. Anyone moving through it receives a takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03931.description_en: All non-magical fire in the area of effect is put out. Magical fire must make an RR or be extinguished.

sp-03932.description_en: Caster magically enters a tree and can leave from any other tree within range.

sp-03933.description_en: Creates a wall of tough branches that is 10' x 10' x 1'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 80%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. Anyone passing through it takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03934.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 8.

sp-03935.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to an Awakened Tree.)

sp-03936.description_en: As Tree Healing, except that in addition, the tree is cured of any diseases.

sp-03937.description_en: Creates a wall of trees in the area of effect. The trees can be burned through or chopped down. They are rooted to the ground. The actual height of the trees will vary according to the trees in the area.

sp-03938.description_en: Target is rooted to the ground. He may make a Very Hard maneuver to break free. While rooted, all Unbalancing criticals are lowered by two degrees (i.e., a 'C' critical would become an 'A' critical, a 'B' critical would become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -SO).

sp-03939.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 11.

sp-03940.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to a Slowroot.)

sp-03941.description_en: As Smother, except for the area of effect and range, and magical fires suffer -20 to their RRs.

sp-03943.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 20.

sp-03944.description_en: Caster can revive any one dead tree.

sp-03945.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to a Treeherd.)

sp-03946.description_en: Caster can take the form, physical size, and abilities of any one tree with which he is familiar (GM's discretion.)

sp-03947.description_en: As Smother, except for area of effect, range, and magical fires suffer -50 to their RRs.

sp-03948.description_en: Caster can either issue a summons to every sentient tree within a forest, or animate one tree per level and bring them all to fight for a cause that is crucial to the forest's survival. (Trees are animated as in Command Tree, GM's discretion). SPECIAL Nons

sp-03949.description_en: Creates a talisman that protects (in the form of bonuses to the caster's DB and RRs) the caster from animal attacks. Protection is equal to +1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell.

sp-03950.description_en: Creates a talisman that will add +1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell to one maneuver to find an herb.

sp-03951.description_en: Creates a talisman that will add+ 1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell to one Influence maneuver.

sp-03952.description_en: Creates a talisman that will add +1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell to one magical maneuver (e.g., Magic Ritual, Spell Mastery) selected at the time of the talisman's creation.

sp-03953.description_en: Creates a talisman that will protect the caster from a specific, living creature type (e.g., werewolves, lizards, etc.). Protection grants caster +1 per PP that the caster spendH:asting this spell on his DB and RRs versus any attack from that type of creature.

sp-03955.description_en: As Protedion Talisman, except it will protect the caster from spirits.

sp-03956.description_en: As Protedion Talisman, except it will protect the caster from Undead.

sp-03957.description_en: Caster adds +1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell to his DB or RR versus one specific spell that he has been affected by in the past.

sp-03958.description_en: As Protedion Talisman, except it will protect the caster from Demons.

sp-03959.description_en: Caster traps a portion of the target's soul into a talisman. The target is at -20 to all actions until the talisman is destroyed. The target will always know the direction to the talisman. The creator of such a talisman gains a special bonus of +1 to spell casting static maneuvers and +1 PP for each such soul that is trapped, while he has the talisman. The caster may only have two such talismans per experience level.

sp-03960.description_en: This talisman is created to function against one specific target. The target suffers a -1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell to all actions that may harm the caster.

sp-03961.description_en: Caster creates a talisman that protects his soul from Absolution spells, Constitution draining, and similar type powers. All RRs vs. these effects are made at + 1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell.

sp-03962.description_en: Caster creates a doll resembling a specific target from which he has a portion of a soul (using the Soul Trap spell). When the holder of this doll is within sight of the person whose soul is inside the doll, he may command him to do anything that is not totally alien (e.g., blinding himself).

sp-03963.description_en: This talisman warns the caster when anyone enters a 100'R around his person, and if that person intends to harm him.

sp-03964.description_en: As Death Talisman, except that it also subtracts -1 per PP that the caster spends casting this spell from the target's RR versus spells cast by the caster.

sp-03965.description_en: Caster creates a talisman that when sacrificed, adds +1 per caster level to one Divine Intervention maneuver. This talisman should be difficult to create, and require hard to find or expensive components (GM discretion).

sp-03966.description_en: As Voodoo Doll, except that whatever befalls the doll also happens to the target in a similar fashion (GM's discretion).

sp-03967.description_en: Caster may create a permanent talisman (with a permanent duration) using one of the lower level spells on this list.

sp-05779.description_en: The caster enters a trance-like state to prepare his mind to be the recipient for a Star Voice spell, Mind Voice spell or Mind Tongue spell (off Mind Speech (Mentalist Base)). While he is under the effects of this spell, an incoming spell belonging to one of the three groups mentioned above will have its range increased by 10 times.

sp-05780.description_en: As Star Voice, except the caster may mentally speak with any one thinking being that he can see.

sp-05781.description_en: When this spell is cast, the next Star Voice or Mind Voice spell (cast within one minute of this spell) will be able to focus in on a specific person as its target (even if the caster cannot see the target). The target must have previously been Mind Stored (see the Starsense spell list).

sp-05782.description_en: As Star Voice, except the caster may speak to another spell user of the Mentalism realm as far as the horizon if it is clear and at night, In other circumstances, the range is 1000'.

sp-05783.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except the range is 300' and the caster must know exactly where the target is.

sp-05784.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 20 times.

sp-05785.description_en: As Mind Voice III, except the range is 500'.

sp-05786.description_en: Caster can cause his voice to be heard at a point up to 100' away (in amplified tones). If the location is out of sight, the caster must have been there.

sp-05787.description_en: As Mind Voice III, except the range is 1000'.

sp-05788.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 50 times.

sp-05790.description_en: As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 300' away.

sp-05791.description_en: As Mind Voice III, except the range is 1 mile.

sp-05792.description_en: As Star Voice, except the range is 5 miles per level of the caster if the spell is cast on a clear night, and 1 mile per level of the caster under other conditions.

sp-05793.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 100 times.

sp-05794.description_en: As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 500' away.

sp-05795.description_en: As Greater Mind Voice I, except the range is 5 miles.

sp-05796.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except range is increased by 500 times.

sp-05799.description_en: As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 1 mile per level away.

sp-05800.description_en: As Mind Voice III, except if the target of this spell is another spell user of the Mentalism realm, the range is unlimited; otherwise, the range is 5 miles per level of the caster.

sp-05802.description_en: Caster is able to read and write very simple phrases and words in a specific language, and possibly understand the context of very simple passages. The caster must have a sample text in the target language. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the written form of the language.

sp-05803.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell to work.

sp-05804.description_en: Caster gets a vision of up to 1 minute (per level of experience) into the past. The caster must select the point in the past to be viewed (and the vision will be accurate within one minute). The vision must be associated with a person, place or object touched at the time of casting. The vision includes sight and sound. The vision will last up to 1 round (per level of the caster) if the caster concentrates and remains inactive. The caster is effectively in a trance while concentrating. Time passes at a rate of one round of real time for 10 rounds of vision.

sp-05805.description_en: As Literacy I, except the caster can read moderately simple writings and understand most of the details, but will have trouble with subtle concepts. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the written form of the language.

sp-05807.description_en: This spell gives the caster the ability to scan the past by “feeling the temporal location for significant events.” This translates to the caster knowing the approximate time-frames of significant events, without knowing the nature of the events. To use this knowledge, the caster must cast a Vision Behind spell (within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-05808.description_en: As Literacy I, except the caster has the reading level of the average literate man, and may write at a “ninth grade level” (equivalent to someone who has completed “secondary” education or finished a craft or trade apprenticeship). For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the written form of the language.

sp-05811.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 10 minutes per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±5 minutes) and the trance can last up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-05812.description_en: As Literacy I, except the caster may read relatively complex material and recognize (if not fully understand) the nature of archaic or unusual dialects and concepts. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 8 in the written form of the language.

sp-05813.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 hour per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±30 minutes) and the trance can last up to 5 minutes per level of the caster.

sp-05814.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 4 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05816.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 day per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 hour) and the trance can last up to 10 minutes per level of the caster.

sp-05817.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 month per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 day) and the trance can last up to 1 hour per level of the caster.

sp-05818.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 year per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 week) and the trance can last up to 5 hours per level of the caster.

sp-05823.description_en: Generates a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 5 from all attacks against him.

sp-05827.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-05828.description_en: A 6" radius ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area of radius equal to the range is lit if the flare can rise to its full range. The flare drops at 10' per round. If fired at a target, resolve the attack as a Shock Bolt that delivers Heat criticals.

sp-05829.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched with equivalent illumination to full daylight. It also nullifies all magically created darkness for the duration in that area. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being.

sp-05830.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-05831.description_en: A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-05833.description_en: A bolt of intense coherent light (color chosen by the caster at time of casting, but may not be white) is shot from the caster's palm. The attack is resolved on the Fire Bolt Attack Table, with the following special rules: If the bolt hits a reflective surface (such as a mirror or a highly polished breastplate), the bolt will be harmlessly scattered; however the reflective surface will be burned/tarnished (losing its reflectivity until repaired or polished). If the bolt hits a surface which has the same color as the bolt (a green bolt strikes the target's green robes), the concussion hit damage delivered by the bolt is halved (round down; e.g., a result of 5 hits and an 'A' critical becomes 2 hits and an 'A' critical).

sp-05834.description_en: As Light II, except the caster can delay the effects of the spell and it can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at time of casting): elapsed time (up to 24 hours), specific movements, specific sounds, or touch.

sp-05835.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 20 from all attacks.

sp-05836.description_en: A brilliant flash blinds the target for 1 round per 5 failure.

sp-05837.description_en: As Beacon V, except the ray can be up to 10 miles long.

sp-05838.description_en: As Light II, except up to 20 areas can be lit with a total radius of 200'.

sp-05839.description_en: As Utterlight I, except up to 5 areas can be lit with a total radius of 50'.

sp-05840.description_en: As Lesser Starbolt, except the range is 1,000'.

sp-05841.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 25 from all attacks.

sp-05845.description_en: Determines the Ascendant and Midheaven for a given time at a given location to an accuracy of one angular minute (one-sixtieth of a degree), and determines the Sun Sign for that given time.

sp-05846.description_en: Determines the astrological positions of all culturally relevant celestial bodies for a given location on a given day up to one year into the past or up to one year into the future.

sp-05847.description_en: Given a birth chart, the caster can correlate all the astrologically significant information to provide one of three types of interpretation of the celestial influences on the person described by that birth chart. The caster can provide a general character analysis of the person in terms of all areas of life, a detailed analysis of the person for one specific area of life (e.g., health, love, aspirations etc.), or a problem analysis considering the merits and demerits of that person with respect to some decision or undertaking. The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05848.description_en: Given a query concerning a decision, an action, an event, etc., the caster can provide an assessment of the outcome of querent's topic based upon the celestial influences beginning from the time at which the query was asked until ten minutes per level of the caster into the future. The caster's prediction will depend on the nature of the query, but might include whether the outcome will be positive or negative, the probable outcome, any “trends” which will probably develop in the time-frame. With longer timeframes, the predictions will fail to note the lesser trends or minor events. Only one Horary spell may be cast by the caster in any given 24-hour period, and failed spells count towards that limit. The prediction will be accurate 25% of the time plus 1% per level of the caster (otherwise, the results will be random). The duration of this spell is the time required to assess the celestial influences.

sp-05849.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to three years into the past or the future.

sp-05850.description_en: Caster can determine the exact location of the target's birth to the nearest mile.

sp-05851.description_en: Caster can determine the date of birth and time of birth of the target to the nearest minute.

sp-05852.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 hour per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05853.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to five years into the past or the future.

sp-05854.description_en: Given a birth chart which has been progressed for a single month in a given year (either in the past or in the future), the caster can correlate all the astrologically significant information to provide an interpretation of the celestial influences upon the person described by the chart over the course of that month. The caster can provide a general summary of the trends in one specific area of life over the course of that month. The interpretation will not reveal the destination(s) involved nor the timings of the journeys. The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05855.description_en: Allows the caster to determine all the aspects in a given chart or charts which are considered relevant in the caster's system of astrology. This will usually include all conjunctions, oppositions, squares, trines, quincunx, sextiles, etc.

sp-05856.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 day per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05857.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to ten years into the past or the future.

sp-05858.description_en: Based on available previously determined data (e.g., Ascendant, Midheaven, celestial positions), the caster can trace out an astrological chart (which is completely accurate given the available information) onto a suitable surface. The duration of this spell represents the time taken for the caster to trace out the chart.

sp-05860.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 week per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05861.description_en: As Ephemeris XV, except can be up to fifteen years into the past or the future.

sp-05862.description_en: Given a number of birth charts or progressed birth charts, the caster can correlate the astrologically significant information in terms of correspondences between or among the birth charts. The caster can then provide an analysis of how the persons described by the given charts will interact with each other based on the celestial influences exerted upon them either at their births or at a given time. A synastric interpretation might (in many cultures) be required to determine if a given marriage was astrologically advisable or to determine the soundness of a business partnership. The caster can only provide a synastric interpretation for a maximum of one chart per five levels of the caster (round up). The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05863.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to twenty years into the past or the future.

sp-05864.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 month per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05865.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to two years per level of the caster into the past or the future.

sp-05866.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 year per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05867.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to five years per level of the caster into the past or the future.

sp-05869.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The object or place must be within 100' of the caster.

sp-05870.description_en: The caster can see on a clear night (when the stars or moonlight is visible) as if it were day. The range of the caster's vision is that of normal daylight vision. The caster must be outdoors for this spell to function.

sp-05871.description_en: As Location I, except the range is 300'.

sp-05873.description_en: Caster learns direction and distance to any unshielded mind for which he has a mental pattern from Mind Store and which is within 100' per level of the caster.

sp-05874.description_en: As Location I, except the range is 500'.

sp-05875.description_en: Caster learns the race, profession, and level of a target. The target must have been located by the Presence spell.

sp-05876.description_en: Caster learns the direction to any unshielded mind for which he has a mental pattern from Mind Store, and which is within range of this spell.

sp-05877.description_en: On a clear night (under starlight or moonlight), the caster attunes himself to the “music of the spheres” and can hear the faintest of sounds by merely concentrating his attention to a given locale. The caster's range of hearing is up to the horizon. Note the caster must be outdoors for this spell to function, and he cannot concentrate his attention to areas that are not under the starlight or moonlight (e.g., within buildings, etc.).

sp-05878.description_en: The caster can transfer a copy of any one Mind Stored pattern to another spell user from the Mentalism realm (i.e., both casters now have the person stored). The target of this spell must know the Mind Store spell (but he needn't spend the PPs to cast Mind Store).

sp-05879.description_en: As Presence, but the caster also gains general knowledge of the targets' actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of the targets' actions for the round (and in which “phase” they want to perform the action). This does not prevent the targets from changing their actions (with the appropriate penalty for changing their actions).

sp-05880.description_en: As Stareyes, except the caster can see on a dark night (no stars visible and no moonlight) as if it were day. The darkness must be naturally occurring (not from any magical effects).

sp-05881.description_en: As Location I, except for the range.

sp-05883.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05884.description_en: As Stareyes, except the caster can see in magically created darkness as if it were day.

sp-05885.description_en: As Direction, except for the range.

sp-05886.description_en: As Starhearing, except the caster is able to attune himself to the “music of the spheres” on dark nights when there is neither starlight nor moonlight.

sp-05890.description_en: As Location I, except the range is unlimited if both the caster and the target are outdoors while the stars are visible. If either the caster or the target (or both) are not outdoors, the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-05892.description_en: The target is calmed and cannot take aggressive (offensive) action, while the caster speaks to the target (requiring concentration of the caster). After the caster ceases to speak to the target, the effect will continue for as many rounds as the caster has already spoken. For example, if the caster speaks to a target for 3 rounds, the target will be calmed for those 3 rounds plus the following 3 rounds. Note the target must be able to hear and understand the caster. The caster may concentrate on this spell and a Speech or Common Speech spell at the same time.

sp-05893.description_en: The target must answer a single-concept question truthfully (though he must be able to understand the question).

sp-05894.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except the target will become afraid of one person (including the caster), object, or place chosen by the caster at time of casting, and will flee in fear from the source of that fear at maximum pace for the duration of this spell. Note that unless the target is restrained (even in a minor way), he will attempt to run after one round.

sp-05896.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +10 bonus to all non-magical attempts to persuade and/or influence people.

sp-05897.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except the target can take no more than 10% action each round for the duration of this spell.

sp-05898.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except the target will obey any actions suggested by the caster that are not totally alien to the target (e.g., no suicide commands, no blinding himself commands, etc.).

sp-05900.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except the target will believe that the reasoning and ideas put forward by the caster are correct and valid, and will be unable to doubt these beliefs for the duration of the spell. After the spell has ended, the target will continue to believe these ideas until either persuaded otherwise or presented with irrefutable evidence to the contrary.

sp-05901.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05902.description_en: As Orate I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-05903.description_en: As Speech I, except the caster speaks the target language as if he were a native. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 8 (spoken) in the language.

sp-05904.description_en: As Voice of Fear, except affects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05905.description_en: As Voice of Paralysis, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05906.description_en: As Voice of Command, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05907.description_en: As Speech I, except the caster has absolute fluency in the target language and all closely related dialects. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 10 (spoken) in the language.

sp-05908.description_en: As Voice of Beguilement, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05909.description_en: The target will consider the caster to be a staunch ally and friend, and will obey any commands directly issued by the caster which are not truly alien, and where no commands have been issued by the caster, the target will act in what he considers to be the caster's best interests. The caster must speak alone and without interruption with the target for at least one minute per level of the target, both the target and the caster must be within 50' of each other (and able to see each other), and the target must be able to hear and understand the caster (who may concentrate on Speech or Common Speech spells while establishing his hold over the target). The allegiance of the target can be prematurely terminated if dispelling magic is employed or if the target is presented with irrefutable evidence that the caster has betrayed him or if the caster orders the target to perform a truly alien act.

sp-05910.description_en: As Speech V, except all who can hear the caster will hear him in their native language, and the caster may concentrate on understanding a different language each round. Note the caster cannot simultaneously understand more than one language in any given round through using this spell.

sp-05911.description_en: As Orate I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-05912.description_en: As Voice of Dominion, except the caster must speak with the target for ten minutes per level of the target, and the duration of the allegiance is permanent unless terminated prematurely as described in Voice of Dominion.

sp-00846.description_en: Target will take no aggressive/offensive action, and will fight only if attacked. If the caster casts this spell at an already calmed target, the target will fall asleep.

sp-00847.description_en: Target must answer the next question the caster asks truthfully.

sp-00848.description_en: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action; he may continue to fight current foes or in self defense.

sp-00849.description_en: Target believes that the caster is of the same alignment as himself, is influential, and is superior to himself in rank, power and/or efficiency. Target will usually seek to ingratiate himself to the caster.

sp-00850.description_en: Target will obey a command of up to 5 words in length from the caster. Command cannot be completely alien to the target (e.g., suicide, blinding himself, etc) and the caster must speak a language the target can understand.

sp-00851.description_en: Target permanently forgets up to I min/lvl of specified memories as selected by caster. Memories older than I day give a special modification of +20 to the target's RR and memories older than I week get a special +40 RR modification. Memories older than I month may not be forgotten through this spell.

sp-00852.description_en: Target domesticated animal reverts to a wild state for the duration of this spell.

sp-00853.description_en: Caster causes the target to experience any one specified emotion. Caster cannot dictate the direction the target will choose to express this emotion. For example, caster can specify the emotion oflove, but he cannot choose a person for the target to fall in love with, the target will just be very loving in general.

sp-00854.description_en: The target likes or dislikes a person, place, or thing as specified by the caster. If the target has very strong feelings about the subject previously, the GM may indicate that the target receives a bonus or penalty to his resistance rolls. JO. Fear-Target flees in total fear from the caster (or a specified location) for I min per 5% failure. The target will not desire to return to the location or wish to face the caster for I day/5% failure.

sp-00856.description_en: Target develops a very serious and troublesome doubt concerning a previously accepted fact, action, or idea.

sp-00857.description_en: As Inclination, except the target experiences either devoted love or repulsive hatred towards a subject designated by caster (must be present at time of casting). For the duration the intensity of the emotion will be such that the target will have a difficult time focusing on anything else other than his love or hate. At the end of the duration, the target must make an additional resistance roll with a +20 RR modification or the effect will become permanent (to a lesser degree of intensity).

sp-00858.description_en: Target will seek to enact some vengeance against a person, place, or thing as specified by the caster. There must be in the target's mind some concept of the subject having wronged the target for the spell to be effective. The exact form of the vengeance sought depends on the character of the target, and the severity of his RR failure.

sp-00859.description_en: The caster may summon any extra planar creature (e.g., demon, elemental, etc) whose True name he knows (through use of the Creature Name spell). Each round there is a 35% chance the specified creature hears his name and appears to the caster. This spell does not command the entity, though the caster may control the entity through the use of other spells on this list or through various influential skills.

sp-00860.description_en: All targets within the area of effect will become hostile and seek to attack the nearest opponent

sp-00861.description_en: Target extra planar creature (e.g. demon, elemental, etc) whose True name the caster knows (through the use of the Creature Name spell) is dismissed from the caster's plane back to his home plane. Alternatively, the caster can attempt to banish the target from the caster's plane for a period of I 00 years/I 0% failure. The target receives a special +20 RR modification to any banish attempt and if the spell fails, the target will either attack the caster or flee. The attempt to banish the demon cancels any of the caster's control spells of which the target is under the influence.

sp-00862.description_en: Targets flee in total panic from the caster.

sp-00863.description_en: Target is eased from the effects of mind disease, grief, Iycanthropy, hate, etc for the duration of this spell.

sp-00864.description_en: As Confusion, except affects all targets in radius.

sp-00865.description_en: As Command, except affects all targets in radius.

sp-00866.description_en: Target sleeps in a deep, unwakable sleep without aging or deterioration until dispelled, a set condition is met or the duration ends.

sp-00868.description_en: Target becomes the caster's unquestioning slave for the duration of this spell. The target may attempt a new RR at the end of each week to break the effect. The target will seek to ingratiate himself to his master and do all things in a manner to please his master and forward his master's goals.

sp-00870.description_en: This spell inscribes a spell on a specially prepared piece of paper. The rune can then be used to cast the inscribed spell once. The spell to be inscribed must be cast within one minute after this spell is cast. Rune II can inscribe 1st or 2nd level spells. The rune can be set to affect the reader.

sp-00871.description_en: [RR . - - - - - - - - - - . . - - - - - - - - - - - - , Mod: -20] A Sign can be inscribed on any "non-mobile" surface and affects the triggering being. A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): a) specified time has passed, b) specified movements within 20', c) specified sounds within 20', d) touch, or e) reading. The Sign is cancelled when a target fails a RR against it. Sign of Pain causes the target to take 25%

sp-00872.description_en: '-As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 3rd level spells.

sp-00873.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain, except Iii.Ji I target feels weak and drained. This results in a special modifi- W cation of -20 to all maneuvers and attacks for I O minutes per 5 RR failure.

sp-00874.description_en: The caster may determine what spell is inscribed within a rune or sign. This spell has a I% chance per level of the inscribed spell of setting off the inscribed spell. The caster also learns if the rune or sign is set to affect a readerornot.

sp-00875.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 5th level spells.

sp-00876.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target is in a state of shock for I Ominutes per 5% failure (treat shock victims as if they are stunned except they never pass out due to this shock).

sp-00877.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 6th level spells. I0. Sign of Fear-[RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target will flee the place of the sign. The target may not return for I0 minutes per 5 RR failure.

sp-00879.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 7th level spells.

sp-00880.description_en: As Sign ofPain except target is teleported to one of the caster's designated Observation Signs. The designated Observation Sign may not be more than I mile per level of the caster (at the time of inscribing this spell) away from the Sign of Transport or else the attempt to inscribe this Sign automatically fails.

sp-00881.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 8th level spells.

sp-00882.description_en: Caster's may see and hear as ifhe were at any one of his Observation Signs within range of this spell. The caster's vision may rotate around the point of the Observation Sign (except that he will not be able to see through the surface the Sign is inscribed on if it is opaque.

sp-00883.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 10th level spells.

sp-00884.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target takes 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-00886.description_en: As Rune II, except caster may inscribe up to 15th level spells.

sp-00887.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Pain except target is blinded for I hour per 5% RR failure.

sp-00916.description_en: Target wooden object has it's form, straightness, and strength ruined. This results in doubling the break number range (to a maximum of 1-10) and halving the original strength (or reliability). The object may not be larger than I pound per level of caster.

sp-00917.description_en: Caster instantly transforms I cubic foot of earth or wood into a fine, dry powder.

sp-00918.description_en: As Dust Earth/Wood, except affects I cubic foot of stone.

sp-00919.description_en: Caster animates I cubic foot (per level of the caster) of any gaseous substance within range. For as long as caster concentrates, gas will move as the caster wills at a rate of I' per level of caster per round, subject to environmental conditions. If the gas moves beyond a I0'R/lvl of the caster then it is no longerunder the caster's control. The caster may give the gas a last command (such as follow me or move towards the door). After giving a final command, the caster no longer concentrates and the gas will attempt to follow the final command for I round/level of the caster (or until the gas moves out of range of the caster).

sp-00920.description_en: All metal on the target object oxidizes at a rate of 1 cubic inch per round.

sp-00921.description_en: As Animate Gas, except affects liquid.

sp-00922.description_en: Caster is able to convert I cubic foot of sand, dirt or dust into a solid stone form. The stone formed will have the same general shape as the original substance did just prior to conversion to stone.

sp-00923.description_en: As Warp Wood, except affects metal objects up to I pound per level of the caster.

sp-00924.description_en: The caster may cause a target living creature to bleed (if applicable). The target begins to bleed at a rate of 1 hit per round per 5% RR failure. For example, if a target fails his RR by 25, he will bleed 5 hits per round for 5 rounds .

sp-00925.description_en: As Ice/Water, except affects up to 10 cubic feet.

sp-00926.description_en: As Animate Gas, except affects I cubic inch of solid material per level of the caster.

sp-00927.description_en: Target inorganic item (up to I cubic foot in size) is shattered explosively. All targets within 5' take an 'A' Impact critical and the holder of the object takes a 'C' Impact critical.

sp-00928.description_en: As Dust Stone, except affects up to 10 cubic feet of stone.

sp-00929.description_en: Target normal plant (shrub size or smaller) instantly dies and withers. Magical plants, large plants, and unusual plants may attempt to resist this spell (with a special modifier of +20).

sp-00930.description_en: Target Animate spell from this list has its duration increased to I minute per level. Caster may give the animated material simple commands and the animated material will attempt to carry out those commands (without the need for the caster to concentrate).

sp-00931.description_en: As Dust Earth/Wood, except I cubic inch of metal may be affected.

sp-00932.description_en: Target lock is magically fused shut. The lock may be broken, but it will never unlock.

sp-00933.description_en: As Shatter, except object may be up to 3 cubic feet (in size) and all within IO'R take a 'B' Impact critical, while the holder takes a 'D' Impact critical.

sp-00934.description_en: Target organic creature, plant or object begins to rot. Each round the caster concentrates, the target receives a cumulative -10 penalty to all actions and looses 10% of his current hits. If the target ever leaves the range of this spell, this spell is cancelled (though the damage taken is still applied).

sp-00935.description_en: As Lesser Animation, except for duration.

sp-00936.description_en: Caster may cause a living or organic target to gradually turn to stone at the rate of 5% of the total mass of the target per round. The effect may be dispelled or removed with a Remove Curse spell; however, the petrified object resists all dispelling attempts at with a special modifier of +20 (making it harder to dispel the petrification).

sp-00937.description_en: As Petrify, except for duration and the petrified target resists dispelling attempts at +40.

sp-00939.description_en: Caster can remove one Symbol/ (an placed I st level spell). The Symbol's RR is based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (the target's level) and the level of the Bypass Symbol Spell (the attack level).

sp-00940.description_en: Caster can emplace one I st level spell on any I given non-mobile stone (see below). Within one minute, the spell to be placed must also be cast (within I 0'). The symbol is usually visible, but is only required to be visible if reading is the trigger (see below). • The Symbol must be placed on a slab of stone (block, piece, etc.) weighing at least 2,000 pounds. Only one Symbol may be placed on each continuous slab. The stone may not be moved without dispelling the Symbol. • A Symbol can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. The triggering range is normally I 0' or the range of the placed spell, whichever is larger. • If the spell placed is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell's level (i.e., for Symbol I that attack level is always 1st level, not the level of the caster). If the spell is an elemental attack, the OB is normally +0. However, the attack can be focused on a location (as opposed to simply the person who triggers the symbol). In this case the OB is +50. • Normally, if the Symbol affects a being or thing (e.g., healing, attacks, etc.), it can be triggered only once per day.

sp-00941.description_en: Allows the caster to connect one surface or trigger to a symbol that is normally outside of range of the symbol. For example, manipulating a door and lock mechanism in one room could trigger a Light Symbol on the other side of the building, bringing someone to investigate. The distance between the trigger and the symbol can be up to 1 foot per level. Symbol Extension must be in place before the symbol to use it is inscribed or imbedded.

sp-00942.description_en: As Bypass Symbol/, except affects up to a Symbol II/.

sp-00943.description_en: As Unsymbol /, except affects up to a Symbol

sp-00944.description_en: As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a 3rd level spell.

sp-00945.description_en: As Bypass Symbol I, except affects up to a Symbol V.

sp-00946.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol V.

sp-00950.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol VII/.

sp-00955.description_en: As Symbol I, except emplaces up to a I 3th level spell.

sp-00956.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except affects up to a Symbol X/11.

sp-00957.description_en: As Symbol I, except caster can emplace any spell less than his level.

sp-00958.description_en: Allows caster to modify any imbed symbol spell on this list to allow it to be imbedded on a mobile surface. The resulting sign will remain potent until it is triggered. The mobile surface must be non-living and must weigh at least I 00 pounds. A given spell caster can only have one mobile sign per level of experience (subsequent castings will cause the oldest castings to dispel).

sp-00959.description_en: As Unsymbol I, except caster can remove any spell of a level less than his own (e.g., a 50th level Runemage could remove a 49th level spell, but not a 50th level spell).

sp-00960.description_en: As Inscribe Sign, except target must be a living creature and must weigh at least 50 pounds. The sign will remain potent until triggered. Often these signs are disguised by incorporating them with existing tattoos.

sp-00961.description_en: Allows the caster to research special ward spells to be used with this list. In addition, the caster receives a special bonus of +25 to his next Ward Lore maneuver.

sp-00962.description_en: Allows the caster to detect all active wards within the area of effect. The caster can move the area of effect each round.

sp-00963.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward this spell will sound an alarm when a specified set of circumstances occur within the area of effect. The alarm may be silent (only the caster will be aware, at a range of 100' per level of caster) or audible (everyone will hear an alarm will sound), as dictated at the time of casting. An alarm may either sound for as long as the specified circumstance exists, or it can be set to sound for up to 1 minute per level of the caster before returning to a dormant and watchful state.

sp-00964.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward sign(s) this spell will prevent the use of one designated sense through the area of effect. The sense must be decided at the time the ward sign is prepared. If the caster spends double the normal number of PPs required by this spell, he may add an additional sense that is blocked by this spell. For each increment of normal PPs spent, another sense may be blocked. For example, if 16 PPs are spent, four senses could be blocked. Note that for each extra sense blocked, this spell is treated as being one level higher (for the purposes of Warding Lore).

sp-00965.description_en: When cast on a properly prepared ward sign(s) this spell will attempt to prevent the passage of animals into or through the area of effect. Any animal that attempts to travel through this area will go elsewhere unless it makes an RR (with a special modifier of -20) versus the level of the caster. An animal may be forced into the area, but it will fight and struggle against this as much as it is able. Any animal forces past the ward will suffer a -25 to all actions while in the protected area.

sp-00966.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except affects lesser spirits of the dead (Class I, II, and III).

sp-00967.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except affects lesser demons (Type I, II, and III).

sp-00968.description_en: As Sense Ward, except prevents the casting of Essence spells through the area of effect. All Essence spells must first resist versus the level of the ward or else be canceled. Active spells that pass through the area of effect must make a RR or else be dispelled.

sp-00969.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except prevents the use of Mentalism spells.

sp-00970.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except prevents the use of Channeling spells. ll. Multiple Ward-Allows the caster to combine multiple wards into one properly prepared ward sign. The caster must cast all of the wards involved immediately after this spell (within 2 minutes).

sp-00972.description_en: As Sense Ward, except prevents all creatures from passing into or through the area of effect. Any creature that attempts to pass through the area of effect must make a -20 RR or be blocked from passing through the area. This spell does not have any effect on Class IV, V, and VI undead, nor does it have any effect on Type IV, V, and VI demons.

sp-00973.description_en: As Lesser Animal Ward, except animals must make a -40 RR.

sp-00974.description_en: As Greater Animal Ward, except Class I, II, and III undead must make a-40RR and Class IV, V, and VI undead must make a normal RR.

sp-00975.description_en: Allows caster to tum the ward signs of any ward invisible. The ward is still detectable by a Detect Ward spell.

sp-00976.description_en: As Greater Animal Ward, except Type I, II, and III demons must make a -40 RR and Type IV, V, and VI demons must make a normal RR.

sp-00977.description_en: As Lesser Essence Ward, except for duration.

sp-00978.description_en: As Lesser Mentalism Ward, except for duration.

sp-00979.description_en: As Lesser Channeling Ward, except for duration.

sp-00980.description_en: As Lesser Barrier Ward, except any creature attempting to pass through the area of effect must make a -40 RR. Class IV, V, and VI undead and Type IV, V, and VI demons resist at 10.

sp-00982.description_en: Caster may enchant one ward to have an additional defense versus the ward's target creature type. Whenever the designated creature attempts to pass through the area of effect, in addition to the normal effects of the ward, the ward delivers an 'E' Impact critical if it enters the area of effect (regardless of the creatures resistance roll).

sp-00983.description_en: When this spell is cast on any lower level ward, the target ward will have its duration increased to 1day/level of the caster.

sp-03968.description_en: Caster Channels his deity's energy into a small amount of water, contaminating it with elemental material. Targets in contact with the water will take an 'A' critical of the appropriate type (Impact if they infuse it with Elemental Water). If splashed on a target, make a d100 roll with the following results: 1-25: A critical at -50; 26-50: A critical at -20; 51+ A critical.

sp-03969.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Caster points his hand at target and a blast of raw power from the caster's Deity flows forth. Target struck by beam must resist or have part of itself turn into Elemental Material. Exposure is such that the target receives an 'A' critical of the appropriate type if he fails his Resistance Roll.

sp-03970.description_en: When this spell is cast, the first level spell that the caster begins to cast the next round will be “channeled” to another spell user of the Channeling realm or another spell user who has specialized in the same element as the caster. The “channeled” spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately (i.e., the receiving spell user is now treated as the caster of the spell.) All normal restrictions apply to the transmitted spell. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver of the spell or know exactly where he is (direction and distance, or specified location). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (though he need not know exactly what spell is coming). For example, if an Elemental Priest was at a certain altar at midnight on a full moon ready to receive a spell, then another spell user who knew this could use Channels to send him a spell.

sp-03971.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a Deity or Lord). The target of the spell is stunned.

sp-03972.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'B' critical of the appropriate type.

sp-03973.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a third level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03974.description_en: Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power from his power source (usually a deity.) The target of the spell falls into a deep sleep. The first minute of this sleep is magical (and the target cannot be awakened in any normal fashion.) After the first minute, the target may be awakened normally (though his deep sleep will prevent him from waking on his own until he has slept a full eight hours.)

sp-03975.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'C' critical of the appropriate type.

sp-03976.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a fifth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03977.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I, except the target receives a 'D' critical of the appropriate type.

sp-03978.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a eighth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03979.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I except target receives an 'E' critical of the appropriate type.

sp-03981.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's “soul” is torn from his body; it remains in whatever place “souls” go for the duration of the spell. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. The target is unconscious until the soul is restored. Even subconscious activities (i.e., healing, etc.) suffer a -75 penalty.

sp-03982.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Elemental Channel I except target is completely converted into the caster's element, killing him. All within 5' of target take an 'A' critical of the appropriate type.

sp-03983.description_en: As Channels I, except up to a twentieth level spell may be transmitted.

sp-03984.description_en: Opens a direct channel to the caster's deity; results depend on the deity's personality, motives, and powers. Any spell the deity can cast may be transmitted through the gate.

sp-03996.description_en: As Aggression I, except bonus is +20.

sp-03997.description_en: Target Elemental's energy is intensified. All attacks deal double damage, including breath weapons but not spells. If this spell is cast on a non-elemental, then only breath weapons would be affected. For example, if this was cast on a Zephyr Hound, its breath weapon would do double damage but its melee attacks would remain unaffected.

sp-03998.description_en: As Haste I, except the duration is 3 rounds, split among 1 to 3 targets (in any combination.)

sp-03999.description_en: As Quickness I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04000.description_en: Allows the next spell cast from this list, that is 7th level or lower, to affect one target per level of the caster.

sp-04001.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds, split among 1 to 5 targets (in any combination.)

sp-04002.description_en: As Aggression I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04003.description_en: All of the target's attacks deal double-damage, even breath weapons. Spells remain unaffected.

sp-04004.description_en: As Quickness II, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04005.description_en: Allows the next spell cast from this list to last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-04006.description_en: As Mass Enhancement I, except it will work with any spell on this list 20th level or lower.

sp-04007.description_en: Target is under the effects of Battle Awareness, Reactions I, Peripheral Vision, Aggression III, Quickness III, and Empower for the duration.

sp-03985.description_en: Target gains +25 to his Battle Awareness checks.

sp-03986.description_en: * — Caster creates an invisible force shield in front of the target. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.) Except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.

sp-03987.description_en: Targets gain better insight into the future. Targets gain +3 to their initiative rolls.

sp-03988.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-03989.description_en: Target's level of aggression is increased beyond normal. Attacks that are made while under the effects of this spell are at +10.

sp-03990.description_en: Target may act at twice their normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but immediately afterwards must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds speeded at half rate (i.e., only 50%) per round. See Of Essence for more details.

sp-03991.description_en: Target is faster and more fluid for the duration. The target's Defensive Bonus increases by 10 for all attacks of which that target is aware.

sp-03992.description_en: Target's peripheral vision is enhanced. Foes attacking target do not get any bonuses for flanking and only a +5 for attacking from the rear.

sp-03993.description_en: I — Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e. 200% activity). See Of Essence for more details.

sp-03994.description_en: Target's strength increases for the duration, allowing target to deliver double damage with his melee attacks. This spell does not work on creatures that have their entire make-up from one of the elements (i.e., elementals).

sp-03995.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 4 rounds split

sp-04008.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small elemental (of animal intelligence) to serve as his familiar. Creature can be no more than 10% of the caster's own mass and the caster must cast this spell on the creature once per day for 1 week (concentrating on it two hours per day.) The caster must then choose one of two options: the caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). Alternatively, creature can act as a +1 spell adder to the caster gaining a +1 for every 10 levels of the caster. If the first option is chosen then if the creature is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks. If the second option is chosen, then the caster will be at half power points for 2 weeks.

sp-04009.description_en: Allows caster total control of a Type I Elemental. When caster stops concentrating the elemental will either return to its normal plane of existence or attack the summoner (equal chance of either.) Alternatively, instead of controlling the elemental, the caster can force it to flee for 1 round per level of the caster. Option must be chosen at the time of casting.

sp-04010.description_en: Allows the caster to open a gate to the elemental plane of his choice. Gate forms over the course of three rounds. After gate forms an elemental will come through the gate and will stay for three rounds. If the elemental is not controlled or mastered within three rounds, the elemental will return through the gate or will attack the summoner (equal chance of either). Gate is attuned to drawing in the weakest of elementals (Type I), however it won't prevent a stronger one from coming through. Roll randomly to determine the type of elemental that comes through the gate: 01-75, Type I Elemental; 76-90, Type II Elemental; 91-100, Type III Elemental.

sp-04011.description_en: As Control Elemental I, except caster need not concentrate to control the elemental. The elemental will remain and obey the caster until the caster is killed, the elemental is outside the range limit, or the elemental is killed. If the elemental is ever freed from this bond, it will either return to its normal plane of existence or attack the summoner (equal chance of either).

sp-04012.description_en: As Control Elemental I, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-04013.description_en: For the duration caster can speak to elementals of one Elemental Source (Fire, Water, Earth, etc.). Caster must choose the type of elemental at the time of casting. Casting of this spell does not ensure that the elemental is friendly, just that the caster can speak to him.

sp-04014.description_en: As Master Elemental I, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-04015.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except gate is attuned to pulling in Type II Elementals, however it won't prevent a

sp-04016.description_en: As Control Type I, except it affects Type I, II, or III Elementals.

sp-04017.description_en: As Control Type I, except it affects Type I, II, III, or IV Elementals.

sp-04018.description_en: As Master Type I, except it affects Type I, II or III Elementals.

sp-04019.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except gate is attuned to pulling in Type III Elementals, however it won't prevent a weaker or stronger elemental from coming through the gate. Roll randomly to determine the type of elemental that comes through the gate: 01-05, Type I Elemental; 06-10, Type II Elemental; 11-75, Type III Elemental; 76-90, Type IV Elemental; 91-100, Type V Elemental.

sp-04020.description_en: As Master Type I, except it affects Type I - IV Elementals. If cast on a Type V Elemental, effect only lasts 1 hour per level.

sp-04021.description_en: As Elemental Gate I, except caster can specify type of Elemental (I-V) and the specific elemental summoned. GM's may allow Priests to summon Avatars of their Deity with this spell, though the caster must be in very good graces with his Deity to do so.

sp-04022.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of d10 Concussion hits.

sp-04023.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding of a wound on an elemental being that is bleeding up to 2 hits per round; target may not be moved or bleeding resumes.

sp-04024.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of one area of minor damage caused by an element. Minor damage is considered to be similar to minor frostbite or 1st degree burn (GM discretion).

sp-04025.description_en: Allows the caster to stop bleeding on a wound on an elemental being that is bleeding up to 2 hits per round, target may not be moved or bleeding resumes.

sp-04026.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of one minor irritation (e.g., headache, tooth-ache, bee-sting, hang-over, etc.)

sp-04028.description_en: * — Target elemental is relieved of one round of accumulated stun. This spell goes off automatically if the caster is stunned (if the caster qualifies, i.e., has 14 corruption points in his element).

sp-04029.description_en: Allows caster to stop bleeding from one wound that is bleeding at 1 hit per round.

sp-04030.description_en: * — Target elemental is healed of 1 Concussion hit for every minute the caster concentrates.

sp-04031.description_en: Target elemental is healed of 5d10 concussion hits.

sp-04032.description_en: Elemental material of the caster's Main Element is pooled into a suitable container (GM's discretion, fire would burn a wood container, but any of the others would be fine). Contact with material will cause an 'A' critical to those who are unprotected or who have the “bath” spell cast on them.

sp-04033.description_en: Allows caster to close one open wound that is bleeding up to 5 hits per round.

sp-04034.description_en: Target Elemental creature can bathe in the elemental material pooled by the caster. For every minute spent in the bath it heals 5 Concussion hits or 1 hit per round of Bleeding. Bath is effective up to 1 minute per cubic foot of elemental material caster has summoned using the pool element.

sp-04035.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the same spells from the Elemental Restorations list (Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Bone.)

sp-04036.description_en: Allows caster to repair 1 damaged blood vessel of any size, including severed veins and arteries; recovery time: 1-10 days, depending on the size of the vessel and the severity of the damage. A major vessel is one that bleeds at 5 hits per round or more when severed.

sp-04037.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of 7d10 concussion hits.

sp-04038.description_en: * — As Regeneration I, except target's damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute.

sp-04039.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of 10d10 concussion hits.

sp-04040.description_en: As Clotting I, except that blood loss (i.e. hits per round) from one wound is stopped.

sp-04041.description_en: Allows caster to reattach severed limb; also requires use of the spells from the Elemental Preservations List (Joining: Muscles, Joining: Nerves, Joining: Bone.)

sp-04042.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.

sp-04043.description_en: Target Elemental is healed of all concussion hits.

sp-04044.description_en: Caster acquires complete understanding of any bodily damage, including the tools and methods required for healing; caster does not receive the skill or power to perform the cure.

sp-04045.description_en: Allows to caster to repair (not replace) 1 sprain; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04046.description_en: Allows caster to mend one simple fracture (not compound fractures, shatters, joint damage, etc.) Recovery time is one day.

sp-04047.description_en: Allows caster to repair (not replace) 1 damaged muscle, recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04048.description_en: Allows caster to repair all cartilage damage around one joint. Recovery time is one day.

sp-04049.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor damage to 1 nerve; there is no recovery time. Minor damage is any damage that results in penalties up to -20.

sp-04050.description_en: Allows caster to repair one damaged tendon; recovery time: 1 hour.

sp-04051.description_en: As Minor Fracture Repair, except that the caster can repair compound fractures. Recovery time is one day.

sp-04052.description_en: Allows caster to repair one fracture in a skull (but not a shattered area). Recovery time is 1-10 days (depending on the damage.)

sp-04053.description_en: As Minor Nerve Repair, except it will heal any nerve damage.

sp-04054.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04055.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04056.description_en: Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the following spells: Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Bones, Limb Preservation: Blood Vessels.

sp-04057.description_en: Caster can repair any eye damage short of total eye loss (e.g., eye's destruction precludes repair); recovery time: 1-10 days.

sp-04058.description_en: Allows caster to repair one broken (but not shattered joint). Recovery time is 1-10 days.

sp-04059.description_en: Caster can cure any 1 paralysis problem.

sp-04060.description_en: Allows caster to repair any internal or external organ damage (not including the brain or nervous system); requires a 1-10 hour operation and 1-10 day recovery time.

sp-04061.description_en: Allows caster to reattach limb. As long as all four Preservation spells have been cast on the limb this spell succeeds. Otherwise this spell fails. If successful, limb is fully functional in 1-10 days.

sp-04062.description_en: Allows caster to repair minor brain damage (including recovery from coma); note that experience lost is not restored (% lost permanently dependent on severity of damage); requires a 1 hour operation; recover time: 1-10 days.

sp-04063.description_en: Allows caster to regenerate any one part of the target's body. There is no recovery time.

sp-04064.description_en: Caster is aware of all who are tainted with elemental material within the area of effect. This does not determine the type of corruption nor the severity.

sp-04065.description_en: Caster is aware of the type of elemental corruption and the severity of the corruption (Corruption Points) for the target of this spell.

sp-04066.description_en: Target is temporarily infused with elemental material of the caster's Main Element. For all intents and purposes, target's corruption points are considered 10 higher for the duration.

sp-04067.description_en: Target's body is readied for an Elemental Infusion. This prevents the negative effects of an infusion spell.

sp-04068.description_en: Target's body is slowly infused with elemental force. It travels through the blood and lymph system of the target's body, slowly integrating itself. This process takes 10 minutes and those who are not protected by a prepare body spell take an 'A' Tiny critical every minute of this spell's duration. The target's corruption points for the caster's element are increased by 3. This spell cannot raise a target's corruption points over 10. Any random rolls for trait determination may be modified by +/ - 20%, if the corruption caused by this spell causes the target to receive a factor point.

sp-04069.description_en: Target's body is covered in an illusion that will display the physical effects of being tainted by one element (chosen at time of casting). If analyzed by an Analyze Taint spell, the target must make an RR. If successful, the target is seen as having a corruption level of 25. If the RR is failed then the analyzer pierces the illusion and knows the truth.

sp-04070.description_en: Target's body is covered with an illusion that will disguise the effects of one elemental factor (caused by corruption points). The illusion is visual and magical. Any magical detections trying to pierce the illusion must make a resistance roll to do so.

sp-04071.description_en: As Transformation I, except taint level is 20 higher for the duration.

sp-04072.description_en: Elemental energies are slowly removed from target's body. This process takes 10 minutes and those who are not protected by a prepare body spell take an 'A' Tiny critical every minute of this spell's duration. The target's corruption level decreases by 1-10 for any element of the caster's choice.

sp-04073.description_en: As Infuse Taint I, except that 3 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 20.

sp-04074.description_en: [RR Mod: — (equal to highest corruption points / 5)]. Target's highest elemental corruption is turned against him. If he fails by 1-10 he will take an 'A' Impact critical; 11-20, a 'B' critical; 21-30, a 'C' critical; 31-40, a 'D' critical, 41+, an 'E' critical.

sp-04075.description_en: As Transformation I, corruption points are 30 higher for the duration.

sp-04076.description_en: As Infuse Taint I, except 5 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 30.

sp-04077.description_en: As Remove Taint I, except 2-20 corruption points are removed.

sp-04078.description_en: Target being that has a number of corruption points over 50 is made immune to all effects of elemental corruption; additionally corruption points cannot be removed from the target. Only divine intervention can counter the effects of this spell. Half of all the corruptive traits the target has are passed onto his offspring. Determine which traits are passed on by rolling randomly.

sp-04079.description_en: As Consumptive Taint I, except that the two highest elemental corruption points are turned against his (roll only one attack roll but roll resistance rolls twice, one for each element). If the target has only one type of corruption, then treat this spell as two separate castings of Consumptive Taint I.

sp-04080.description_en: As Infuse Taint I, except 7 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 40.

sp-04081.description_en: As Remove Taint I, except 3 corruption points are removed and the corruption level can be reduced all the way.

sp-04082.description_en: As Infuse Taint I, except 10 corruption points are gained and there is no maximum taint level.

sp-04083.description_en: Target dead body (self if caster dies) is consumed in a massive explosion of elemental force. All within 10' R of target take an attack by an elemental ball of the caster's type (use Fireball Table, changing the criticals according to the elemental type of the caster), doing double damage. This conflagration of force lasts for 10 minutes (those in the area take attacks every round). After 10 minutes have passed the elemental conflagration dies out suddenly and the target appears at its center alive and well. Target suffers no negative effects from being dead but now has at least 50 corruption points of the caster's elemental type (if he was already corrupted, add 50). All other elemental corruption has been removed from the target's body. Target is also under a minor Geas from the Priest's Deity (GM's determination of what it is). If this spell is cast by the Priest's subconscious mind (i.e. on themselves) then there is no Geas. Optional rule: GM may decide that this is a literal rebirth. If so then the target emerges from the conflagration as an infant. He will age 1 year each day till he reaches his previous age. Longlived races will generally age faster, dwarves: x2, Elves: x5.
